 A differently colored variant, the Dark Dagger L,
also exists.

194.DSCR:
A fighter-type space mobile armor developed by the
Earth Alliance Forces.
 The successor to the Moebius Zero, it is equipped
with four of the wired-type 'Gun Barrel' units,
armed with beam cannons and beam edges. This is a
weapon that only someone with exceptional spatial
awareness can handle, but its pilot, Neo, wields it
as naturally as his own limbs, holding his own
without any trouble even against Shinn and Ray
simultaneously.
194.DSC2:
A fighter-type space mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance Forces.
 The successor to the Moebius Zero, it is equipped
with four of the wired-type 'Gun Barrel' units,
armed with beam cannons and beam edges. This is a
weapon that only someone with exceptional spatial
awareness can handle, but its pilot, Neo, wields
it as naturally as his own limbs, holding his own
without any trouble even against Shinn and Ray
simultaneously.

195.DSCR:
The Earth Alliance Forces' mainstay mass-production
mobile suit, succeeding the Dagger-L.
 It is highly mobile thanks to large thrusters
mounted on its shoulders, back, and legs. Because
it can make use of the 'Striker Pack System' from
the Dagger-L, the generational transition was able
to proceed smoothly.
 In addition to the Jet Striker Pack, which enables
flight even under gravity, there also exists a Multi
Striker Pack equipped with nuclear missiles.
195.DSC2:
The Windam is the successor to the Dagger L and the
Earth Alliance's main mass-production mobile suit.
It is highly mobile due to the large thrusters
mounted on its shoulders, back, and legs. Since the
Strike Pack system from the Dagger L can be used
with it, this facilitated a smooth generational
transition. In addition to the Jet Striker Pack,
which allows flight under gravity, a Multi Striker
Pack equipped with nuclear missiles also exists.
Its base specs are high, but perhaps because it is
often shown being shot down by the Minerva's mobile
suit team, which surpasses it, no scenes of it in
action were seen.

196.DSCR:
Neo Roanoke's personal Windam, colored purple
unlike standard units.
 While the unit's base performance is unchanged from
a standard model, its Jet Striker Pack is a special
limiter-removed specification, giving it a
substantial boost in thrust.
 Since it lacked weaponry that could take advantage
of Neo's true forte - his spatial awareness - it saw
no particularly flashy exploits, but it nevertheless
held its own, and more, against both Shinn and
Athrun.
196.DSC2:
This is Neo Roanoke's personal Windam unit. Unlike
the standard units, it is painted in a purple color
scheme.
 The basic performance of the unit is no different
from the standard models, but the Jet Striker pack
is a special specification with the limiters
removed, greatly increasing its thrust.
 Because it was not equipped with weapons that could
make use of Neo's true specialty, his spatial
awareness ability, it did not have any flashy
achievements, but even so it fought on par with or
better than Shinn and Athrun.
 In the battle at Berlin, it was shot down by Kira,
who pierced the flight unit along with both arms.
At the time it was flying at a considerable
altitude, but the impact of the crash did not cause
the machine to explode, so its impact resistance
appears to be quite high.

197.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X24S) and the Alliance (RGX-01).
 With large thrusters on its back and waist, it is a
unit specialized for combat in open space, capable
of independent flight even within the atmosphere
using that same output. Its mobility increases
further after morphing into mobile armor form.
 Its distinctive armament includes Mobile Armament
Pods based on an improved DRAGOON System, which
allow it to carry out an All-Range Attack. Using
this, it instantly wiped out two GuAIZ R units from
the Minerva that had been sent in pursuit from
Armory One.
197.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X24S) and the Alliance (RGX-01).
 The large thrusters on its back and waist make it a
machine specialized for space combat, and within the
atmosphere it can use that output for independent
flight. After transforming into mobile armor form,
its maneuverability improves even further.
 Its distinctive armament includes mobile weapon
pods that improve on the DRAGOON system, enabling
all-range attacks. Using these, it instantly
destroyed two GOUF Ignited units launched from the
Minerva in pursuit from Armory One.
 However, those were about its only notable
achievements. Afterwards it was cornered by Athrun
and others at Junius Seven, defeated by Kira off the
coast of Crete, and shot down by Orb's Murasame
squadron in Berlin.

198.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X31S) and the Alliance (RGX-02).
 A highly versatile unit usable in a variety of
battle conditions, it performs at its absolute best
in underwater combat. When it morphs into its
uniquely shaped mobile armor form, it can swim
freely underwater like a fish returned to water. It
once toyed with Ray's and Lunamaria's ZAKUs
simultaneously and sank the submarine carrier
Nilagongo, among other feats.
198.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X31S) and the Alliance (RGX-02).
 It is a highly versatile machine that can be
deployed in a variety of combat situations, but it
displays its maximum performance especially in
underwater combat. When it transforms into its
uniquely shaped mobile armor form, it can swim
through the water with complete freedom, like a fish
in water. It toyed with both Ray's and Lunamaria's
ZAKUs simultaneously and also sank the submarine
carrier Niragon Goh, among other achievements.
 However, it is ironic that its end came when it was
pierced by the Blast Impulse Gundam on the water's
surface - its own favored field.

199.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X88S) and the Alliance (RGX-03).
 Following in the design lineage of the BuCUE and
LaGOWE, it can morph into a four-legged beast-type
mobile armor form. Specialized for ground-based
melee combat, its basic tactic is to close the
distance on enemies using its mobility and agility,
then cut them down with its wing-shaped beam
blades.
199.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X88S) and the Alliance (RGX-03).
 Following in the lineage of the BuCUE and LaGOWE,
it can transform into a four-legged beast-type
mobile armor form. It specializes in melee combat
on land, using its mobility and maneuverability to
close in on enemies and slice them in two with its
wing-shaped beam blades as its basic tactic.
 In battle, it fought on par with or better than
Lunamaria and Shinn, and also shot down Heine.
However, Stella, lacking mental stability, sortied
alone on her own authority and was shot down as a
result.

200.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain.
 This unit was recovered by ZAFT after being
disabled in combat against the Savior Gundam and the
Impulse Gundam. During its transport back to PLANT,
the Clyne Faction apparently pulled some strings,
and it ended up being sent to the Eternal instead.
It was subsequently repainted in a coloring
reminiscent of the LaGOWE and became Waltfeld's
personal unit.
200.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
 This is the unit that ZAFT recovered after it was
rendered inoperable in battle against the Saviour
Gundam and Impulse Gundam. During transport to
PLANT, the Clyne faction apparently intervened by
some means, and it was sent to the Eternal.
Afterwards it was repainted in a color scheme
reminiscent of the LaGOWE and became Waltfeld's
personal machine. However, since Waltfeld needed to
serve as captain of the Eternal, it was almost never
used.

201.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units. It was entrusted to Athrun by
Durandal when he was appointed to FAITH.
 Specialized for aerial combat, it gains even
greater mobility by morphing into mobile armor form,
which also enables long-range cruising. It served
as a mainstay unit for the Minerva, which fought
frequently at sea.
 In battle, it can use hit-and-run tactics that
exploit its high mobility, as well as attacks that
vary in speed to confuse the enemy.
201.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed by ZAFT as part of the
'Second Stage Series' of new-generation
high-performance machines. It was entrusted to
Athrun by Durandal when he was appointed to FAITH.
The unit is specialized for aerial combat, and by
transforming into mobile armor mode it gains even
greater mobility and is capable of long-range
cruising. It served as the mainstay of the Minerva,
which saw much combat over the sea. In battle, it
could employ hit-and-run tactics using its high
mobility, and confound enemies with attacks that
varied in speed. Later, it engaged Kira's Freedom
Gundam after a difference of opinion led them into
conflict, but found itself at a disadvantage in
basic performance against a unit equipped with a
Neutron Jammer Canceller, and struggled.
Furthermore, Kira's manifestation of SEED proved
decisive, and the Saviour was sliced apart by beam
sabers.

202.DSCR:
ZAFT's most advanced mobile suit, developed to
bring a decisive end to the war against the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 As Shinn's abilities grew rapidly, Durandal came to
believe that the Impulse Gundam could no longer make
full use of his talent, and had fine adjustments
made to the unit, effectively making it Shinn's
personal machine.
 It is equipped with the 'Hyper Deuterion,' a power
plant that combines a nuclear engine with the
Deuterion Beam Transmission System, and can generate
wings of light from its wing parts to achieve
tremendous mobility.
 It combines all the strengths of the Impulse
Gundam's three configurations, successfully
achieving both a varied arsenal effective at any
range and outstanding maneuverability. Further
equipped with unique systems such as palm-mounted
beam cannons and a Mirage-Colloid-based Double
function, it realizes the concept of a single unit
capable of handling any battle situation.
202.DSC2:
ZAFT's most advanced mobile suit, developed to
bring a decisive end to the war with the Earth
Alliance. As Shinn grew rapidly, Durandal judged
that the Impulse Gundam could no longer fully
utilize his talents, and had this unit finely tuned,
effectively making it Shinn's personal machine. It
is equipped with the 'Hyper Duetrion' power system,
which combines a nuclear engine with the Deuterion
Beam energy transmission system, and can generate
Wings of Light from its wing parts to achieve
tremendous mobility. It combines the strengths of
all three Impulse Gundam forms, successfully
reconciling a versatile arsenal effective at any
range with outstanding maneuverability.
Furthermore, unique equipment such as palm beam
cannons and a afterimage function applying Mirage
Colloid was added, realizing the concept of a single
unit capable of handling any combat situation.
However, the lack of armament on the legs proved to
be its undoing; during a melee exchange of kicks
with the Infinite Justice, its right leg was
destroyed by the Griffon Beam Blade, and it fell to
the lunar surface.

203.DSCR:
The most advanced mobile suit, an evolution of the
Providence Gundam developed in the closing days of
the previous war.
 It was originally intended to be given to Athrun,
from whom great things were expected, but when
Athrun himself attempted to defect from ZAFT, Ray,
who pursued him, ended up piloting it instead - and
it became his machine from then on.
 The 'DRAGOON System' mounted on its back has
improved response thanks to an upgraded quantum
interface, allowing it to be used regardless of the
pilot's spatial awareness. In outer space, it shows
its true worth by detaching from the main body to
carry out an All-Range Attack. Within the
atmosphere, it remains attached and instead adjusts
its angle, enabling multiple attacks across all
360 degrees.
203.DSC2:
A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed as an
evolution of the Providence Gundam, which was built
near the end of the previous war. Initially, it was
intended to be given to Athrun, whose performance
was highly anticipated, but when Athrun attempted to
defect from ZAFT, Ray, who was pursuing him, boarded
the unit instead, and it became his favored
machine. The 'Dragoon System' mounted on the back
has improved response through refinements to the
quantum interface, and can be used without being
limited by the pilot's spatial awareness. In space,
it displays its full potential by deploying
all-range attacks with separated units. Within the
atmosphere, it can adjust the angle of the units
without separating them to deliver multiple attacks
in all 360 degrees. It fought on equal terms
against Kira's Strike Freedom Gundam, who opposed
Durandal. However, Ray was shot down when he was
caught off guard by a momentary distraction caused
by Kira's words. Notably, at the end of the
previous war, a decisive battle was fought between
the Freedom Gundam and Providence Gundam, the
forerunners of these two units. The fact that the
pilot of the Providence Gundam at that time was Rau
Le Creuset, a being extremely close to Ray, also
speaks to their deep-seated connection.

204.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed by ZAFT in the closing days
of the previous war and entrusted by Lacus to Kira.
It was heavily damaged in battle against the
Providence Gundam during the final battle of that
war, but was secretly repaired in Orb and kept in
strict storage deep within an underground shelter.
 Though an older machine, it is equipped with a
Neutron Jammer Canceller, technology now banned from
installation in mobile suits. Because it uses a
nuclear fusion engine for power, it has no limit on
operating time, giving it performance that can
overwhelm current-generation units. Kira, who
wished to avoid further fighting, kept it sealed
away, but was ultimately forced to pilot it again in
order to protect Lacus and those around her from an
assassination squad. Since then it has operated
together with the Archangel, used only to strip
enemies of their mobility and combat capability.
204.DSC2:
A mobile suit developed by ZAFT near the end of the
previous war and entrusted to Kira by Lacus. It was
heavily damaged during the final battle of that war
against the Providence Gundam, but was secretly
repaired in Orb and stored deep within an
underground shelter. Although it is an older
machine, it is equipped with a Neutron Jammer
Canceller, the installation of which is now
prohibited on mobile suits. Powered by a nuclear
fusion engine, it has no operational time limit and
possesses performance capable of overwhelming
current-generation units. It was sealed away by
Kira, who did not desire conflict, but he was forced
to pilot it to protect Lacus and those around him
from an assassination squad. Thereafter, it
accompanied the Archangel, and was used solely to
reduce the mobility and offensive capability of
opponents. It was defeated and destroyed beyond
recognition by Shinn, who, burning with rage over
Stella's death, launched unpredictable multi-layered
attacks.

205.DSCR:
The most advanced mobile suit, developed alongside
the Infinite Justice Gundam at the 'Factory,' the
base of the anti-Durandal Clyne Faction.
 It has a gold frame housing a new type of power
plant, the laser fusion engine, giving it output
several times that of the Freedom Gundam. Its newly
added 'Super DRAGOON Mobile Weapon System' allows
the mobility-enhancing wing sections to detach and
be used as wirelessly guided beam weapons. In its
first sortie, it made a spectacular debut using this
new weapon, disabling a combined total of
twenty-five ZAKUs and GOUFs in just two minutes.
 Its armor has also been changed to VPS Armor, and
it even has a built-in beam shield, making it a unit
with no weak point to exploit in either offense or
defense. If it has any single flaw, it is that its
performance is so high that no one but Kira can
handle it.
 Its official name is 'Strike Freedom Gundam,' but
Kira consistently called it simply 'Freedom.'
205.DSC2:
A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed alongside
the Infinite Justice Gundam at the 'Factory,' a
stronghold of the Clyne faction opposing Durandal.
It features a gold frame and mounts a new laser
nuclear fusion engine, boasting several times the
output of the Freedom Gundam. The newly equipped
'Super Dragoon Mobile Weapon System' allows the wing
components, which enhance mobility, to separate and
be used as wire-guided beam weapons. In its first
sortie, it made a brilliant debut by using this new
weapon to disable a total of 25 Zaku and GOUF
units in just two minutes. Its armor has also been
changed to VPS Armor, and it even incorporates a
beam shield, making it a machine with no gaps in
offense or defense. If there is a single drawback,
it is that its performance is so high that no one
other than Kira can handle it. Its official
designation is 'Strike Freedom Gundam,' but Kira
consistently called it 'Freedom.' Unlike the
Freedom Gundam, which was heavily damaged at the end
of the previous war, this unit finished the conflict
in near-perfect condition. It is a main unit more
deserving of the title than the one that bears the
program's name in its invincibility.

206.DSCR:
The most advanced mobile suit, developed alongside
the Strike Freedom Gundam at the 'Factory,' the base
of the anti-Durandal Clyne Faction.
 An evolution of the Justice Gundam that Athrun
piloted during the previous war, it also
incorporates technology from ZAFT's 'Second Stage
Series.' It carries a laser fusion engine within a
silver frame, and its greatest feature, the combined
thruster-and-weapon unit 'Fatum-01,' has also
received major reinforcement and improvement.
 Both the unit itself and Fatum-01 are equipped
with numerous close-quarters melee weapons, and when
used as an assault weapon it dealt a fatal blow to
the Minerva's propulsion system. In the final
battle it was used against the interior of Requiem,
successfully destroying it.
206.DSC2:
The latest mobile suit developed at the 'Factory',
the stronghold of the Clyne faction opposing
Durandal, alongside the Strike Freedom Gundam. It
is a development of the Justice Gundam that Athrun
piloted in the previous war, and incorporates
technology from ZAFT's 'Second Stage Series'. It is
equipped with a laser nuclear fusion engine in its
silver frame, and its signature thruster and
armament unit, the 'Fatum-01', has been greatly
enhanced and improved. The main body is loaded with
numerous melee weapons, and in its use as a shock
weapon it dealt fatal damage to the Minerva's
propulsion system. In the final battle, it was used
inside Requiem and succeeded in destroying it.
Unlike the Justice Gundam, which left no prototype
after being self-destructed in the previous war,
this unit finished the fight in almost perfect
condition except for the 'Fatum-01'. Perhaps this
too is an indicator of Athrun's growth.

207.DSCR:
A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
Orb's former Chief Representative.
 Development had been underway since the previous
war, but because the latest technology was
incorporated at every stage, it was ultimately
completed as a high-performance unit that rivals
current-generation mobile suits.
 The Oowashi (Golden Eagle) Equipment is optimized
for operation within the atmosphere, with an
attached flight unit enabling independent flight.
High-energy beam cannons mounted on either side give
it strong long-range attack capability.
 Its dazzling golden body is the 'Yatanokagami,' an
anti-beam defense and reflection system that absorbs
beams fired at the unit, locks onto the attacking
enemy, and reflects the beam back at them. This
grants it high defensive power as well as the
ability to turn an opponent's own attack directly
into a counterattack. However, it has the weakness
of being unable to fully guard against solid
projectile weapons.
207.DSC2:
A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
former representative of Orb. Development had
progressed since the previous war, but because the
latest technology was incorporated each time, it was
completed as a high-performance machine rivaling
current mobile suits. The Oowashi pack is
specialized for use in the atmosphere, and with its
equipped flight unit it can fly independently. It
carries high-energy beam cannons on both sides,
giving it high long-range attack capabilities. Its
dazzling gold body is the anti-beam defense and
reflection system 'Yatanokagami', which absorbs
beams fired at the unit and reflects them after
locking onto the enemy. This provides high
defensive power and allows the enemy's attacks to be
used for counterattacks. However, it cannot fully
block physical weapons, so when hit by the Destiny
Gundam's Flash Edge 2, its left arm was severed.

208.DSCR:
A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
Orb's former Chief Representative.
 When it was taken up into space, Neo took over as
pilot in place of Cagalli, who had to remain in
Orb.
 The Shiranui Equipment is optimized for operation
in space, and its greatest feature is the 'Guided
Mobile Beam Turret System,' an adaptation of the
DRAGOON System designed so that anyone can use it.
Neo, who already possessed superior spatial
awareness, handled it with complete freedom - on
offense, destroying numerous enemy mobile suits at
once, and on defense, linking the beam turrets
together to form a barrier.
208.DSC2:
A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
former representative of Orb. When going into
space, Neo (Mu), taking over for Cagalli who had to
remain in Orb, became its pilot. The Shiranui pack
is specialized for space use, and its greatest
feature is the 'Guided Mobile Beam Turret System',
an improvement on the DRAGOON system that anyone can
use. Neo (Mu), who originally had excellent spatial
awareness, used it freely, destroying many enemy
mobile suits at once on offense and deploying
barriers by linking the beam turrets on defense. In
the final battle, he thrust his machine between the
Archangel's bridge and an incoming barrage. In the
same situation during the previous war, the unit was
destroyed while stopping the attack, but at this
second opportunity, he succeeded in enduring it.

209.DSCR:
Orb's next-generation mass-production mobile suit,
developed by Morgenroete. It is the successor to
the M1 Astray and retains traces of its
predecessor's design in the shape of its head.
 Designed with carrier-based operation in mind, it
can take either a general-purpose mobile suit form
or a high-mobility fighter jet form. Despite being
a mass-production unit, its base performance is by
no means low, and it is a well-balanced machine
overall. Thanks to the resolve and unity of the Orb
forces, it performed beyond its specifications.
209.DSC2:
The next-generation mass-produced mobile suit of
the Orb military, developed at Morgenroete. It is
the successor to the M1 Astray, and its heritage
can be seen in the design of its head. As it is
intended for carrier operations, it can take a
general-purpose mobile suit form and a high-mobility
fighter form. Although it is a mass-produced unit,
its basic performance is by no means low, and it is
a well-balanced machine overall. Through the
determination and unity of the Orb military, it
performed beyond its specs, cornering the Minerva
and shooting down the Chaos Gundam.

210.DSCR:
Andrew Waltfeld's personal Murasame.
 It is distinguished by its yellow coloring, though
its performance is the same as a standard unit.
 It sortied in the Battle of the Dardanelles Strait,
where Waltfeld, quipping "I'm not as good as Kira,"
shot down numerous Murasames with it.
210.DSC2:
A Murasame customized for Andrew Waltfeld. Its
yellow coloring is distinctive, but the machine's
performance is the same as the standard units. It
sortied in the Battle of the Dardanelles, and
Waltfeld, who claimed to be 'not as skilled as
Kira', shot down many Murasames. After Waltfeld
returned to the Eternal, Kisaka took his place and
sortied in the Orb defense battle.

211.DSCR:
A prototype mobile armor developed by the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 Its crab-like silhouette and sheer size overwhelm
anyone who faces it. Indeed, the Minerva's bridge
crew - Arthur in particular - were considerably
shaken the first time they laid eyes on it.
 It possesses mobility unimaginable for its massive
frame, and can attack in all directions using its
claws and beam cannons. It is also a formidable
unit capable of deploying a positron reflector on
its front to bounce back even the Minerva's
Tannhauser cannon. However, to make full use of its
capabilities, it requires a crew of three - a
captain, a helmsman, and a gunner.
211.DSC2:
Zamza-Zah was a prototype mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance. Its crab-like silhouette and
enormous size gave those who faced it an
overwhelming sense of intimidation. In fact, the
Minerva's bridge crew, especially Arthur, were quite
shocked upon seeing it for the first time. Despite
its massive frame, it possessed unexpected mobility
and could attack in all directions with its claws
and beam cannons. Furthermore, it could deploy
positron reflectors on its front and was a powerful
unit capable of repelling even the Minerva's
Tannhauser. However, to make full use of its
performance, it required three crew members: a
commander, a helmsman, and a gunner, in addition to
the pilot. The initial type deployed pushed the
Impulse Gundam to the brink of being shot down, but
that became the trigger for Shinn's SEED to awaken.
It was overwhelmed by his dramatically improved
movements after the awakening and was ultimately
pierced through the cockpit and destroyed.

212.DSCR:
A prototype developed by the Earth Alliance,
combining the upper body of a mobile suit (a Strike
Dagger) with the lower body of a mobile armor.
 Its Positron Reflector grants it high defensive
power, and it was deployed mainly for base defense.
Unlike the Positron Reflector used by the Zamza-Zah,
this one deploys to the front, allowing for quick
switching between offense and defense.
 It also carries a wide array of ranged weapons,
making it unmatched in long-range combat.
212.DSC2:
Gells-Ghe was a prototype unit developed by the
Earth Alliance that possessed the upper body of a
mobile suit, the Strike Dagger, and the lower body
of a mobile armor. It boasted high defensive
capabilities thanks to its positron reflector, which
was primarily deployed for base defense. Unlike the
Zamza-Zah's reflector, its positron reflector was
deployed toward the front, allowing for rapid
switching between offense and defense. It was also
well-armed with ranged weapons and displayed
unmatched strength in long-range combat. However,
on the other hand, it could not adequately respond
to close-quarters combat, and after being closed in
on by the Saviour Gundam, it was easily shot down.

213.DSCR:
A mass-produced giant mobile armor developed by the
Earth Alliance.
 It lacks the visual impact of the Zamza-Zah or
Gells-Ghe, but its large beam cannon and Positron
Reflector give it a good balance of offense and
defense, along with excellent mobility. However, it
carries no armament suited for close combat, leaving
it weak at close range.
213.DSC2:
A mass-produced giant mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance.
 It lacks the visual impact of the Zamza-Zah or
Gells-Ghe, but its large beam cannon and Positron
Reflector give it a good balance of offense and
defense, along with excellent mobility. However,
it carries no armament suited for close combat,
leaving it weak at close range.

214.DSCR:
A giant mobile suit that the Earth Alliance and
LOGOS had developed by Adukarf Mechano-Industry.
The listed overall length covers only the unit
itself; including the back-mounted weapons unit,
its size exceeds 50 meters.
 The overwhelming firepower of its numerous
full-body armaments, its thick armor, and the
Positron Reflectors mounted on both arms let it
maintain a high standard of both offense and
defense. In its mobile armor mode, in which the
back-mounted weapons unit covers the upper body, it
is also capable of low-altitude flight.
 It is a machine exclusive to Extended pilots.
Stellar boarded the first unit built and engulfed
cities across western Eurasia, including Berlin, in
flame. The five units built afterward were
committed to the battle at Heaven's Base, where
Sting and others piloted them and inflicted massive
damage on the ZAFT fleet.
214.DSC2:
The Destroy Gundam was a massive mobile suit
developed by the Earth Alliance and LOGOS at the
Adukaf Mechano Industries company. Its stated total
length covered only the main unit, and including the
rear weapon unit, its size exceeded fifty meters.
It maintained a high standard in both offense and
defense through the overwhelming firepower of its
numerous weapons mounted across its body, thick
armor, and the positron reflectors equipped on both
arms. In its mobile armor form, where the rear
weapon unit covered its upper body, it was also
capable of low-altitude flight. It was a unit
designed exclusively for Extenders, and Stella
piloted the initial production model, engulfing
cities across western Eurasia, including Berlin, in
flames. The five units produced afterward were
deployed in the battle at Heaven's Base, where Sting
and the others piloted them and inflicted tremendous
damage on the ZAFT fleet. However, all units were
destroyed through the combined efforts of Shinn,
Ray, and Lunamaria.

215.DSCR:
ZAFT's newest warship, built to operate and
coordinate with the 'Second Stage Series' units. It
is equipped with catapults compatible with the
Silhouette System and a Deuterion beam transmission
system.
 It can move at high speed regardless of
environment, whether in space, on land, or at sea.
Its armament is equally abundant: the positron
cannon 'Tannhauser', beam cannons, solid rounds,
Gatling cannons, and a wide variety of missiles for
space, ground, interception, and torpedo use, among
a great deal more. In addition, the bridge -
traditionally a warship's greatest weakness - is
shielded during combat, making this an all-purpose
warship that can fight without worry.
215.DSC2:
The Minerva was the latest ZAFT warship built with
the goal of operating and coordinating the Second
Stage Series units. It was equipped with a catapult
compatible with the Silhouette System and the
Deuterion Beam transmission system. It could move
at high speed regardless of location, whether in
space, on the ground, or at sea. Its armaments were
also abundant, including positron cannons, beam
cannons, solid rounds, gatling cannons, and various
missiles for space, ground, anti-aircraft, and
torpedo purposes. Moreover, the bridge, which had
been a warship's greatest weakness, was shielded
during combat, making it an all-purpose battleship
that could head into battle without concern.
Although it set sail without a proper launching
ceremony, it continued to achieve significant
results in various locations even before the war
began, making its name famous as ZAFT's strongest
force. However, during the final battle at Messiah,
it was defeated by the Archangel and rendered
combat-incapable.

216.DSCR:
A special warship operated by Phantom Pain, a
special forces unit of the Earth Alliance. Talia
referred to it as 'Bogey One' during pursuit.
 It is equipped with Mirage Colloid, banned by
treaty, and excels at stealth operations using it.
The ship also contains a maintenance room for
Extended pilots, allowing mental conditioning and
memory manipulation to be carried out at any time.
 It was used in the seizure of the new Gundams at
Armory One, and fulfilled that role admirably.
216.DSC2:
The Girty Lue was a special warship operated by
Phantom Pain, a special forces unit of the Earth
Alliance. Talia referred to it as Bogey One during
the pursuit. It was equipped with Mirage Colloid,
which was prohibited by treaty, and excelled in
stealth operations using it. The ship also
contained a maintenance room for Extenders, where
psychological adjustments and memory manipulation
could be performed at any time. It was used to
seize the new Gundams at Armory One and fulfilled
that role perfectly. It was also used when Djibril
escaped from the Daedalus base on the Moon, but its
bridge was crushed by the Legend Gundam's Beam
Spike, and the ship was sunk.

217.DSCR:
A special assault carrier built for mobile suit
operations, constructed at the neutral colony
Heliopolis by Orb's Morgenroete at the request of
the Atlantic Federation during the previous war.
 After the previous war ended, it was repaired with
Cagalli's support and hidden on the seabed off Orb.
But with the return of a chaotic era, its former
crew were gathered once more and it took to the
skies again. At the time, Murrue - with the
battle-hardened veteran Waltfeld aboard - proposed
giving up the captain's seat, but in the end the
entire bridge crew agreed that Murrue should remain
in command.
 Equipped with Laminated Armor, positron cannons,
and numerous other powerful systems, it still
displays high combat capability even two years after
its construction. Its appearance has changed
little, but it has gained submersion capability and
had its various electronic systems upgraded. Living
conditions aboard have also been improved, the
crowning example being, of all things, a hot
spring. One cannot help but wonder what would
happen if it attempted another barrel roll in its
current state.
217.DSC2:
A special assault carrier built for mobile suit
operations, constructed at the neutral colony

 After the previous war ended, it was repaired

Living conditions aboard have also been improved,

current state.

218.DSCR:
A ZAFT-developed ship dedicated to operating the
Freedom Gundam and Justice Gundam. Many former ZAFT
crew members are aboard, including Lacus, the symbol
of the Clyne Faction, Captain Waltfeld, and Dacosta
and Meyrin.
 Though it is outgunned by the Archangel, it
possesses enough speed to easily outrun ZAFT's fast
Nazca-class ships. It also carries the Freedom
Gundam and Justice Gundam's weapons unit, the
'Meteor', mounted on its bow; the unit detaches
when the two Gundams make use of it, but otherwise
serves as a gun battery.
218.DSC2:
A ZAFT-developed ship dedicated to operating the
Freedom Gundam and Justice Gundam. Many former
ZAFT crew members are aboard, including Lacus, the
symbol of the Clyne Faction, Captain Waltfeld, and

 Though it is outgunned by the Archangel, it

otherwise serves as a gun battery.

219.DSCR:
A high-speed combat vessel of ZAFT.
 A considerable number have been deployed since the
previous war, with emphasis placed on mobility and
mobile suit operation rather than firepower.
 The Voltaire, flagship of the Joule Team led by
Yzak, is also a Nazca-class vessel.
219.DSC2:
A high-speed combat vessel of ZAFT.
 A considerable number have been deployed since
the previous war, with emphasis placed on mobility
and mobile suit operation rather than firepower.
 The Voltaire, flagship of the Joule Team led by
Yzak, is also a Nazca-class vessel.

220.DSCR:
A large space carrier of ZAFT, the Gondwana-class.
 Equipped with four mobile suit decks, sixteen
catapults, and mobility sufficient for fleet
operations, it is the ship that forms the core of
ZAFT's space combat forces.
220.DSC2:
A large space carrier of ZAFT, the
Gondwana-class.
 Equipped with four mobile suit decks, sixteen
catapults, and mobility sufficient for fleet
operations, it is the ship that forms the core of
ZAFT's space combat forces.

221.DSCR:
A small space warship of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally an escort vessel, it was refitted into a
mobile-suit carrier by adding catapults and a
hangar, and now serves a wide variety of purposes.
 Variants equipped with a reflector shield on the
bow have also been confirmed.
221.DSC2:
A small space warship of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally an escort vessel, it was refitted into
a mobile-suit carrier by adding catapults and a
hangar, and now serves a wide variety of purposes.
 Variants equipped with a reflector shield on the
bow have also been confirmed.

222.DSCR:
A space carrier of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally designed as a carrier for mobile armors,
it boasts one of the largest mobile suit capacities
among all ships in Alliance service.
222.DSC2:
A space carrier of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally designed as a carrier for mobile
armors, it boasts one of the largest mobile suit
capacities among all ships in Alliance service.

223.DSCR:
An Overman that Duke Medaille kept hidden at Dome
Polis Ulgusk, disguised as a work of art.
 When Gainer activated it, he combined his own name
with the title 'King', earned as a game champion, to
name it 'King Gainer'.
 Its weapons include the Chain Gun, usable as both a
sword and a gun; the Needler, wielded like a
dagger; and buckshot grenades that scatter numerous
bomblets. Spare units of each are carried in a
pouch on the left thigh, allowing it to fight
dual-wielding two Chain Guns, among other tactics.
 Its Over Skill, 'Acceleration', lets it move at
such tremendous speed that it leaves afterimages.
223.DSC2:
At Domepolis Urgusk, this Overman was stored by
Duke Medaille under the guise of an art object.
 The Gainer who activated it combined the game
champion title 'King' with his own name to call it
'King Gainer'.
 Its weapons include the Chengan, which can be used
as both a sword and a gun, the Needler wielded like
a dagger, and scatter grenades that release large
numbers of bombs. Spare rounds for each are kept in
the pouch on its left thigh, allowing tactics such
as dual-wielding two Chengan blades.
 With the Over Skill 'Acceleration', it could move
at super speed that created afterimages, but this
was only a fraction of its power.
 In the battle against the fully awakened Overdevil,
King Gainer activated its true Over Skills: 'Over
Freeze' (the cessation of all motion, the same
ability as the Overdevil) and its opposite, 'Over
Heat' (the activation of all motion). It drove off
the Overdevil with these. Because of this ability,
it is speculated that King Gainer may be an Overman
created as a servant of the Overdevil, or as one
designed to oppose the Overdevil.

224.DSCR:
A Silhouette Machine used by the Gauli Squad.
 Operated with defense rather than offense as its
purpose, it is unusual among both Overmen and
Silhouette Machines in carrying a shield, giving it
high defensive performance.
 It mounts a 12.7mm machine gun on its body and
carries a 60mm Rivet Gun as a handheld weapon.
Though it lacks a decisive finishing blow, its
well-balanced overall performance makes it seem
quite easy to handle.
 Later, Mamadou developed an anti-Silhouette Machine
weapon that uses electromagnetic waves to interfere
with the startup of Muscle Engines, giving the
Panther more opportunities to shine offensively as
well.

A Silhouette Machine used by the Gauli Squad.

225.DSCR:
A Silhouette Machine piloted by Gain.
 It was developed with sniping in mind, using a
76mm rapid-fire cannon with excellent range and
power. Its mobility allows it to fire while on the
move, quickly relocate to terrain suited for
sniping, and brace itself on both arms to serve as a
fixed gun platform.
 Its eye-catching, oversized left arm belongs to the
legendary Early Overman, Brunhilde, granting it
monstrous strength that surpasses even other
Overmen.
225.DSC2:
A silhouette machine piloted by Gain.
 It was developed with precision sniping in mind
using its 76mm rapid-fire cannon, which is
impeccable in both range and power, and it could
fire while moving using its mobility, move quickly
to terrain suited for sniping, or support its body
with both arms to serve as a fixed gun emplacement.
 Its eye-catching large left arm comes from the
legendary early Overman Brunhilde. For this reason,
it boasts monstrous strength that even surpasses
that of an Overman.
 When it was attacked by the Desert Netta, Gauli
sortied alone in it and was absorbed, resulting in
it being caught in the self-destruction and heavily
damaged. Even then, the left arm remained
unscathed.

226.DSCR:
A patchwork Overman assembled by combining Gachiko
with parts from various other Overmen.
 Its name carries on that of an Overman Gain once
used as his personal machine, and is thought to
contain the meaning of 'Emperor'.
 Its main armament is a 76mm rapid-fire cannon and
the Brunhilde left arm carried over from Gachiko.
That arm in particular has had its abilities
analyzed and properly reconnected, making the
'Gravity' Over Skill usable.
226.DSC2:
A patchwork Overman built by combining Gachiko with
parts from various other Overmen.
 Its name carries on from the Overman Gain once used
as his beloved machine. It is thought to contain
the meaning 'Emperor'.
 Its main armaments are a 76mm rapid-fire cannon
and Brunhilde's left arm reused from Gachiko. In
particular, with the left arm, because its abilities
had been analyzed and properly connected, the Over
Skill 'Gravity' became usable.
 In the battle against the Overdevil, it donned
Planeta's coat and worked to persuade Gainer.
However, before achieving its goal, it was pierced
by a spear of ice and fell.

227.DSCR:
The Siberian Railway Guard's mainstay Silhouette
Machine.
 Designed primarily to chase down People, it
emphasizes mobility with features such as hover
locomotion and lightweight armor.
 However, it has many operational shortcomings, such
as poor durability and the need for two operators -
one for weapons control and one for mobility.
Because of this, the Dobeck was later developed as a
successor.

228.DSCR:
An upgraded Silhouette Machine based on the
Dogozzo.
 Though its mobility falls short of the Dogozzo's,
nearly all of the earlier machine's shortcomings
have been improved, including increased armor and
firepower and a switch to single-seat operation.
 A transformation mechanism also lets it switch
between a normal 'Turtle Mode' with its upper
section closed and a firing mode with the upper
section deployed for its 200mm rocket-assisted
cannon.
 After Adette stole a large number of units from the
Siberian Railway Guard's secret base, the Dobeck
Squad that was originally meant to be formed and
deployed had its scale drastically reduced.
 Units belonging to the Siberian Railway Guard are
painted light blue.

229.DSCR:
A Silhouette Machine upgraded from the Dogozzo.
 Procured as a fighting force by Adette, who became
the leader of a vigilante group formed by the People
of Dome Polis Gangaran.
 The unit Adette pilots is a high-performance
variant with improvements such as hover boosters,
and is colored red.
229.DSC2:
A Silhouette Machine upgraded from the Dogozzo.
 Procured as a fighting force by Adette, who
became the leader of a vigilante group formed by
the People of Dome Polis Gangaran.
 The unit Adette pilots is a high-performance
variant with improvements such as hover boosters,
and is colored red.

230.DSCR:
A Silhouette Machine that is an upgraded version of
the Dogozzo.
 Procured by Adette, who became the leader of a
vigilante group formed by the People of Dome Polis
Gangaran, to serve as its fighting force.
 The performance of the units piloted by members of
Adette's squad remains unchanged from the time of
procurement, but their color has been changed to
dark green.
230.DSC2:
A Silhouette Machine that is an upgraded version
of the Dogozzo.
 Procured by Adette, who became the leader of a

 The performance of the units piloted by members

231.DSCR:
An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its Over Skill, 'Time Stop', halts the passage of
time for anything touched by the Stop Beam fired
from its hand. Yassaba wielded this Over Skill with
great skill, using it to stop bullets fired at
himself, to freeze weather phenomena like storms or
avalanches on snowy mountains in order to lure
enemies in, and to release the stop effect at the
perfect moment to create an opening. Wearing a
dedicated Stop Coat allows it to fire the Stop Beam
over an even wider area.
 Attacks from the four twin-barrel launchers mounted
on both hands and the superheated flamethrower
'Bellows' drove King Gainer into a desperate
situation.
231.DSC2:
An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its Over Skill 'Time Stop' stops the time of
anything touched by the stop beam released from its
hands. Yassaba used this Over Skill skillfully,
such as stopping bullets fired at it, halting
weather phenomena like storms or avalanches on snowy
mountains to guide enemies, and releasing the stop
at an exquisite timing to create openings. By
wearing a special stop coat, it could release the
stop beam over a wider area.
 It cornered King Gainer with attacks from four twin
launchers on both hands and the ultra-high-heat
flamethrower 'Bellows', but a single bullet fired by
Gain proved decisive, and it was defeated. After
coming into the hands of Yapan's Ceiling, it seems
to have been used as repair parts for King Gainer.

232.DSCR:
A mass-produced Overman of Saint Reigan, and a
simplified version of the Golem. Its distinctive
flight form, sitting cross-legged, resembles a great
Buddha statue.
 Being a simplified model, its appearance seems
poorer than the Golem's, but its powerful Over
Skill, 'Shockwave', lets a pair of units combine to
unleash an ultra-vibration shockwave called the
'Mach Band Shaker'.
 Since it cannot use its Over Skill alone, it is
clear that this machine only shows its true worth
when operated in numbers.
232.DSC2:
A mass-produced Overman of Saint Reigan, and a
simplified version of the Golem. Its distinctive
flight form, sitting cross-legged, resembles a
great Buddha statue.
 Being a simplified model, its appearance seems
poorer than the Golem's, but its powerful Over
Skill, 'Shockwave', lets a pair of units combine
to unleash an ultra-vibration shockwave called the
'Mach Band Shaker'.
 Since it cannot use its Over Skill alone, it is
clear that this machine only shows its true worth
when operated in numbers.

233.DSCR:
An Overman used by Saint Reigan.
 It possesses the Over Skill 'Hardening', which can
dramatically increase the strength of its full-body
armor.
 A pure combat type equipped with two Hand Guns and
a chakram-like Disc Harpoon. The Disc Harpoon is a
versatile weapon that can change size, extend spikes
to increase its power, and even be used as a
close-combat weapon. It can also make use of an
anti-Overman rifle.
 Wearing a Power Coat unlocks the 'Superhuman
Strength' Over Skill, power strong enough to lift
the ceiling of Yapan. However, it was discovered to
hinder mobility and close-combat capability, and was
eventually cast off mid-battle.
233.DSC2:
An Overman used by Saint Reigan.
 It possesses the Over Skill 'Hardening', which
can dramatically increase the strength of its
full-body armor.
 A pure combat type equipped with two Hand Guns
and a chakram-like Disc Harpoon. The Disc Harpoon
is a versatile weapon that can change size, extend
spikes to increase its power, and even be used as
a close-combat weapon. It can also make use of an
anti-Overman rifle.
 Wearing a Power Coat unlocks the 'Superhuman
Strength' Over Skill, power strong enough to lift
the ceiling of Yapan. However, it was discovered
to hinder mobility and close-combat capability,
and was eventually cast off mid-battle.

234.DSCR:
An Overman owned by the Siberian Railway Guard,
referred to together with Desnetta Lionnetter as a
'Psycho Overman'.
 Its Over Skill, 'Mind Voice', can release a
person's surface thoughts as speech, leaving their
mind's contents laid bare to everyone around them.
Kashmar used this to instigate conflict between the
ceiling of Yapan and the People of Gangaran.
 In combat, it also demonstrated the offensive use
of reading an enemy's thoughts in advance, showing
combat ability high enough to fend off attacks even
from Gain and Gainer working together.
234.DSC2:
An Overman owned by the Siberian Railway Guard,
also called a Psycho Overman together with the
Desert Netta and Lion Netta.
 The Over Skill 'Telepathy' releases a person's
surface consciousness as a voice, so one's thoughts
become openly known to those around. Kashmar used
this to incite conflict between Yapan's Ceiling and
the people of Gangaran.
 In combat, it also used the ability offensively to
read the enemy's thoughts beforehand, displaying
combat prowess that even Gain and Gainer together
could not penetrate with their attacks. However,
when Gainer focused all his nerves on exposing his
feelings for Sara, Kashmar lost concentration and
stopped the Over Skill. King Gainer exploited that
opening and destroyed it.
 When Gainer used Over Freeze, Gain draped Planeta's
coat over the Emperanza, and it served the role of
conveying everyone's inner voices.

235.DSCR:
An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its only real weapon is an electric shock orb fired
from its whisker-like appendages, but it possesses
the Over Skill 'Illusion', which conjures up
whatever false images the pilot wishes one after
another. This lets it appear to split into multiple
copies of itself, or project phantom images to
confuse the enemy.
235.DSC2:
An Overman used by the Siberian Railway Guard. Its
main weapon is only an electric shock ball fired
from its beard-like parts, but it possesses the Over
Skill 'Phantom', which creates one illusion after
another as desired by the pilot. With this, it
could appear to divide itself, or project phantoms
to confuse enemies. Kejinan used this not only to
put on a comedy typical of him, but also to corner
King Gainer at one point. However, because the
illusions were annihilated at a speed faster than
they could be created, the main body was exposed and
destroyed.

236.DSCR:
An Overman with the Over Skill 'Theft', capable of
stealing any matter, regardless of size, across
space.
 Its original owner was Duke Pirwitz, lord of
Polichev, but Asuham made blackmail-like demands to
seize it in what amounted to theft - a fitting
origin, given the machine's own ability.
 In battle it stole a Rivet Gun from the Panther,
and even stole bullets and the artificial muscle
from King Gainer's shoulder.
236.DSC2:
An Overman possessing the Over Skill 'Theft', which
could steal any substance, regardless of size,
across space. Its original owner was Duke Pilwitz,
the lord of Policev, but Asuham took it over in a
near-theft manner with extortionate demands, and it
can be said that its origin was fitting for such an
ability. In battle, it stole a rivet gun from
Panther, and even stole bullets and the artificial
muscles of the shoulders from King Gainer, but it
could not steal Anna's heart and tears. Then
Asuham, who was too fixated on Gain, was left open,
and the unit was defeated by King Gainer.

237.DSCR:
An Overman given by Overdevil to Sara after she was
Over Frozen by Gainer.
 Having gained the Over Skill 'Theft', which can
steal any matter across space, Sara attempted to
steal the very lives of the ceiling of Yapan.
237.DSC2:
An Overman given by the Overdevil to Sara, who had
been Over Frozen. Sara, gaining the Over Skill
'Theft', which could steal any substance across
space, attempted to steal the lives of the leaders
of Yapan. However, she was stopped by Adette's
Dobeck, had the pouch that was the source of her
Over Skill destroyed, and was shot down.

238.DSCR:
An Early Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 It possesses the Over Skill 'Change', which lets it
curl into a sphere, transform parts of its body into
a sword or shield, increase its own volume, and even
fire off that increased volume as projectiles - a
truly anything-goes versatility.
 Combined with the astonishing ability of its pilot,
Cynthia, it demonstrated performance powerful enough
to single-handedly wipe out Saint Reigan's Asuham
Boone special forces unit.
238.DSC2:
An Early Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard. It
possessed the Over Skill 'Change', and could become
spherical, change parts of its body into swords or
shields, and also increase its volume or fire the
increased volume outward as projectiles, showing off
a transformative versatility that allowed almost
anything. Thanks to the extraordinary ability of
its pilot, Cynthia, it demonstrated enough
performance to annihilate the Asuham Boone special
forces unit of St. Reigan with a single unit.
After Cynthia withdrew with wounds to her heart,
Asuham piloted it, and a second unit that Kids had
hidden also appeared.

239.DSCR:
A mass-produced Overman based on the Dominator.
 Though simplified, it retains transformation
capability and can also use the Over Skill 'Shock'.
 It was deployed to the Kids Munt royal guard.
239.DSC2:
A mass-production type Overman based on the
Dominator. Although simplified, it retains
transformation capabilities and can also use the
Over Skill 'Electric Shock'. Deployed to the Kids
Munto guard corps, it fought against the Overdevil
and King Gainer, but almost all units were shot
down.

240.DSCR:
A mysterious being said to have been sealed away by
the first Miia.
 It possesses a will of its own, and holds the
hidden ability to open the ice gate known as the
'Icing Gate'.
 Its body had been broken apart into separate
pieces, but Kids, upon learning of its existence,
secretly gathered them within the Agato Crystal.
 Its Over Skill, 'Over Freeze', is a terrifying
ability that halts not only the movement of matter,
but also growth, evolution, portions of emotion such
as conscience, and even black holes - stopping
anything, tangible or intangible, without
exception.
240.DSC2:
Overdevil is a mysterious being said to have been
sealed by the first Miiya. It possesses its own
will and holds the ability to open the ice gate
known as the 'Icing Gate.' Though its body parts
had been scattered, they were secretly gathered and
stored inside a crystal of Agato by Kids, who had
learned of its existence. Its Over Skill, 'Over
Freeze,' is a terrifying ability that halts not only
the movement of matter but also growth, evolution,
conscience, and other emotions, and even a black
hole - stopping anything, tangible or intangible,
without exception. With this power, it manipulated
the hearts of Cynthia and Gainer, using them as
pawns, and brought the world to the brink of
freezing. However, its body was pierced by the Over
Heat of King Gainer, piloted by Gainer after he
broke free from its control, and it fell to the
earth as rain.

241.DSCR:
The form Gainer took after being Over Frozen,
growing to giant size and becoming an Overman.
 What Gainer wears is the Overcoat of the Overman
Black Mail, a machine that never appeared in the
game, materialized by Overdevil.
241.DSC2:
The form Gainer took after being Over Frozen,
growing to giant size and becoming an Overman.
 What Gainer wears is the Overcoat of the Overman
Black Mail, a machine that never appeared in the
game, materialized by Overdevil.

242.DSCR:
A black Megadeus piloted by Roger Smith.
 When Roger shouts, "Big O, Showtime" into the
wristwatch on his left arm, it rises from
underground to stand against the enemy at his side.
 When Roger boards it, the words "CAST IN THE NAME
OF GOD, YE NOT GUILTY" are displayed on the front
monitor.
 It is normally housed beneath Roger's mansion. But
once Roger issues the call, it races through disused
underground transit lines aboard its dedicated
transporter, the 'Prairie Dog', and is carried to
its destination.
 It conceals built-in weapons such as the eye beam
'Arc Line' and the 'Cannon Party' and 'Missile
Party' fired from its chest and abdomen, but its
ultimate finishing move is the one-hit-kill strike
'Sudden Impact', delivered by driving its arm's
Strike Pile into the target.
 From time to time, Big O has taken independent
action as though possessed of its own will. When,
where, and by whom Big O was built - not even Roger,
its own pilot, knows the answer.
242.DSC2:
Big O is a black Megadeus piloted by Roger Smith.
It appears from underground when Roger shouts 'Big
O, Showtime' into the wristwatch on his left arm,
and stands against enemies alongside him. When
Roger is aboard, the front monitor displays the
spell 'CAST IN THE NAME OF GOD, YE NOT GUILTY.'
Normally, it is housed beneath Roger's mansion. But
once summoned by Roger, it races through disused
underground transit systems via the dedicated
transporter 'Prairie Dog' to its destination. It is
armed with internal weapons such as the eye-beam
'Arc Line' and the chest and abdomen-launched
'Cannon Party' and 'Missile Party,' but its greatest
finishing move is 'Sudden Impact,' a one-hit killing
blow that drives the arm's strike pile into the
foe. The three units Big O, Big Duo, and Big Fau
are beings called 'The Big'; by appearance, Big O
is called the Black Big, Big Duo the Red Big, and
Big Fau the White Big. In the final phase of the
battle with Big Fau, Dorothy, who functioned as Big
O's interface, caused each part to deploy and fired
a high-output beam from the chest, activating the
ultimate move 'Big O Final Stage.' At times, Big O
acted on its own as if it possessed a will. When,
where, and who manufactured Big O - even Roger, its
pilot, did not know.

243.DSCR:
A bandage-wrapped Megadeus that appeared at the
ruins of John F. Kennedy International Airport.
 It controls the bandages covering its body and
fires a beam from its eyes.
 It bound Big O with its bandages, but was engulfed
in flame after taking a direct hit from a missile
fired by Big O.
243.DSC2:
Mummy is a bandaged Megadeus that appeared at the
site of the former John F. Kennedy International
Airport. It manipulates the bandages covering its
whole body and fires beams from its eyes. It bound
Big O with its bandages, but was hit directly by
missiles fired by Big O and engulfed in flames.
From beneath that blaze, the Red Big - that is, Big
Duo - emerged.

244.DSCR:
A flying red Megadeus discovered by Schwarzwald.
 If Big O is the Big of the land, then Big Duo could
be called the Big of the sky.
 It deploys main wings from both arms, transforms
its four fingers into propellers, and flies using
the afterburners of its powerful engines.
 Its armament includes the eye beam Arc Line,
Gatling missiles fired from its chest, and megaton
missiles stored in both lower legs. It can also
spin its four fingers to grind down an opponent.
244.DSC2:
Big Duo is a flying red Megadeus discovered by
Schwarz. If Big O is the Big of the land, Big Duo
possesses performance that could be called the Big
of the sky. It deploys main wings from both arms,
transforms its four fingers into propellers, and
flies using the afterburner of its powerful
engines. Its armaments include the eye-beam Arc
Line, gatling missiles fired from the chest, and
megaton missiles stored in both lower legs. It can
also rotate its four fingers to grind away the
enemy. When it confronted Big O at the Central
Dome, it tormented Big O with bombing from the air.
However, Roger's quick thinking turned the tables,
and it was destroyed. Afterwards, it reacted to
Dorothy's presence, advancing on its own without a
pilot as if pursuing her, and eventually came to a
halt.

245.DSCR:
The heavily damaged Big Duo, reinforced and
remodeled by Paradigm Corporation's science
division.
 It retains flight capability as before its
remodeling, and now wears a face guard while
flying.
 Beyond its more menacing design, several changes to
its performance can be seen, such as the hollowing
out of its Gatling missile ports. As new weaponry,
its fingers can now transform into knife edges, and
its left eye has been equipped with the Artemis
Arcline.
 Its cockpit employs the same interface-substitution
technology Beck once used, linking Alan into the
machine through countless cables and connectors.
245.DSC2:
Big Duo Inferno is a heavily modified version of
the destroyed Big Duo, rebuilt and enhanced by the
science division of Paradigm Corporation. It can
fly as before the modification, and now wears a face
guard during flight. Not only was its design made
more menacing, but several performance changes were
made, such as hollowed-out gatling missile launch
ports. As new weapons, its fingers can transform
into knife edges, and the left eye is equipped with
an Artemis Arcline. The cockpit uses the interface
substitution technology that Beck employed,
integrating Alan through countless cables and
connectors. As if responding to the will of
Schwarz, who had already lost his body, it began
acting on its own without accepting Alan as its
pilot, absorbed Alan, and vanished into the sky.

246.DSCR:
The white Big, piloted by Alex.
 Discovered in a foreign land with its body
scattered in pieces, Alex requested that the Union
recover it. Its parts were loaded into three
separate Megadeuses, which carried them to Paradigm
City.
 It was assembled at Paradigm Corporation's
underground factory using every technique the
science division could bring to bear, but because
its core memory was missing, it ran amok on its
first outing and fell into malfunction.
 Its weapons include tentacle-like beam cannons
extending from its back, cannon guns that extend
from its shoulders, and the Corkscrew Punch, which
attacks by spinning the rotors on its arms. By
using those rotors as screws, it can also move
freely underwater.
246.DSC2:
A white Big Fau piloted by Alex. It was discovered
in pieces in a foreign land, so Alex asked the Union
to recover it. The parts were loaded onto three
Megadeuses and transported to Paradigm City.
 It was assembled at the Paradigm Corporation's
underground factory using the best technology the
science division had, but because its core memory
was missing, it ran out of control and malfunctioned
during its first battle. However, after the memory
circuit extracted from Dorothy was installed to
serve as the core memory, Alex was able to handle
Big Fau completely.
 Its weapons include a tentacle-like beam cannon
extending from its back, cannons that emerge from
its shoulders, and a corkscrew punch that attacks by
spinning the rotors on its arms. By using the
rotors as screws, it can move freely through the
sea.
 For a time it overwhelmed Big O, but it lost half
its body to the 'Big O Final Stage' and was then
destroyed by the suddenly appearing Big Venus.

247.DSCR:
A Megadeus used by T-Bone and Dove to break Beck
out of prison, also known as 'Super Beck'.
 It was built using Heavy Metal unit parts stolen
from the Wise Company.
 Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides
of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips.
The beam has enough power to cut through the chain
of the Moby Dick anchor, but when it struck Big O's
head crystal, it was deflected.
 It is notable for its fast retreat speed and the
ability to rotate its upper body 180 degrees, a
feature it used to catch Big O off guard on one
occasion.
247.DSC2:
A Megadeus used by T-Bone and Dove to break Beck
out of prison, also known as 'Super Beck'.
 It was built using Heavy Metal unit parts stolen
from the Wise Company.
 Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides
of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips.
The beam has enough power to cut through the chain
of the Moby Dick anchor, but when it struck Big
O's head crystal, it was deflected.
 It is notable for its fast retreat speed and the
ability to rotate its upper body 180 degrees, a
feature it used to catch Big O off guard on one
occasion.

248.DSCR:
A three-unit combining Heavy Metal unit deployed by
Beck, which combines with the shout, "Final
Together!" Beck's sports car, the 'Beck Mobile',
forms the head; Dove's construction vehicle forms
the chest and arms; and T-Bone's trailer forms the
lower body. Beck handled the design, while
Yoshifura Yakamoto Industries handled
manufacturing.
 Its weapon is a crescent-moon-shaped sword formed
by combining the blade-like parts on both shoulders,
engraved at its center with the single character for
'Slash'. It struck a dedicated finishing pose
complete with its own theme music in front of Big O,
but was riddled with holes by the merciless O
Thunder attack and defeated without much of a real
fight.
248.DSC2:
A three-unit combining Heavy Metal unit deployed
by Beck, which combines with the shout, "Final
Together!" Beck's sports car, the 'Beck Mobile',
forms the head; Dove's construction vehicle forms
the chest and arms; and T-Bone's trailer forms the
lower body. Beck handled the design, while
Yoshifura Yakamoto Industries handled
manufacturing.
 Its weapon is a crescent-moon-shaped sword formed
by combining the blade-like parts on both
shoulders, engraved at its center with the single
character for 'Slash'. It struck a dedicated
finishing pose complete with its own theme music
in front of Big O, but was riddled with holes by
the merciless O Thunder attack and defeated
without much of a real fight.

249.DSCR:
The prototype form of a Megadeus, buried deep
within Paradigm City's underground passages in the
ruins of a pavilion-like shrine. It was discovered
by Schwarzwald, who had descended underground in
search of the truth.
 It awakened in response to Dorothy's sudden
appearance before it, and began operating in pursuit
of her memory.
 It toyed with Big O using agile movements and
electric shocks fired from its head, but in the end
was destroyed by a direct hit from Big O's Missile
Party.
249.DSC2:
The prototype form of a Megadeus, buried deep
within Paradigm City's underground passages in the
ruins of a pavilion-like shrine. It was discovered
by Schwarzwald, who had descended underground in
search of the truth.
 It awakened in response to Dorothy's sudden
appearance before it, and began operating in
pursuit of her memory.
 It toyed with Big O using agile movements and
electric shocks fired from its head, but in the
end was destroyed by a direct hit from Big O's
Missile Party.

250.DSCR:
A form created by combining six parts taken from
three foreign Megadeuses that had been destroyed by
Big O.
 The Union revived it as a warning directed at
Alex.
 After one-sidedly attacking the disabled Big O, it
attempted to bring down Paradigm Corporation's
headquarters, but was destroyed by Big Fau, piloted
by Alex.
250.DSC2:
A form created by combining six parts taken from
three foreign Megadeuses that had been destroyed
by Big O.
 The Union revived it as a warning directed at
Alex.
 After one-sidedly attacking the disabled Big O,
it attempted to bring down Paradigm Corporation's
headquarters, but was destroyed by Big Fau,
piloted by Alex.

251.DSCR:
A robot built by Sandman for use against the
Zeravire.
 With Gran Kaiser as its core, four Gran Diva units
unite with it to form God Gravion.
 It is equipped with the Ergo Form system, which
circulates gravitons to form a graviton field around
itself, multiplying the power of its weapons many
times over. While Ergo Form is active, tremendous
strain is placed on both weapons and pilot, making
extended use impossible.
 However, since Gran Kaiser itself bears no graviton
burden, it has no GravCrit either.
251.DSC2:
A robot built by Sandman for use against the
Zeravire. By uniting the Gran Kaiser as the core
with the four Grandivas, God Gravion is completed.
 It is equipped with an Ergo Form system that forms
a graviton field around itself through graviton
circulation, multiplying the power of its weapons
severalfold. While Ergo Form is active, the weapons
and pilot are placed under enormous strain, making
prolonged use impossible. When Eiji, burning with
rivalry against Tokai, boarded it without
permission, he was severely injured by the Ergo
Form's backlash. This shows both its power and its
danger.
 However, since the Gran Kaiser itself is not
burdened by gravitons, it has no graviton critical
limit.

252.DSCR:
A super robot developed by Sandman for use against
the Zeravire.
 It is completed when four Gran Diva units unite
with the core Gran Kaiser: G-Attacker as the right
leg, G-Striker as the left leg, G-Driller for both
arms, and G-Shadow for the chest and head.
 Through the effect of the Ergo Form system, it can
resonate the pilot's G-Factor with the gravitons to
multiply the power of its weapons many times over.
However, the unite state has a time limit called
GravCrit; exceeding it would destroy each Gran
Diva, so the union is forcibly released just before
critical, a built-in weakness.
 For attacks, it draws on the various weapons built
into each Gran Diva: the highly homing 'Graviton
Missile' from G-Attacker, the laser-like whip
'Graviton Viper' from G-Striker, the 'Graviton
Tornado Punch', launched by spinning G-Driller, the
'Gravity Crescent', thrown from G-Shadow's wings,
and the 'Graviton Arc', which releases graviton
energy from the chest, among others.
252.DSC2:
A super robot developed by Sandman for use against
the Zeravire.
 It is completed by the four Grandivas - the G
Attacker as the right leg, G Striker as the left
leg, G Driller as both arms, and G Shadow as the
chest and head - uniting with the core Gran Kaiser.
 Through the Ergo Form system, the pilot's G Factor
is made to resonate with gravitons, multiplying
weapon power severalfold. However, the union has a
time limit called the graviton critical point. If
this is exceeded, the Grandivas will be destroyed,
so the union is forcibly cancelled just before
reaching criticality - a weakness.
 For attacks, it uses various weapons built into
each Grandiva. From the G Attacker comes the highly
homing 'Graviton Missile', from the G Striker the
laser whip 'Graviton Viper', the 'Graviton Tornado
Punch' which spins and fires the G Driller, the
'Gravity Crescent' which throws the G Shadow's
wings, and the 'Graviton Arc' which releases
graviton energy from the chest.
 The 'Choujuuken' (Super Heavy Sword) brought by
Sandman in episode 13 is the strongest sword,
capable of cutting its target along with the space
around it. Besides slashing, it can also be used to
seal the enemy's movements with an Ergo Storm before
cutting. However, it is originally a weapon for Sol
Gravion.

253.DSCR:
A super robot developed by Sandman in preparation
for the coming showdown with his adoptive brother,
Hugue.
 It is completed when four Sol Gran Diva units unite
with the core Gran Kaiser: Geo Caliber as the right
leg, Geo Stinger as the left leg, Geo Javelin for
both arms, and Geo Mirage for the chest and head.
 The Ergo Form system amplifies the pilot's
willpower, allowing it to unleash gravitons in an
explosive release. In theory, it holds power enough
not merely to destroy a planet, but even to create
one. Because piloting it demands commensurate skill
from its Gran Knights, Sandman kept it hidden at a
lunar base until they had grown into warriors worthy
of that power.
 Its main weapons include the 'Sol Graviton Cannon'
mounted on both shoulders, the 'Sol Graviton Arc'
fired from the chest, the 'Sol Graviton Nova', which
concentrates the two, and the 'Sol Graviton
Bringer', a charging attack made by spinning the
drill on its left arm. The 'Choujuuken' that God
Gravion wielded is, in fact, originally a weapon of
Sol Gravion.
253.DSC2:
A super robot developed by Sandman in preparation
for the coming final battle against his
brother-in-law Hyugi.
 It is completed by the four Sol Grandivas - the Geo
Caliver as the right leg, Geo Stinger as the left
leg, Geo Javelin as both arms, and Geo Mirage as the
chest and head - uniting with the core Gran Kaiser.
 Through the Ergo Form system, it amplifies the
pilot's mental energy and explosively releases heavy
gravitons. In theory, it possesses the power to not
only destroy a star but even create one.
Consequently, the Grand Knights who pilot it must be
of commensurate ability, so Sandman kept it hidden
at a lunar base until they grew into warriors worthy
of that power.
 Its main weapons include the 'Sol Graviton Cannon'
on both shoulders, the 'Sol Graviton Arc' fired from
the chest, the 'Sol Graviton Nova' which
concentrates those two, and the 'Sol Graviton
Bringer' which charges with the left arm drill
spinning. The 'Choujuuken' used by God Gravion is
also originally a Sol Gravion weapon.
 By performing the most sinister union with God
Sigma Gravion, it can become the strongest final
form, 'Ultimate Gravion'.

254.DSCR:
A super robot completed when Gran Divas unite with
the star-creation unit Gran Sigma, a machine capable
of creating even stars, developed by a young Sandman
to save his homeland of Rambius. Unlike God
Gravion's blue, its color scheme is black, matching
Gran Sigma.
 Despite uniting with Gran Divas running on the
Phantom System, it displayed performance on par with
God Gravion. This is an achievement made possible
only by Gran Sigma's own unfathomable capabilities,
and above all, by Sandman's own strength and skill.
 Its main weapon is the 'Graviton Lancer', formed by
joining swords drawn from its waist into one.
Sandman used it to effortlessly cut down a Zeravire
that stood in his path with the 'Sigma Slash', a
strike whose blade traces the shape of a sigma.
254.DSC2:
A super robot completed by the Grandivas uniting
with the Souseiki Gran Sigma, a machine capable even
of creating stars, which the young Sandman developed
to save his homeland of Lambias. Its color scheme
is black to match Gran Sigma, unlike God Gravion's
blue.
 Despite uniting with Grandivas that operate on the
Phantom System, it displayed performance rivaling
God Gravion. This feat was only possible through
the immeasurable performance hidden within Gran
Sigma and, above all, Sandman's own power and
skill.
 Its main weapon is the 'Graviton Lancer', formed by
combining swords drawn from the waist. With it,
Sandman used the 'Sigma Slash', whose blade's
trajectory traces a sigma, to easily dispatch the
Zeravire that stood in his way.
 In the final battle against the Zeravire homeworld
Goma, it performed the most sinister union with Sol
Gravion to become 'Ultimate Gravion', stunning
viewers.

255.DSCR:
The mainstay weapon of the Earth Federation
Authority (EFA), a machine that could be called a
mass-produced Gravion. Five units were built, all
assigned to the Gran Trooper Squad. The squad
leader Faye's unit is marked with red coloring in
several places.
 In addition to a highly combat-capable humanoid
form, it can also transform into a highly mobile
fighter-jet form.
 Each Gran Trooper carries different armament;
Faye's unit has two: the 'Gravity Lang', formed by
combining and throwing the parts on both shoulders,
and the 'Gravity Arrow', which fires countless beam
rounds. By drawing energy from every Gran Trooper
unit, it can also use the 'Lightning Detonator', a
weapon with 1.5 times the destructive power of
the Graviton Arc.
255.DSC2:
The Gran Trooper is the main battle machine of the
Earth Federation Administration (EFA), and can be
called a mass-production version of Gravion. It was
developed based on Gravion data sent by Mizuki.
Five units were manufactured, and all were assigned
to the Gran Trooper squad. The unit piloted by the
squad leader, Faye, has red coloring applied in
various places.
 In addition to a humanoid form with high combat
capability, it can also transform into a fighter
form with high mobility.
 Each Gran Trooper is equipped with different
armaments; Faye's unit has two: the 'Gravity
Lang', which combines and throws the shoulder parts,
and the 'Gravity Arrow', which fires numerous beam
shots. Furthermore, by receiving energy supply from
each Gran Trooper, it can use the 'Lightning
Detonator', which has 1.5 times the destructive
power of the Graviton Arc.

256.DSCR:
The smallest class of Zeravire, the Soldier
Zeravire, roughly 5 to 10 meters in overall
length.
 Zeravire are classified by size into
'Soldier-class', 'Warrior-class', and
'Destroyer-class'. The Soldier-class serves roles
such as escorting and scouting for the Warrior-class
and Destroyer-class.

The smallest class of Zeravire, the Soldier

257.DSCR:
The Zeravire that first invaded Earth, appearing in
Episode 1, 'The Castle Where the Giant God
Dwells'. Its official name is 'Sword God of
Purging, Dicreel'.
 It was once damaged by an attack from God Gravion,
but healed itself and returned, having evolved.
