258.DSCR:
A Zeravire appearing in Episode 6, 'Touga's Day
Off'. Its official name is 'Perceiving God of the
Demon Eye, Juettal'.
 It was created to investigate God Gravion's
capabilities, and its combat ability is lower than
that of other Zeravire.
258.DSC2:
A Zeravire that appeared in episode 6, 'Touga's
Day Off'. Its official name is 'Demon Eye Shikigami
Juettal'.
 It was created to investigate the performance of
God Gravion, and its combat capability is lower than
other Zeravires. Therefore, it was scattered by
Touga and Eiji, who were roused to protect their
friends.

259.DSCR:
A Zeravire built specifically to counter God
Gravion, appearing in Episode 13, 'Silver Fang'.
Its official name is 'War God of the Duel,
Hudwell'.
 It has resistance to every weapon it has previously
encountered, and gave God Gravion a hard fight.
259.DSC2:
A Zeravire that appeared in episode 13, 'Silver
Fang', created for fighting God Gravion. Its
official name is 'Duel War God Hudwell'.
 It had resistance to all weapons previously used,
and drove God Gravion into a corner. However, it
was destroyed by a single strike from the
Choujuuken, which united the hearts of the Gran
Knights.

260.DSCR:
A Zeravire appearing in Episode 3, 'Heated Battle!
The Gurabi Hot Spring!!'. Its official name is
'Dragon God of the Flame Prison, Magguard'.
 It lurked within a magma layer and stirred volcanic
activity into greater activity.
260.DSC2:
A Zeravire that appeared in episode 3, 'Fierce
Battle! Gurabi Hot Springs!!'. Its official name is
'Flame Prison Dragon God Magguard'.
 It hid within the magma layer and activated
volcanic activity, but was defeated by God Gravion,
spurred on by the passionate cheering of the maids.

261.DSCR:
A Zeravire appearing in Episode 7, 'The Shattered
Goddess'. Its official name is 'Servant God of the
Broken Vow, Zalogros'.
 It exploited a brief opening during the unite
sequence to seize Gran Kaiser, then cornered Touga
with a psychic attack and heavily damaged
G-Driller.
261.DSC2:
A Zeravire that appeared in episode 7, 'The
Shattered Goddess'. Its official name is 'Broken
Precept Slave God Zalogros'.
 It exploited a slight opening during Unite,
capturing Gran Kaiser. Afterwards, it cornered
Touga with a mental attack, but due to Eina's
suicide attack, it lost Gran Kaiser, though it
heavily damaged the G Driller. Subsequently, it was
destroyed by Gran Troopers that appeared suddenly.

262.DSCR:
The strongest Zeravire, first appearing in Episode
11, 'The Star-Making Machine.' It conceals within
itself the energy of the long-vanished planets
Ranbias and Serias. Its formal name is 'Karmic
Demon God Zeravion.'
 It possesses what seems to be limitless
self-regenerative power, and drove even Sol Gravion
to the brink of defeat.
262.DSC2:
The mightiest Zeravire to appear from episode 11
'Souseiki', holding within it the energy of the
long-extinct planets Lambias and Celia. Its
official name is 'Gyomashin Zeravion'. It possessed
what seemed to be infinite self-regeneration
ability, and even drove Sol Gravion into a corner.
However, its programming that prevented it from
attacking Leele was exploited in reverse, and the
opening created when it halted was seized upon to
destroy it with the Choujuuken.

263.DSCR:
The planet that served as the Zeravire's home base,
introduced in Episode 12, 'Anthem of Souls.' When
Hyugi and Zeravion fell in battle, the planet itself
transformed into a Zeravire and fell into a
rampaging state.
263.DSC2:
A planet that appeared in episode 12 'Anthem of
Souls', serving as the home base of the Zeravire.
With Hyugi and Zeravion defeated, it transformed
itself into a Zeravire and ran wild. It was
completely destroyed by the Choujuu Enouzan of
Ultimate Gravion.

264.DSCR:
Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it as
a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels. It
is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Sol
forms the upper body, Vector Mars the lower body,
and Vector Luna the back unit - it is Aquarion's
strongest form.
 It is characterized by a red-based color scheme and
a head modeled after the sun, with power stones on
both shoulders and shins that amplify bio-energy and
higher-dimensional quantum force.
 While it boasts armor resistant to physical attacks
and tremendous output, it also demands immense
Element ability from its pilot, making it a form
used almost exclusively by Apollo. Deploying the
Solar Wings on its back allows it to unleash even
greater power.
 Its main armament is its fist itself, and its
destructive power is strong enough to crush a
Cherudim Soldier in a single blow without even using
a named technique. Most of its finishing moves are
also fist-based, such as the life-risking punch that
reaches the moon, 'Infinite Punch,' and 'United
Light and Shadow Fist,' unleashed in perfect unison
by Apollo and Silvia after they finally recognized
their true feelings for one another.
 Note that when Lena serves as the main pilot, it
instead takes on the silver-gleaming form 'Silver
Aquarion.'
264.DSC2:
A mechanized angel built by Apollonius 12,000
years ago for use against the Shadow Angels. It is
sometimes called the Mythological-Type Aquarion. By
combining three Vector Machines, it can transform
into three different forms; the order of assembly
greatly changes the resulting form and abilities.
This is Aquarion's strongest form, completed with
Vector Sol forming the upper body, Vector Mars the
lower body, and Vector Luna the back. It is
characterized by its red-based coloration and
sun-motif head, with power stones on both shoulders
and both shins that amplify bio-energy and
higher-dimensional quantum power. While its armor
resists physical attacks and it possesses enormous
output, it also demands powerful Element abilities
from its pilots, making it almost exclusively
Apollo's form. Deploying the solar wings on its
back allows it to bring out even greater power. Its
main armament is its 'fists' themselves, whose
destructive force is so strong that even without
using a special technique it can shatter a Cherudim
Soldier in one blow. Its special moves are mostly
fist-based as well, including the 'Mugen Punch', a
desperate punch that reaches the moon, and the
'Kouei Gou Ikkken', delivered in unison by Apollo
and Silvia after they realized their true feelings
for each other. Incidentally, when Reena is the
main pilot, it takes on a silvery gleam and becomes
'Silver Aquarion'. Initially, Apollo, who held the
past life of Apollonius, was believed to be the
'Wing of the Sun' who would be the savior. But
Zushi, alias Toma, revealed that the true 'Wing of
the Sun' was in fact the Aquarion that Apollonius
had built with his own wings.

265.DSCR:
Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it as
a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels. It
is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Mars
forms the upper body, Vector Luna the lower body,
and Vector Sol the back unit - a form excelling in
mobility.
 It is characterized by a blue-based color scheme
and a head modeled after a star, with the longest
legs of the three forms.
 In terms of performance, it boasts the greatest
mobility of the three forms, with speed exceeding
the sound barrier and impressive jumping power, and
it resists energy attacks. Since it demands
excellent athletic ability from its pilot, Sirius or
Pierre most often serve as its head.
 Its main armament, the StarSwd, becomes a
formidable weapon even wielded alone by Sirius, who
possesses superb swordsmanship. Depending on the
situation, variations exist as well, such as
dual-wielding or the 'Fire Saber,' which combines it
with Pierre's power over flame. Many of its
finishing moves also make use of the StarSwd,
including 'Jealousy Sword,' in which Sirius turned
his jealousy of Apollo into a whirlwind, and 'True
Self-Discovery Sword,' unleashed in his quest for
his true self.

266.DSCR:
Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it as
a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels. It
is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Luna
forms the upper body, Vector Sol the lower body, and
Vector Mars the back unit - a form that excels at
long-range combat and armed reconnaissance.
 It is characterized by a green-based color scheme
and a head modeled after the moon, and is the only
one of the three forms with its cockpit located in
the head.
 In terms of performance, while it has the weakest
physical output of the three forms, it boasts strong
resistance to mental attacks. It also has excellent
empathic sensitivity, so it is mainly piloted by
female Elements such as Reika or Silvia.
 Its armament includes weapons suited for ranged
combat, such as the 'Lunatic Archery,' which fires
arrows from a giant bow nearly as tall as the unit
itself, and the 'Light Wave Shuriken,' which throws
glowing ring-shaped shuriken. Its finishing moves
are mostly unleashed from the Lunatic Archery, such
as the 'Moonsault Attack,' which Silvia fired to
bridge dream and reality, and the 'Ravenous Burst
Arrow,' said to be usable only by one consumed by
hunger. Beyond that, it can also use
martial-arts-based techniques, such as the 'Shoryu
Tenrai' performed by Reika.

This Solar Aquarion was completed by adding Vector
Omega in place of Vector Mars, which was lost when
Sirius defected.
 Normally the Mythical-type Aquarion and the
Assault-type Aquarion are not compatible with one
another, but the team makes the fusion work through
experience, skill, guts, and above all, teamwork.

268.DSCR:
A form completed when Vector Omega serves as the
head part, combined with the original Vector Sol and

 Its finishing moves include the 'Angel Sword of

'Infinite Light of Exploding Love,' a spiral of

270.DSCR:
A new-model Aquarion jointly developed by the New
United Nations Forces and DEAVA, using Futaba, a
wing of paired Shadow Angel wings. Known as the
Assault-type Aquarion, a considerable number have
been produced in series. Because it is piloted by
an Element who has likewise had these wings
transplanted, a single pilot can control all of its
functions (the other two units, in contrast, are
equipped with control units that use ordinary Fallen
Angel Wings).
 It reaches completion when Vector Alpha serves as
its head, forming this combined state. It carries
the massive Impact Cannon that stood out even in
Vector Alpha's solo form. Normally stored in its
left arm, when in use it loads a Fallen Angel Wing
and fires the powerful PSG Quantum Cannon.
 When Glen, who had fallen into a coma, had a Fallen
Angel Wing transplanted into him and returned to the
front lines, he appeared piloting this unit.
 Additionally, as a form not found in the original,
the Assault-type Aquarion can also transform into
'Assault Walker Mode,' which enables high-speed
ground movement and retains flight capability, or
'Armageddon Mode,' a multi-legged gun-platform
form.
270.DSC2:
A new Aquarion jointly developed by the New United
Nations Forces and DEAVA using the wings of Futaba.
Called the Assault-Type Aquarion, considerable
numbers have been mass-produced. Because Elements
who have likewise received transplanted wings pilot
it, a single person can control all functions (the
other two units are equipped with control units
using Shadow Angel wings). This form is completed
with Vector Alpha as the head, and carries the
massive Impact Cannon that was already eye-catching
in Vector Alpha mode. Normally stored in the left
arm, when used it loads a Shadow Angel wing and
fires the PSG Quantum Cannon, making it a powerful
weapon. When Glen, who had fallen into a coma,
received the wings of a Celestial Angel and returned
to the front lines, he appeared in this machine. In
the final battle, Reika piloted it alongside Reena
and Pierre, unleashing the last special move 'Fukou
Danzetsuken' at the approaching Onshi, and literally
parted with her own misfortune. Incidentally, the
Assault-Type Aquarion, a form not even present in
the original, can transform into an 'Assault Walker
form' enabling high-speed ground movement and
flight, and a multi-legged artillery 'Armageddon
form'.

Cherudim Soldier's mobility while unleashing
Aquarion Mars's swordsmanship, it also still fires

274.DSCR:
A Cherudim Soldier that appeared in Episode 21,
'Red Way.'
 Piloted by none other than Zushi (Toma), the Shadow
Angels' front-line commander, its combat ability
ranks among the strongest of all Cherudim Soldiers.
 Wielding the swords in both arms with brilliant
skill, it toyed with Sirius's Aquarion Mars.
274.DSC2:
A Cherudim Soldier that appeared in episode 21
'Red Way'. Piloted by the Shadow Angel front-line
commander Zushi, alias Toma, its combat ability is
among the strongest of the Cherudim Soldiers. It
skillfully wielded the swords on both arms,
confounding Sirius in his Aquarion Mars. In that
battle, Sirius was captivated and defected to the
Shadow Angels.

275.DSCR:
A two-seat Cherudim Soldier that first appeared in
Episode 13, 'A Love Letter Twelve Thousand Years
Old,' piloted initially by Zushi (Toma) and later by
Onshi (Otoha).
 Faster even than Aquarion Mars, it fights like a
dancer, dual-wielding blades formed from the skirt
parts at its waist.
275.DSC2:
In episode 13 'The 10,000 Year Love Letter',
this two-seat Cherudim Soldier first appeared
piloted by Zushi (Toma) and then by Onshi (Otoha).
 It possessed agility surpassing that of Aquarion
Mars and fought in a dancing style with twin swords
fashioned from its waist skirt parts.
 It completely overwhelmed Aquarion, but was burned
to nothing by the 'Fire Flame Thunder Burst' (Kauen
Baku Raiha), which Reika created by gathering the
abilities of Tsugumi and Pierre into a new form -
Aquarion Solna - born from Reika's quick thinking.

276.DSCR:
A Cherudim Soldier exclusive to Ryoshi (Moroha),
first appearing in Episode 10, 'A Star in the Sky,
a Flower on the Ground.'
 Its hammer-like giant fist strikes and its
combination attacks after splitting into two bodies
are ferocious in the extreme, and it once inflicted
severe wounds on Silvia.
276.DSC2:
Appearing from episode 10 'Stars in the Sky,
Flowers on the Ground', this was a Cherudim Soldier
used exclusively by Ryoshi.
 Its attacks using hammer-like massive fists and its
combination fighting when split into two units were
intense, and it seriously wounded Silvia. However,
it was driven back by the 'Infinite Cross Fist'
(Mugen Cross), a special move Apollo and Sirius
devised by realizing their own immaturity, crossing
their fists with each other.
 It reappeared later when Apollo and the others
forced their way into Atlandia and cornered Glen's
Aquarion Omega, but it fell before Glen's attack,
which traded away his own life.

277.DSCR:
A combat humanoid weapon deployed by the Shadow
Angel race.
 Its weapons are sharp claws that can slice through
a building with ease, and a pulse beam fired from
its head. Though its limbs are long, its movements
are quick, tracing an irregular, unpredictable
path.

 It possesses astonishingly hard armor that
deflected every one of Aquarion's attacks. Its
drill-like arms can be used to strike directly, or
fired off as projectiles.
278.DSC2:

 Its armor was remarkably hard and deflected every

 It was blasted from within by the joint special

 It was destroyed by the 'Super 3D Infinite Fist'

283.DSCR:
The world's oldest LFO, developed by the Federation
from an Archetype (a humanoid relic that serves as
the base unit for LFOs) that it excavated. Because
it forms the foundation for every LFO that followed,
it is called 'Nirvash type ZERO.' LFO stands for
'Light Finding Operation,' referring to rechargeable
humanoid mobile machines.
 It has various features found in no other unit,
such as its left-right two-seat cockpit and its
ability to move without a Compac Drive installed.
It also appears to choose its own pilot and can act
autonomously at times, so piloting it well depends
less on operating skill than on achieving mutual
understanding with the machine.
 By setting the Amita Drive into the Compac Drive,
it links with the Satori Program, triggering the
'Seven Swell Phenomenon,' which causes an abnormal
outbreak of Trapar before making it vanish
completely.

284.DSCR:
The form into which Nirvash evolved of its own
will, in step with the changes in Eureka and
Renton. Its formal designation should be 'Nirvash
type ZERO spec2' (Spec 2), but Eureka and the
others continue to simply call it "Nirvash."
 Because the very shape of the Archetype serving as
its base had changed, it was almost entirely rebuilt
from scratch at the Tresor Institute. Its greatest
feature is that, in addition to its previous
humanoid mode and Vehicle mode, it can now transform
into a high-speed Flight mode. With this renewal,
Renton became the main rider, while Eureka took on
the sub role and piloting duties for the high-speed
Flight mode.
 The area around the cockpit also changed, bringing
the two pilots closer together, and space was even
prepared in the rear for the children to ride. It
looks just like a family car.
 As with the type ZERO, its lift board was made by
Thurston Garage, crafted by Axel's own hand.

285.DSCR:
Nirvash's final form, which evolved in response to
Renton's feelings and those of Maurice and the other
children. Its formal designation should be 'Nirvash
type ZERO spec3' (Spec 3).
 Unlike the transformation into Spec 2, this form
was born when the Archetype fused directly with its
installed machinery. Its biological appearance, its
control system that directly reflects Renton's own
movements, and its ability to fly without a lift
board are all vastly different from its previous
forms.
 With power that transcends the very concept of an
LFO, it drove off swarm after swarm of Coralian
antibodies.

286.DSCR:
An LFO that mainly serves on the front line for
Gekkostate. Its formal name is 'Terminus type
R606.'
 The second unit officially adopted in the Terminus
line. It achieved improved mobility and extended
operating time by sacrificing the airframe strength
meant to support its various mounts and equipment,
resulting in a lighter overall build.
 As its fighter-plane-like shape suggests, its
cockpit is a two-seat, front-and-back
configuration. In combat, the most common
arrangement was Matthieu riding up front as rider,
with Stoner in back taking photographs. In everyday
use, it is also commonly used for shopping and
hauling supplies.

Gekkostate. Its formal name is 'Terminus type
R808.'
 Because it is equipped with a twin-turret Long
Range Laser Cannon for long-distance attacks, it
boasts the strongest firepower of any LFO in
Gekkostate's possession. In exchange, its power
consumption is severe, leaving it with a short
operating time as its drawback.
 Hilda mainly rides it, supporting and being
supported by her partner Matthieu.

288.DSCR:
The most advanced LFO in Gekkostate's possession.
Its formal name is 'Terminus type R909.'
 It was originally officially adopted by the
Federation's special mobile unit. It achieved
outstanding mobility through weight reduction
surpassing even the R606, along with long
operating time and high firepower through
power-saving improvements that fixed the R808's
weakness. By removing its limiter, it can even make
use of the 'Compac Feedback System,' giving it the
highest performance in the series.
 However, it became correspondingly harder to
handle, and its production cost rose as well.
Combined with the fact that no further improvement
in performance could be expected, it became the
machine that put an end to the Terminus line. Since
no one in Gekkostate besides Holland can pilot it,
it has effectively become his personal machine.
288.DSC2:
The most advanced LFO owned by Gekkostate. Its
official name is 'Terminus type R909'.
 Originally, this unit was adopted for regular use

long operating time and high firepower through
improved power saving that corrects the R808's
flaws. By releasing the limiter, the 'Compact
Feedback System' can also be used, making it the
highest performance in the series.
 However, on the other hand, handling became
considerably more difficult, and production costs
also rose. Additionally, for the reason that no
further improvement in unit performance could be
hoped for, it became the unit that brought the
Terminus series to an end. Since no one in
Gekkostate other than Holland can master it, it has
effectively become his personal machine.
 During the second encounter with Anemone, he fought
the End alone, but was grabbed by its claw and torn
apart.

289.DSCR:
An LFO developed at the Federation's Tresor
Institute. As its name, 'Terminus type B303,'
indicates, it is the earliest unit in the Terminus
line. Given its shape, it is said to possibly be a
transitional machine born somewhere between the type
ZERO and the End.
 It was an experimental unit never officially
adopted, and traces of that remain in its movable
Long Range Laser Cannon mounted on its back and in
its transformation mechanism, which was ultimately
omitted.
 Its greatest feature is that its 'Compac Feedback
System' has no limiter installed. In exchange for
the astonishing agility this grants, it places an
extraordinary physical and mental burden on its
rider. Because of this, administering drugs that
heighten the nervous system's responsiveness is
mandatory before boarding.
 Because of its aggressive shape and performance
that could even kill its own rider, it bears the
nickname 'Devil Fish.' Holland, having lost the
R909, piloted it and achieved great results in
battle, but the devil gradually ate away at his
body.

290.DSCR:
The mobile mothership that serves as Gekkostate's
base.
 Originally the newest-model cruiser developed by
the Federation, Holland stole it when he staged his
mutiny, and has used it ever since.
 It possesses ultra-high-speed cruising ability from
its cutting-edge, high-output engine, along with the
transport and storage capacity of a mothership able
to carry four LFOs. In terms of combat capability,
it is armed with six main guns, pulse laser cannons,
and heat-seeking missiles. It is further equipped
with the stealth system 'Compac Interferencer,'
which cancels out residual Trapar waves against
radar waves to evade military detection networks,
allowing it to respond to virtually any operation.
 On top of all this, it also functions as a living
space complete with private quarters for its
members, a shop, and even a large bathhouse - an
all-purpose ship that satisfies every need in a
single vessel.

is the 'Compac Feedback System,' which allows even
riders without advanced skill to achieve a certain
level of control.
 The 10 (ichi-maru) type is the normal type, a
lightweight model.

293.DSCR:
A KLF developed by the Federation in imitation of
the type ZERO. Its formal name is 'Nirvash type the
END.'
 In contrast to the type ZERO, it has an ominous
black body and a sharp, angular form. Yet it shares
a number of traits with it as well, such as
responding to the calls of its rider, Anemone, and
having eyes set into its head. It is also
distinctive for wearing two lift boards on its feet
like skis.
 Its arsenal includes the 'Basque Crisis,' which
strikes directly at an enemy rider's brain, along
with wire-guided melee claws and numerous homing
lasers. It pursues its target relentlessly, true to
its name, bringing 'the end' to whoever stands
against it.
293.DSC2:
A KLF developed by the Federation of the Tower
State, modeled after Type Zero. Its official name
is 'Nirvash type the END'.
 In contrast to Type Zero, it has a sinister black
body and sharp-angled form. However, it responds to
the calls of its rider Anemone, and has eyes on its
head, showing many commonalities. It is also
distinctive in that it wears two lift boards on both
feet like skis.
 It is equipped with 'Bascud Crisis', which directly
attacks the brains of enemy riders, as its primary
weapon, as well as wire-guided melee claws and
numerous homing lasers. It pursues its target
relentlessly, bringing 'the end' to those it faces,
as its name suggests. In the battle against the
Coralian Antibody, it deployed VC-10s around
itself to form 'Formation Gagundura' and unleashed
'Baharuk Swell'.
 In the end, it evolved just like Type Zero, and
gained a pure white body as if responding to
Anemone's feelings, but it protected Anemone and
Dominic from Dewey's attack and ceased its
activity.

294.DSCR:
The Federation's newest Mon-Soono-type machine.
 It is distinguished by side panels that deploy from
its enlarged legs, letting them double as lift
boards. In place of a rear weapon mount, it carries
rail guns on its elbows.
 Its true strength is unleashed when the six units
piloted by the Ageha Squad form 'Formation
Gagundura' with the End at its center.

295.DSCR:
A large flying-wing battleship operated by the
Federation's air force.
 It has enormous wings that collect Trapar, and
travels at high speed along ley lines to transport
the KLFs and personnel it carries. It is also
equipped with an ample arsenal, including beam
cannons, missiles, and depth charges, giving it
excellent performance as a warship as well.
 Because the Izumo Squad, led by Jurgens, also uses
this class of ship, it is also known as an
'Izumo-class ship.' The red line on its wings
originally denotes membership in the Izumo Squad.
295.DSC2:
A large flying-wing battleship operated by the air

 It has huge wings that receive Trapar, and moves at

weaponry such as beam cannons, missiles, and depth
charges, making its performance as a combat vessel

 The Izumo squad led by Jurgens also uses this ship,

ambition, it underwent major modifications at the
Trezor Institute and was reborn as the 'Super Izumo
ship'. At that time, it was painted deep red, the
'hot man's blood'. The red lines on the wings
originally indicate Izumo squad affiliation.

296.DSCR:
The newest-model cruiser developed by the
Federation. It serves as the flagship of the Ageha
Squad, with Dewey aboard as its captain.
 Designed using the same line of technology as the
Gekko-Goh, it boasts a massive hull roughly 1.5
kilometers long and about 700 meters wide.
Despite being such an enormous vessel, it carries
only a single onboard unit: the Nirvash type the
END.
 To offset the vulnerability to being hit that comes
with such a massive body, it is equipped with the
'Bit' system, which automatically defends against
and counterattacks enemy fire.
296.DSC2:
The Ginga-Goh is the latest cruiser developed by
the Federation of the Tower State military. It
serves as the flagship of the Ageha Squad, with

 Designed with the same technological lineage as the
Gekko-Goh, it boasts an ultra-large hull
approximately 1.5 kilometers in length and 700
meters in width. Despite being such a massive
vessel, it carries only a single aircraft: the
Nirvash type the END.
 To mitigate the susceptibility to damage inherent
in its enormous size, it is equipped with an
automated 'Bit' system that both defends against
enemy attacks and launches its own.
 It proudly demonstrated an ironclad defense,
blocking all attacks from the Gekko-Goh, but its
stronghold was breached beginning with Holland's
suicidal ramming attack.

297.DSCR:

 Its bombing accuracy is extremely high, and it

298.DSCR:

Operations Force. Charles received it in place of
severance pay upon retiring from the SOF. The blue
unit is his personal machine.
 The 'Spearhead SH-101' takes its name from the
melee spear mounted on its head, and is also
equipped with a retractable blade on its forearm and

 Because it can fly using the reflector at its waist
even without a lift board, it can trace remarkably
tricky flight paths. It also carries functions
unique to the Special Operations Force, such as
autopilot through running programs.

303.DSCR:
A prototype for the Earth Federation Forces'
next-generation mass-production unit.
 It is tuned on the assumption that it will operate
with the all-domain general-purpose weapon system
developed in the same period, the 'Ganary Carver.'
 There is nothing remarkable about the airframe's
raw performance, but it has a flexible joint
structure and high responsiveness that meets the
demands of any pilot, from raw recruits to
veterans.
 The tactical research unit 'Glory Star' is
conducting performance evaluation of the airframe
and collecting operational data on the Ganary
Carver.
 Unit 1's Ganary Carver is tuned for gunnery
combat, and is being used to collect data on the
high-output beam weapon 'Ray Straight Turret.'
 Unit 1's Ganary Carver also functions as the
master unit, with the ability to integrate the data
from Units 2 and 3.

306.DSCR:
A unit repaired in the field by splicing together
the severely damaged Virgola Units 1 and 2.
 While there is no functional deficiency, out of
respect for the pilots' wishes, the parts
deliberately retain the coloring of their original
airframes rather than being repainted.
 The operational data from each unit was also
integrated at the same time, allowing the Ganary
Carver to reach a provisional completion as the
all-domain general-purpose weapon system it was
originally meant to be.

307.DSCR:
A Virgola refitted by Chimera's Dr. G.E.

 The unit's name was decided by its current pilot.
 In addition to tuning the servo motors and
actuators at each joint, the VWFS (V-Wing Flight
System) enables atmospheric flight, giving it, on
top of the Virgola's signature responsiveness,
remarkable agility as well.
 The Ganary Carver has also transformed through a
peculiar phenomenon, and its output has risen
dramatically as well. This is thought to be because
its core section, previously a black box, absorbed
its surrounding parts and reconstructed itself into
a state closer to its original intended function.

 Using an array of tools mounted all over its body,

Jarrench,' it handles repairs on machines of every
size, from small units to large ships.
 Because it can also unleash tremendous power in

 Its cockpit seats two, and though small, it
includes living quarters - for Beater Service, it is
not only an essential tool of the trade but also a

0.DSCR:
The pilot of Mazinger Z.
 He is a hot-blooded young man
with a strong sense of justice,
though simple-minded and a bit
careless. Entrusted with Mazinger
Z by his grandfather, Dr. Juzo
Kabuto, he went into battle to
crush the ambitions of the evil
scientist Dr. Hell, who sought
world domination.
 At first he had no idea how to
operate the robot and piloted it
recklessly, but the skills he had
honed riding motorcycles and his
natural talent for close combat
soon became second nature to him
in the cockpit. Those abilities
served him well in hand-to-hand
fighting against the Iron Mask
forces as well.
 After wiping out Dr. Hell's army
of Mechanical Beasts, he entrusted
the fight against the new threat
of the Mycenae Empire to Tetsuya
Tsurugi and Great Mazinger, and
left for the United States to
study abroad. However, as the
Mycenae Empire's assaults
intensified, he returned home for
a time and helped bring about the
enemy's defeat.
 After finishing his studies
abroad and returning to Japan, he
threw himself into the fight
against the Vega Star Alliance
alongside Duke Fleed, piloting the
TFO he had built himself and the
newly developed Double Spazer.
0.DSC2:
Pilot of Mazinger Z.
 He has a simple personality and
is sometimes scatterbrained, but
he is a hot-blooded man with a
heart of justice. Entrusted with
Mazinger Z by his grandfather,
Dr. Juzo Kabuto, he entered
battle to crush the ambitions of
the evil scientist Dr. Hell, who
sought world conquest.
 Initially not knowing how to
handle the machine, he piloted it
recklessly, but he learned through
the techniques honed on his
motorcycle and his innate fighting
sense. These skills were also
fully displayed in close-quarters
combat against the Iron Mask
Corps.
 After annihilating Dr. Hell's
Mechanical Beast Corps, he
entrusted the fight against the
new threat, the Mikene Empire, to
Tetsuya Tsurugi and Great
Mazinger, and departed for America
to study. However, to counter the
escalating attacks of the Mikene
Empire, he returned temporarily
and made a comeback in a
powered-up Mazinger Z, showing the
gallant form of the Double
Mazinger.
 After returning home from his
studies, he boarded the TFO, which
he had built independently, and
the newly developed Double Spazer,
throwing himself into battle
against the Vega United Forces
alongside Duke Fleed.
 Throughout all series, he stood
against great evil - he is the
true hero of justice.

1.DSCR:
The daughter of Professor Yumi,
director of the Photon Power
Laboratory, and the pilot of
Aphrodite A and Diana A.
 Cheerful by nature, she is quite
skilled at piloting both robots
and motorcycles. She also has a
tomboyish streak, which sometimes
got her into trouble.
 She and Kouji often butted heads,
but through repeated clashes they
built a bond of trust and became
what could be called the best of
partners.
 After the fight against Dr.
Hell's army of Mechanical Beasts
ended, she went to study in the
United States together with
Kouji.

sometimes led her into trouble.
 She often clashed with Kouji, but
through repeated conflicts they
built a relationship of trust and
became what could be called the
best of partners.
 After the battle against Dr.
Hell's Mechanical Beast Corps
ended, she went to America to
study with Kouji. But when the
war against the Mikene Empire
reached its peak, she returned
with Kouji and fought alongside
him.

2.DSCR:
Kouji's younger brother.
 A kind and cheerful boy who
always worries about Kouji while
also cheering him on. At times,
though, he shows a mischievous
streak much like his brother's.
 He is well liked, with many
friends both at the Photon Power
Laboratory and at school.
 In 'Great Mazinger', it was
revealed that Kenzo Kabuto,
director of the Science Fortress
Institute, is his father. The two
of them awkwardly worked to make
up for the years they had lost.

3.DSCR:
Director of the Photon Power

 He is Dr. Juzo Kabuto's top

trust, having even been told of
Dr. Hell's ambitions.
 He is the foremost authority on
Photon Power and Super Alloy Z
research, and developed Mazinger
Z's new weapons as well as
Aphrodite A and Diana A.
 In battle, he gave Kouji and
Sayaka cautious but precise
instructions, proving his worth as
a combat commander as well.

 Quiet by nature, he approaches

 Short-tempered by nature, but a

alongside Dr. Nossori and the

develop Mazinger Z's additional

 Short-tempered by nature, but a first-rate

6.DSCR:
The pilot of Great Mazinger.
Eighteen years old.
 He grew up in an orphanage until
Dr. Kenzo Kabuto took him in so
that he could pilot Great
Mazinger. Raised from then on
with combat drilled into him, he
became a top-class fighter and
pilot. Outside of battle,
however, his poor way with words
tends to leave people with an
impression of him as rough and
unrefined.
 He looked after Shiro as if he
were his own younger brother and
built a bond of trust with Boss
and the others, becoming the
pillar of the Mazinger team in
place of Kouji, who had gone to
America.
6.DSC2:
Pilot of Great Mazinger. 18
years old.
 He lived in an orphanage as a
child, but was taken in by Dr.
Kenzo Kabuto to pilot Great
Mazinger. From then on, he was
raised being drilled in the arts
of combat, making his martial arts
and robot piloting skills
top-notch. However, when it came
to things other than battle, his
taciturn nature tended to give
those around him a rough
impression.
 He looked after Shiro like a
younger brother, built trusting
relationships with Boss and the
others, and became the pillar of
the Mazinger team in place of
Kouji, who had gone to America.
 When Kouji returned for the
decisive battle against the Mikene
Empire, witnessing the father-son
bond between Kenzo and Kouji
ignited feelings of jealousy. His
refusal to cooperate with Kouji
threw the Science Fortress
Research Institute into crisis.
What saved them was Kenzo's deep
affection, no less than that of a
true parent and child, but the
price paid to learn that truth was
far too great.

7.DSCR:
Tetsuya's support pilot and the
pilot of Venus A.
 She grew up in an orphanage until
Dr. Kenzo Kabuto took her in and
raised her as a warrior in
preparation for the coming battle
with the Mycenae Empire. Having
grown up together with Tetsuya,
she became a good partner to him.
 True to her name, she has a
fierce, fiery temperament, being
both spirited and unwilling to
lose. Though she usually puts up
a strong front, she harbors a
complex about her own birth and
has been known to brood over it.

8.DSCR:
Kouji's classmate at Toujo
Academy and the pilot of Boss
Borot. He is always accompanied
by his followers Nuke and Mucha.
 A show-off and a flatterer who is
exactly as simple-minded as he
looks. He is hopeless around
pretty women, getting far more
excited than necessary and going
weak in the knees whenever a
female guest appears. Naturally,
he is smitten with both Sayaka and
Jun.
 He harbors intense rivalry toward
Kouji, and out of a desire for a
robot of his own to shine in, he
kidnapped the Photon Power
Laboratory's three scientists and
forced them to build Boss Borot.
 Though he always clowns around,
he has a genuine desire to protect
peace. Fighting alongside Kouji
and Tetsuya, even if he sometimes
got in their way, he built a deep
friendship and bond of trust with
them.
8.DSC2:
Kouji's classmate at Tojo Academy
and pilot of Boss Borot. He
always has his underlings Nuke and
Mucha in tow.
 His personality is
attention-seeking, a joker, and
simple-minded, matching his
appearance. Above all, he is weak
to pretty women, and whenever a
female guest appeared, he would
get overly excited and become
lovestruck. Naturally, he has
crushes on both Sayaka and Jun.
 He harbors an intense rivalry

 He is always fooling around, but

protect peace. While sometimes

deep bonds of friendship and
trust.
 After the war against the Mikene
Empire ended, he strove to become
a robot scientist, eventually
reaching the point where he could
modify Borot himself.

The pilot of Grendizer.
 He is the prince of Planet Fleed,
destroyed by the Vega Star
Alliance, and one of its few

man who wishes for peace and
believes in love and friendship,
he possesses great physical
ability along with various psychic
powers, including telepathy.
 Having fled the Vega Star
Alliance and made his way to
Earth, he began a new life as
Daisuke, son of Dr. Umon. But
upon learning that the Vega Star
Alliance had set its sights on
Earth, he resolved to fight in
Grendizer to protect his second

12.DSC2:

13.DSCR:
Danbei's daughter.
 A cheerful, spirited girl with
the athletic ability to handle
horseback riding with ease.
 She gradually fell for Daisuke,
who worked at the ranch her father
managed. After learning that his
true identity was the alien Duke
Fleed, she resolved without
hesitation to fight alongside
him. In time she became the pilot
of the Marine Spazer, supporting
Duke both in battle and in daily
life. Her cheerfulness seems to
have been a source of comfort for
Duke, who carried a dark past.
13.DSC2:

Duke's younger sister and

 When Planet Fleed was attacked by

 At first she mistook Duke for an

pendant she became certain he was

mainly rode in the Drill Spazer,
joining forces with him to fight
the Vega Star Alliance.

several external augmentation

 He is also a big-hearted man,

 During the fight against the Vega
Star Alliance, he served as a
combat commander, giving calm and
precise instructions to support
Daisuke and the Grendizer team.
15.DSC2:
Director of the Space Science Institute.
 A brilliant scientist specializing in the study
of UFOs and space science. To bolster the power of
Grendizer, which could not be enhanced through
Earth science alone, he developed several external
augmentation devices such as the Double Spazer and
the Cosmo Special.
 He is also a big-hearted man, having rescued the
alien Duke Fleed and taken him in as his own son.
 During the fight against the Vega Star Alliance,
he served as a combat commander, giving calm and
precise instructions to support Daisuke and the
Grendizer team.

16.DSCR:
The head of Shirakaba Ranch and
father of Hikaru and Goro.
 His hobby is sky watching, in
hopes of spotting a UFO and
encountering aliens.
16.DSC2:
The head of Shirakaba Ranch and father of Hikaru

 His hobby is sky watching, in hopes of spotting a
UFO and encountering aliens.

17.DSCR:
Hikaru's younger brother.
 A mischievous but cheerful and
honest boy who looks up to Daisuke
like an older brother.
17.DSC2:
Hikaru's younger brother.
 A mischievous but cheerful and honest boy who
looks up to Daisuke like an older brother.

18.DSCR:
The absolute ruler of Planet Vega
and holder of full authority over
the Vega Star Alliance.
 He plots to rule the entire
universe, invading other planets
by force and destroying every
world that dared resist, Planet
Fleed among them.
 He remains on Planet Vega
himself, issuing orders for the
invasion of Earth to Skull Moon,
the forward base built on the
Moon.
18.DSC2:
The absolute monarch who rules
the planet Vega and the supreme
commander of the Vega Star
Alliance Army. He plots to
dominate the entire universe,
invading other planets by force
and destroying any that resist,
including the planet Fleed.
Remaining on Vega himself, he
issued orders for the Earth
invasion operation from Skull
Moon, the frontline base built on
the Moon. But when an accident
caused the planet Vega to
collapse, he abandoned the
citizens and fled the planet,
relocating to Skull Moon.
Thereafter he took direct
command. In the end, he launched
a full-scale attack on Earth
aboard the King of Vega, but was
slain by the hands of Grendizer.

19.DSCR:
The officer in charge of Skull
Moon, the forward base the Vega
Star Alliance built on the Moon,
and supreme commander of the
invasion of Earth.
 He has sworn absolute loyalty to
Emperor Vega and strives to carry
out his orders faithfully,
favoring a style of combat that
crushes the enemy through sheer
force.
 Hidden within him is a female
personality of the opposite
temperament, named 'Lady Gandal,'
who favors scheming and
treachery. When she speaks up,
Gandal's face splits in two to
reveal her as a small woman.
Later, after Gandal suffered a
facial injury, he underwent
surgery so that his face could
switch between the two
personalities.
19.DSC2:
The highest authority at Skull
Moon, the frontline base built on
the Moon by the Vega Star Alliance
Army, and the supreme commander of
the Earth invasion operation. He
swears absolute loyalty to Emperor
Vega and strives to faithfully
execute his orders. He prefers
tactics of overwhelming enemies
through military force. Within
him lurks a female persona, 'Lady
Gandal,' who has the opposite
personality and favors scheming
and treachery. When she voices
her opinions, Gandal's face splits
in two and she appears as a small
woman. Later, when Gandal
suffered a facial injury,
reconstructive surgery was
performed that replaced his face
and personality entirely. As the
Alliance Army's defeat became
increasingly certain, Lady Gandal
attempted to assassinate Emperor
Vega to save herself. But sensing
this, Gandal rammed his personal
flagship into Grendizer to protect
the Emperor and died.

20.DSCR:
Emperor Vega's daughter, and also
Duke's betrothed.
 As a child, she was sent to
Planet Fleed as part of a
political arrangement, and she had
loved Duke ever since that time.
20.DSC2:
Rubina was the daughter of
Emperor Vega and the fiancee of
Duke. As a child, she was sent to
Planet Fleed as part of a
political arrangement, and from
that time she continued to love
Duke. She came to Earth to inform
Duke that the effects of Vega
radiation were beginning to
disappear from Planet Fleed, but
during the battle between Zril,
who had come to take her back, and
Grendizer, she was gravely
wounded. In the arms of her
beloved, she passed away while
wishing for peace to the very
end.

21.DSCR:
Having previously piloted the
Eagle - Getter 1, he now pilots
the Dragon - Getter Dragon.
Eighteen years old.
 A student at Asama Academy, he
can be a bit inflexible but is
serious and single-minded by
nature. He serves as captain of
the soccer team and, as the leader
of the Getter Team, keeps its
three pilots working together.
 His family runs a kendo dojo in
Kyushu, and he often drew on the
swordsmanship his father drilled
into him from an early age when
fighting. At times he even faced
members of the Hyakki Hundred in
unarmed combat.
 He seems to be popular not only
with the girls at his school but
also with Gola of the Dinosaur
Empire (Miyuki Saotome) and
Kochouki of the Hyakki Empire,
making him quite the heartbreaker
even though he has no such
intentions himself.

22.DSCR:
Having previously piloted the
Jaguar - Getter 2, he now pilots
the Liger - Getter Liger.
Eighteen years old.
 A student at Asama Academy, he is
the only member of the Getter Team
not in an athletic club, despite
having outstanding physical
reflexes.
 At first, his overconfidence made
him keep others at a distance, a
constant source of friction within
the team. But as he built a bond
of trust with Ryouma and the
others through battle, he began to
take things more seriously, and
his calm judgment saved the Getter
Team from crisis time and again.
 The cross he always wears is a
keepsake from his late mother, who
is said to have borne a faint
resemblance to Michiru, and it
holds her photograph inside.
22.DSC2:
Hayato, an 18-year-old youth,
continued as the pilot of the
Jaguar and Getter 2, and also
served as the pilot of the Liger
and Getter Liger. He was a high
school student attending Asama
Academy, and although he was the
only member of the Getter Team who
did not belong to an athletic
club, his motor skills were
outstanding. Initially, he was
overconfident and built walls
between himself and others, which
caused constant friction within
the team. However, through battle
and building trust with Ryouma and
the others, he came to approach
matters with sincerity. His calm
judgment saved the Getter from
crisis on numerous occasions. The
cross he always wore was a
keepsake from his deceased mother,
who supposedly resembled Michiru,
and inside it was her photograph.
When heading into a deadly
mission, he handed it to Michiru
and conveyed his feelings to her.

23.DSCR:
He joined the Getter Team in
place of Musashi, who died in
battle, and pilots the Poseidon -
Getter Poseidon. Eighteen years
old.
 A transfer student to Asama
Academy, he joined the Getter Team
on the strength of his monstrous
power, enough to flatten dozens of
athletes at once, and a toughness
impressive enough that he could
doze off even while riding the
Getter training simulator.
 His hobby is baseball, and he
later became captain of Asama
Academy's baseball team. His
pilot suit reflects this, looking
every bit like a baseball
uniform.
 A pacifist who dislikes fighting,
he even turned down piloting
Getter for a time. But he is fond
of children and kind-hearted at
heart, as shown when he rallied
himself to fight after Genki was
captured by a Hyakki mecha.

24.DSCR:
Dr. Saotome's daughter.
 Like Ryouma and the others, she
attends Asama Academy, and her
cheerful, kind nature has made her
so popular that she is called the
Mona Lisa of Asama Academy. She
was something of a Madonna figure
to the Getter Team as well.
 Switching from the Command
Machine to the Lady Command, she
skillfully supported the Getter
Team from behind the lines with
reconnaissance, supply runs, and
covering fire, becoming
indispensable in battle. During
the final battle, she piloted
Getter Liger to fill the gap left
by Hayato's absence.

25.DSCR:
Director of the Saotome Institute
and father of Michiru and Genki.
 With his unshaven face, wooden
sandals, and perpetually messy
office, he makes an unimpressive
first impression. But he is the
foremost authority on the
mysterious cosmic radiation known
as 'Getter Rays,' and his ability
as a scientist is recognized as
world-class.
 Though he originally developed
Getter Robo for space exploration,
when the Dinosaur Empire suddenly
appeared he armed Getter and used
it to defend the Earth. He later
completed a new combat-model
Getter Robo to fight the Hyakki
Empire as well.
 In battle he also served as a
commander, never losing his
composure even in the direst
moments, and his sound judgment
made him a great pillar of support
for the Getter Team.
25.DSC2:
Doctor Saotome was the director
of the Saotome Research Institute
and the father of Michiru and
Genki. With his unshaven beard,
geta sandals, and a room left in
complete disarray, he gave a
rather unimpressive impression.
However, he was the leading
authority on the mysterious
radiation from space known as
'Getter Rays,' and his abilities
as a scientist were recognized
worldwide. He developed the
Getter Robo for space development,
but when the Dinosaur Empire
suddenly appeared, he armed the
Getter to protect the Earth.
Furthermore, he completed a new
combat-oriented Getter Robo to
fight the Hyakki Empire. In
battle, he also excelled as a
commander, never losing his
composure even in crisis, and
supported the Getter Team with
excellent situational judgment.
His given name was never revealed
to the end.

26.DSCR:
Dr. Saotome's second son.
 True to his name, he is an
energetic and mischievous
elementary school boy. Never shy
around strangers, he quickly
warmed up to Benkei after his
later arrival and treated him like
a friend.
 He even became friendly with
Jimushiki, a boy from the Hyakki
Empire, and his active nature
helped the Getter Team on more
than one occasion.
26.DSC2:
Dr. Saotome's second son.
 True to his name, he is an energetic and

 He even became friendly with Jimushiki, a boy

27.DSCR:
The emperor who rules the Hyakki
Empire, possessing powerful
telepathic abilities.
 The Hyakki Empire's goal is to
implant artificial horns that
serve as telepathic receiver
antennae into people's heads,
turning humanity into Hyakki
soldiers to use as pawns for world
conquest. But efficiently
developing Hyakki soldiers and
Hyakki mecha requires a Getter Ray
amplifier, and Burai has
relentlessly attacked the Saotome
Institute in order to obtain one.
 He possesses the ruthlessness,
cruelty, and majesty one would
expect from his demonic
appearance, exceeding even those
of Emperor Gore, ruler of the
Dinosaur Empire.
 Yet he can also show leniency
toward his subordinates. When he
learned that Hakkotsuki's daughter
Lisa had betrayed them, he honored
Hakkotsuki's plea not to have to
kill his own daughter and ordered
someone else to carry out the
execution instead. He also showed
consideration for Hidler, who had
just made a miraculous return from
the brink of death before the
final battle, by ordering him to
rest.
27.DSC2:
Emperor Bry was the ruler of the
Hyakki Empire and possessed
powerful telepathic abilities.
The goal of the Hyakki Empire was
to implant artificial horns that
served as telepathic wave
receiving antennas into the heads
of humanity, transforming them
into Hyakki Soldiers to serve as
pawns in their world conquest.
However, to efficiently develop
Hyakki Soldiers and Hyakki mecha,
they needed a Getter Ray
amplification device, and Bry
relentlessly attacked the Saotome
Research Institute to obtain it.
He possessed the ruthlessness,
cruelty, and dignity expected of
his demonic appearance. All of
these surpassed even those of
Emperor Gore of the Dinosaur
Empire. Yet he also had a lenient
side toward his subordinates;
when he learned that Lisa, the
daughter of Hakkotsu Oni, had
betrayed them, he honored Hakkotsu
Oni's plea not to have to kill his
own daughter and ordered someone
else to execute her. Also, during
the final battle, he showed
consideration for Hidlar, who had
just made a miraculous return, by
ordering him to rest. In the end,
he raised the Science Fortress
Island to challenge the final
battle, but was defeated before
the Getter Robo.

28.DSCR:
The combat commander who oversees
the Hyakki Empire's military
might. Along with Dr. Gura, he
serves as one of Emperor Burai's
right-hand men, but behind the
scenes he is a scheming man with
his eye on Burai's own position.
 Underhanded and contemptible by
nature, he directs his malice at
ally and enemy alike. In the
past, fearing that his position as
marshal was threatened, he framed
General Jirai and had him
executed, and when he judged that
the general's son Jiraiki had
likewise become a threat, he
treacherously struck him down amid
the fighting.
 He is no mere petty villain,
however; he possesses real
ability, having broken through the
barrier of the newly built
battleship Sea Force with his
personal fighter craft, survived
the explosion of a Hyakki robot
against all odds, and even taken
Hayato prisoner while making his
escape.
28.DSC2:
Marshal Hidlar was the battle
commander in charge of the
military forces of the Hyakki
Empire. He worked alongside
Doctor Gura as one of Emperor
Bry's right-hand men, but behind
the scenes, he was a scheming man
who coveted his superior's
position. He was cunning and
despicable in character, showing
no discrimination between friend
and foe. In the past, fearing his
position as marshal was
threatened, he trapped General
Jirai and had him executed, and
when he predicted that Jirai's son
Jirai Oni would become a threat,
he arranged for his death in
battle as well. However, he was
not merely a small-time villain;
he possessed considerable skill,
such as breaking through the
barrier of the new battleship Sea
Force with his custom fighter,
making a miraculous escape from an
exploding Hyakki Robot, and even
capturing Hayato as a prisoner
during his escape. But the life
he saved through that miracle was
cut short when Hayato, his
prisoner, destroyed the Science
Fortress Island from within,
ultimately costing him his life.

29.DSCR:
The scientist who serves as the
brains of the Hyakki Empire,
working alongside Marshal Hidler
as one of Emperor Burai's
right-hand men.
 He is responsible for developing
Hyakki mecha and fighter craft as
well as drafting strategy, and his
brilliant mind is indispensable to
the Hyakki Empire.
 Talented young members such as
Jimushiki and Tekkoki gathered
under him, learning from him day
after day.
29.DSC2:
Dr. Glah was a scientist who
served as the brain of the Hyakki
Empire. Alongside Marshal Hidler,
he worked as one of Emperor Bry's
right-hand men.
 He was responsible for the
development of Hyakki mecha and
fighter craft, as well as the
planning of operations, and his
superior intellect was
indispensable to the Hyakki
Empire.
 Under his tutelage, gifted young
men such as Jichki and Tekkoki
gathered and studied daily.
 He was killed in action just
before the final battle, but the
existence of the 'Gravity Control
Device' which he left behind,
capable of raising even the
Science Fortress Island, led Bry
to decide to launch his final
operation.

30.DSCR:
One of the Hyakki Hundred, the
elite corps of the Hyakki Empire.
 Supremely confident in his own
intellect, he developed the Hyakki
mecha Mecha Tekkoki himself and
used it to challenge Getter Robo.
 His combat ability was also
first-rate, skillful enough to
fight Getter Robo to a standstill
and beyond. But when Hidler's
tank forced its way into the
battle, his pride was wounded, and
he turned his blade on Hidler to
protect Getter Robo. Then,
battered and bloodied, he
challenged Getter to a fair
rematch.
30.DSC2:
Tekkoki was one of the Hyakki
Hundred, the elite group of the
Hyakki Empire.
 He had absolute confidence in his
own intellect, and developed the
Hyakki mecha Mecha Tekkoki to
defeat Getter Robo, challenging it
to battle.
 His combat ability was also
first-rate, showing skill enough
to fight Getter to a standstill or
better. However, when Hidler's
tank cut in, his pride was
wounded, and he turned his blade
on Hidler to protect Getter.
Then, while battered and
exhausted, he boldly challenged
Getter to a rematch. The battle
was decided by Getter Dragon's
Spin Cutter, and came to a close
with Tekkoki's death.

31.DSCR:
One of the Hyakki Hundred, the
elite corps of the Hyakki Empire.
 He had been transforming dam
workers and security guards into
Hyakki soldiers, and after his
predecessor Ikkakuki fell to
Getter Robo, he took over the plan
to steal the Getter Ray
amplifier.
 Making use of his Hyakki robot's
special traits, he attempted to
attack the Saotome Institute by
tunneling up from underground.
31.DSC2:
Dokuganki was one of the Hyakki
Hundred, the elite group of the
Hyakki Empire.
 He was converting dam employees
and security guards into Hyakki
soldiers, but since his
predecessor Ikkakuki had been
defeated by Getter, he took over
and plotted to seize the Getter
Ray amplifier.
 He attempted to attack the
Saotome Research Institute from
underground, making use of his
Hyakki robot's characteristics.
However, while advancing
underground, he was dragged out by
Getter Liger and killed by four
consecutive missiles.

32.DSCR:
A veteran warrior among the
Hyakki Hundred, the elite corps of
the Hyakki Empire.
 Once so formidable that he was
called a hero of the skies, he had
retired from active duty in his
old age. But when Hidler lied to
him that his son Gyuugaki had been
killed by Getter Robo, he resolved
to seek revenge.
 Even in old age his skill had not
faded, and his battle-hardened
prowess put the Getter Team
through real hardship.
32.DSC2:
Gyukenki was a veteran of the
Hyakki Hundred, the elite group of
the Hyakki Empire.
 He was a man of such skill that
he was once called the Hero of the
Sky, but due to old age he had
retired from active duty.
However, due to Hidler's lie that
his son, Gyugaki, had been killed
by Getter, he resolved to take
revenge.
 Even in his old age, his skill
had not waned, and with his
combat-hardened experience he
troubled the Getter team. But
when Ryouma pointed out that 'You,
who taught him nothing but
fighting, are the one who killed
your son,' the shock he received
became the cause of his defeat.

33.DSCR:
The pilot of KuRaiOh and main
pilot of God Sigma. Eighteen
years old.
 A man who loved space, believed
in the future, and fought
single-mindedly for peace. Though
he comes from Io, he speaks with
the brisk, plainspoken manner of a
true Edokko, a native of old
Tokyo, and he is warmhearted,
spirited, and hot-blooded, never
one to fuss over small details.
 On Io, he had experience helping
build an ionium refinery using
mining robots, giving him an edge
when it comes to piloting
machinery. Even KuRaiOh, which he
boarded in an emergency during an
Elder attack, he handled as
naturally as his own limbs.
 He is also a formidable fighter
unarmed, and his jumping kick in
particular packs a fierce punch.
 Though he and Teral, the Elder
commander, are enemies, Toshiya
seems to sense something in him
not unlike himself.
33.DSC2:
Toshiya Dan was the main pilot of
KuRaiOh and God Sigma. He was
18 years old.
 He was a man who loved space,
believed in the future, and fought
wholeheartedly for peace. Though
he was from Io, he spoke with the
brisk accent of an Edoite, and was
a broad-minded, spirited, and
passionate man who did not fuss
over details.
 On Io, he had experience helping
build the ionium refinery using
mining robots, and had an edge
when it came to operating
machines. When the Elder Army
attacked and he was forced to
board KuRaiOh in an emergency, he
handled it as if it were an
extension of his own limbs.
 He possessed considerable combat
ability even in his bare body, and
his kick, especially when
delivered from a jump, was
ferocious.
 During the war with the Elders,
he came to sympathize with the
ideals of the enemy commander
Teral, and eventually they became
friends who called each other by
name.
 In the final battle, after
witnessing Teral's death as his
strength gave out mid-purpose, he
alone cornered Gagaarn. Every
bullet Gagaarn sprayed wildly in
his last resistance seemed to be
blocked by an unseen force, and
none struck Toshiya. But the
bullets Toshiya fired for his
fallen comrades and for peace
pierced Gagaarn for certain.
 After it was all over, he
departed alone with God Sigma into
the distant future.

34.DSCR:
The pilot of KaiMeiOh.
Twenty-one years old.
 An extremely cool-headed and
sharp-tongued man, whose
too-accurate observations often
stir up trouble. At heart,
though, he is honest and
straightforward - his foul mouth
is simply his way of covering up
an inability to be candid.
 He also serves as chief engineer
at Trinity Base and is the
second-sharpest mind there after
Dr. Kazami. A hard worker, he
has made it his goal to one day
surpass Dr. Kazami himself.
 His attachment to money runs
strong enough to seem miserly,
though there appears to be some
deeper reason behind it.
34.DSC2:
Julie Noguchi is the pilot of the
sea-shaking king. He is 21
years old.\nHe is a very cool and
sharp-tongued man, and his overly
accurate observations often cause
trouble. However, at heart he is
an upright man, and his harsh
words are simply because he cannot
be honest. At Trinity Base, he
also serves as chief engineer,
possessing intellect second only
to Dr. Kazami. He is a hard
worker who aims to surpass Dr.
Kazami someday. His attachment to
money is so strong that he could
be taken for a miser, but this is
because he is desperately saving
up to go pick up his mother and
younger sister who are on Io,
revealing his deep feelings for
his family. After Dr. Kazami was
dazzled by Elder technology and
betrayed them, he deciphered the
method to release the lock on the
Trinity Engine, and used the
base's Trinity energy to
successfully combine God Sigma, so
without his intellect the Earth
side's victory would not have been
possible. After the battle with
Gagan ended, he saw off Toshiya
who was departing with the words
of encouragement 'Leave Io to
me.'

35.DSCR:
The pilot of RikuShinOh.
 He lost both parents before his
own eyes in an Elder attack, yet
his bright, straightforward
personality shows none of that
tragedy. That said, he is also a
flatterer, a show-off, and
something of a daredevil. Perhaps
because they are close in
maturity, he gets along especially
well with Rie's younger brother
Shouta, who looks up to him like
an older brother.
 Hopeless with machines by nature,
he could not even handle
RikuShinOh well at first. But
when he learned that God Sigma
could be formed and that KuRaiOh
would be its main unit, he pushed
Toshiya aside and climbed into
KuRaiOh himself. KuRaiOh's
onboard computer, however,
declared as a piloting
requirement, "Fighting spirit
alone is not enough. A calm mind
and trained skill are required,"
making him painfully aware of what
he lacked. From then on, through
sheer grit, he gradually managed
to get the hang of at least
RikuShinOh.
35.DSC2:
Kensaku Kira is the pilot of the
land-shaking king. He lost both
parents before his eyes to the
Elder attack, but he has a bright
and straightforward personality
that does not show that tragedy.
However, he is a bit of a fool, a
show-off, and also has a reckless
side. Perhaps because their
mental ages are close, he gets
along especially well with Rie's
younger brother Shota, and is
looked up to as a big brother
figure. He is a natural klutz
with machines, and at first could
not even pilot the land-shaking
king well. But when he learned
that combining into God Sigma was
possible, and that the sky-shaking
king would be the core unit, he
climbed into the sky-shaking king,
pushing Toshiya aside. However,
the sky-shaking king's internal
computer declared as a piloting
condition: 'Fighting spirit alone

 Though born into the prestigious

Learning that he was the Anomaly

participate in the caravan.

69.DSCR:
President of Chiram and supreme
commander of its military. His
full name is Jeffrey White.
 He issued the order to capture

chaotic spacetime world and erase
Mu, Chiram's greatest enemy. He
later pushed forward 'Plan D,' a

artificially triggering another
spacetime vibration through

 He was originally an
approachable, cheerful, and

at Blue Fixer members in fits of
rage.
 He later volunteered to join Blue
Fixer in order to defeat his
archenemy Gattler, and with the

fellow Blue Fixer members.
