sided with the military. This
appeared to be a painful decision
made to deal with various
problems, such as the slow-moving
diplomacy and food shortages.
Deep in his heart, his loyalty to
Dianna remained rooted, and when
Dianna returned to Earth, he once
again became her subject. After
the battle with Ghingnham, he
followed Dianna (Kiel) and
returned to the Moon.

167.DSCR:
Sochie Heim was the second
daughter of the Heim family, for
whom Loran worked as a servant.
She was 15 years old. Her
personality was competitive,
spirited, and boyish. Although
she was concerned about Loran, her
own position and temperament
prevented her from being honest
about her feelings. To avenge her
father, who died in an attack by
the Dianna Counter, she
volunteered for the Ingressa
Militia and became a Kapool
pilot. Because of this, she was
initially hardened with hatred
toward the Moonrace. However,
through learning Loran's true
identity and the affair with
Gavane, who loved her and even
proposed to her, she grew greatly
as a person.

fulfilled, and she exchanged a
tearful farewell kiss with Loran,
who chose to go with Dianna.
Afterwards, she threw Loran's
goldfish toy into the river,
parting with her own feelings.

168.DSCR:
Meschee Kun was born into a
family of airplane makers that had
run the business since her
grandfather's generation, and she
herself flew through the skies as
an airplane pilot. She was 18
years old. She belonged to the
Ingressa Militia's airplane
division and had fought since the
outbreak of war. She had a
friendship that could be called
close with Sochie, and after the
Kapool was excavated, the two
often rode into battle together.
When she went to the Moon, she
became friendly with a boy soldier
of the Dianna Counter and sortied
together with him in a WaD.
168.DSC2:

through the sky as an airplane

She belonged to the airplane unit

to the Moon, she became friendly
with a boy soldier of the Dianna
Counter, and sortied together with
him in a WaD. Her relationship
with this boy seems to have
continued even after the war
ended.

169.DSCR:
Corin Nander was a sergeant in
the Dianna Counter. In the past,
he had been subjected to a
freezing sentence in a military
prison along with his Eagail for
the reason that he had massacred
85 rebel elements who had tried
to kill Dianna without holding a
trial. As his actions made clear,
his loyalty to Dianna was twice as
strong as that of others. He was
released under the pretext of a
pardon to participate in the Earth
Return Operation and descended to
Earth. However, this was believed
to have been arranged by Agrippa,
who sought to throw the front
lines into confusion by sending
the reckless Corin in. Due to the
freezing and errors during
thawing, his hair had fallen out
and part of his face had become
altered, but it was said that he
had originally been a handsome man
with blond hair. He showed an
abnormal obsession and hostility
toward 'Gundam' and continued to
target the Turn A Gundam.

170.DSCR:
Corin Nander was a former
sergeant of the Dianna Counter.
After being defeated by Loran, he
entered the priesthood and
wandered the land, but upon seeing
the light of the M-Fly released by
Merrybell's Turn A Gundam, he
remembered his own mission. He
then went to Dianna, and when he
was permitted to return to the
military and to destroy the
Turn-type Gundam, he was so
overcome with emotion that he shed
tears. His unrestrained behavior,
such as having a Kapool repainted
in his own private colors,
continued to astonish those around
him. However, his skill had not
declined, and he performed aerial
combat in a Kapool, which should
have been unfamiliar to him,
overwhelming the Mahiroo unit with
his exploits.
170.DSC2:

activated its M-Fly, he
deliberately stole fuel from the
Kapools of Sochie and Meshee,
leaving the two of them far from
the battlefield, and went alone to
his death.

171.DSCR:
is a young man who works on
excavation operations in the
Mountain Cycle as a disciple of
the prospector Sid. He is 23
years old.
 He was born into the minority
Maban tribe, and as a child his
parents were killed in tribal
warfare. He was abandoned in the
mountains and taken in by Sid.
Because of this background, he
harbored a rivalry that could be
called hostility toward the
Northern Ameliaans and the
Moonrace, and his attitude toward
Loran in particular was harsh.
 His extensive knowledge of
machinery was recognized, and he
joined the Militia's mobile suit
unit, where he came to command the
Jarapi (junk car) squad.
 While riding in the Flat that
Loran and the others used during
their descent to Earth, he fought
in it, and he gradually developed
a close relationship with Fran,
who had taught him how to pilot
it.
171.DSC2:

it. After peace came, he seems to
have quit the prospector's trade
for the sake of his family, and he
was seen carrying the child he had
with Fran while working hard at
his new job as a fishmonger.

172.DSCR:
is an old man known as a
prospector, an excavator, and also
a researcher of the Black
History.
 Together with his disciple
Joseph, he excavates machines such
as the Kapool from the Mountain
Cycle. Through his involvement in
commanding the excavation of
weapons, he came to accompany the
Militia.
 He showed vitality beyond his
years in many places, dashing
between excavation sites without
sparing time for sleep, and when
manpower was short, boarding a
Borjarnon to intercept the enemy.
 His trademark was a helmet with
an attached flashlight,
reminiscent of a frog, that seemed
convenient for excavation work.
172.DSC2:
Sid Munza was an old man called a

History. Together with his
disciple Joseph, he excavated
Kapools and other artifacts from

intercept the enemy, showing

scene. His trademark was a helmet

seemed convenient for excavation
work. After the fighting ended,
he returned to prospecting with
Poe, who appeared to have been
taken on as a new disciple in
place of Joseph, who had started a
family.

173.DSCR:
is the grandson of the lord of
Ingressa and the central figure of
the Ingressa Militia. He is 19
years old.
 Though raised as a pampered young
master, he had no sense of being
naive about the world. He showed
shrewdness in using whatever was
available to him, and talent in
negotiation, politics, and
judgment, and these were further
honed through battle.
 Even when confronted with the
Moonrace's overwhelming
technology, he was not crushed,
but instead secretly planned to
use that technology to bring about
an industrial revolution. Even
when Ingressa fell and he lost
power, he resolved to climb back
up from there, making him an
ambitious man with resilience.
 He had a strong fixation on
Loran, calling him 'Laura' and
having him dress in women's
clothing.
173.DSC2:
Guin Sard Rheinford was the
grandson of the Ingressa lord and
a central figure of the Ingressa
Militia. He was 19 years old.
Though raised as a young master,

about the world, and showed a

acumen, and judgment, all of which

technology, he was not crushed,

an industrial revolution. Even
when Ingressa fell and he lost
power, he resolved to climb back

fixation on Loran, calling him
'Laura' and making him dress in
women's clothing. Even when he
betrayed Dianna, he tried to bring
only Loran over to his side, and
this obsession went somewhat
beyond the bounds of reason. In
the epilogue, he was confirmed to
have crossed to Gallia together
with Merrybell, whom he had saved
with his own hands.

174.DSCR:
is the commander of the Ingressa
Militia. His rank is colonel. He
is 35 years old.
 He believes that the Moonrace are
invaders of Earth and that the
fight against them is a matter of
defending his homeland. For this
reason, he seemed displeased with
Guin, whom he considered a mere
figurehead and who viewed war as
nothing more than one means of
negotiation.
 However, he was swept along by
the rapidly changing situation and
by Guin's resourcefulness in
forming strategies to match, and
in the end he followed him all the
way to the final battle.
174.DSC2:
Michael Guern was the commander
of the Ingressa Militia, with the
rank of colonel. He was 35
years old. He believed that the
Moonrace were invaders of Earth
and that fighting them was a
matter of defending his homeland.
For this reason, he seemed
displeased that Guin, whom he
considered a mere figurehead,
viewed the war as nothing more
than one means of negotiation.
However, he was tossed about by
the rapidly changing situation and
by Guin's drive in formulating
strategies to match it, and in the
end he followed along all the way
to the final battle. But when the
Willgem crashed down and Guin's
ambitions came to an end, he at
the same time abandoned him and
went his own way.

175.DSCR:
Gavane Gooney is the captain of
the Suisai Squad, the elite mobile
suit unit of the Rujana Militia.
He is 27 years old.
 He has a cheerful personality,
but on the battlefield he is a
fierce commander who always leads
from the front, earning him deep
trust from his subordinates. He
thinks flexibly, changing tactics
to suit the situation.
 When he first met the Ingressa
Militia, he treated Loran and the
others with contempt, calling them
'Ingressa bastards' and
challenging the Turn A Gundam to a
test of strength. But as they
fought together, he came to
acknowledge them as comrades in
arms. In particular, he was drawn
to Sochie, whom he called 'little
miss,' by her earnest way of
fighting, and he eventually went
so far as to propose to her.

shed tears.

176.DSCR:
Lily Borjarnon is the 13th and
youngest daughter of Duke
Borjarnon, the lord of the Lujane
domain. Her personality is
selfish and naive, and her
carefree attitude of not
understanding war is exactly that
of a young lady. However, her
insight into matters and her
observational ability to judge a
person's true nature are
extraordinary. She has known Guin
since childhood, and there were
scenes where she harassed Kiel
(Dianna) for approaching him.
However, she eventually came to
admire Kiel, who served as Queen
of the Moon in Dianna's place, and
offered to become her friend.
176.DSC2:
Lili Borjano is the thirteenth

Borjano, lord of Rujan. Her
personality is selfish and naive
about the world, and her
lighthearted inability to
comprehend war is just like a
young lady of privilege. However,
she possesses extraordinary
insight into matters and keen
observational skills for judging a
person's true character. She had
known Guin since childhood, and
was seen harassing Kiel, who was
acting as Dianna, when she
approached him. Eventually,
however, she came to admire Kiel,
who served as Queen of the Moon in

become her friend. When she was
betrayed by Guin, she showed no
sign of being shaken, and instead
displayed a strong core by
attempting to stop his actions.
She once even proposed to Loran,
saying 'Become Laura and seduce
Guin.' This may have been a
reflection of her wounded heart,
stemming from being disregarded as
a woman.

177.DSCR:
Horace Niven is a Moonrace
engineer. Initially he acted
alongside the Dianna Counter that
accompanied him, but he defected
to Earth, driven by his
intellectual curiosity toward the
excavated Earth weapons.
Thereafter, at Guin's request, he
came to cooperate with the
Ingressa Militia. There were many
places where he could demonstrate
his abilities, such as the
research, analysis, repair, and
maintenance of excavated weapons
including the Turn A Gundam.
Although most Earthlings did not
look favorably upon the Moonrace
engineers, they seemed not to care
much, perhaps because they were
only interested in unknown
technology. He had a distinctive
face like a Great Buddha statue,
and Merrybell, whose face
resembled a panda's, told him he
had an 'amusing face.'

178.DSCR:
Harry Ord serves as captain of
the Dianna Counter's elite guard.
He is 18 years old and holds the
rank of lieutenant. His
personality is calm and
intellectual, but because he is
overly earnest, he also has an
inflexible side. He has sworn
absolute loyalty to Dianna, and
the depth of his devotion is so
famous that even an ordinary
female soldier knows of it. He
was the first to notice the swap
between Dianna and Kiel, but he
continued to serve without
changing his attitude and
protected Kiel. He always wears
red sunglasses, which are
night-vision goggles, and
according to him, they serve to
'hide his gaze when looking at
women other than Dianna.' He did
not even remove them when kissing
Kiel, who had developed feelings
for him, but it seems he was not
disliked for that. His skill
piloting his gold-colored custom
SUMO is top-class. At the Winter
Palace, he took on the Mahiroo
squad led by Suesson and defeated
them in seconds with a single
unit, which shows his true
ability. He favored suits and
vests in a yellow-and-black
combination, and pajamas with star
marks, leaving his fashion sense
open to question.

179.DSCR:
Meme Midgard is a Moonrace who
infiltrated Earth on Agrippa's
orders. His rank is captain.
While serving as the manager of
Keith's bread factory as a cover,
he plotted the assassination of
Dianna and the seizure of the Turn
A Gundam. He had a sly and
suspicious personality, and when
he judged that Teteth, whom he had
ordered to assassinate Dianna, had
failed her mission, he shot her
dead to silence her. The
marksmanship he displayed at that
time was considerable.
Furthermore, after returning to
the Moon, he resorted to
outrageous acts such as fighting a
battle that involved the Winter
Palace, where many citizens were
in cryogenic sleep. However, that
action became the trigger for
activating the M-Fly.

Dianna's law.'

180.DSCR:
Teteth Halle is a woman who
plotted to assassinate Dianna
under Midgard's orders. She was
born between a Moonrace and a
woman whom Dianna had once brought
back from Earth to the Moon.
Because she was raised with
discrimination from a young age,
she harbored intense hatred toward
everything around her, including
Dianna, the lunar system, and her
Earthling blood. As a reward for
the assassination, she had secured
a promise from Midgard to make her
an honorary citizen of the Moon.
180.DSC2:

was born to a woman Dianna had
brought back from Earth to the
Moon, and a Moonrace man. Having
grown up facing discrimination

Midgard, who feared the matter
would come to light. Later, a
scene was broadcast showing her
mother Linda waking from cryogenic
sleep and searching for her
daughter, which only emphasized
the tragedy further.

181.DSCR:
Phil Ackermann was a lieutenant
in the Dianna Counter and became
the commander of the Earth descent
operation after the death of his
predecessor. He looked down on
Earthlings as barbarians and
advocated for subjugation by
force. However, taking advantage
of Dianna's departure from Earth
while she sought peaceful
coexistence, he rose in rebellion
and declared the founding of the
Sunbelt Republic. At one point he
even displayed the ambition of
becoming the king of Earth, but in
the end he swore his loyalty to
Dianna once again. He then united
with the Earth side, despite
lingering ill feelings, and fought
against the Ghingnham fleet.
181.DSC2:

182.DSCR:
Poe Eiji was a lieutenant in the
Dianna Counter. She descended to
Earth as a pilot of a Wodom under
Phil's command. Her interception
of the Militia's airplane forces
became the opening of the long
conflict between Earth and the
Moon. She was quick to tears,
weeping at every turn, and her
tearfulness even became the
subtitle of episode 31. She
appears to have been in a romantic
relationship with her superior
Phil, and she followed him when he
rebelled against Dianna. Yet,
deep in her heart, her loyalty to
the queen remained rooted, and
when Dianna returned, she wept
tears of joy.
182.DSC2:
Poe Eiji was a second lieutenant

Wodom under Phil's command. Her

airplane squadron became the

conflict between Earth and the

apprentice.

183.DSCR:
Ghingnham Gym was the head of the
Ghingnham family, which governed
the martial arts of the Moonrace,
and the supreme commander of the
Ghingnham space fleet. True to
his words that 'battle itself is
my reason for existence,' he
always carried a sword and
personally boarded the Turn X to
go to the front lines. This
behavior stemmed from his intense
pride in being a man of the
warrior class. Ordinarily he held
a calm and broad-minded view, but
once battle began, he revealed his
arrogant and belligerent nature.
As a result, he would become so
excited that he lost sight of his
surroundings and would attack
friend and foe alike, exposing his
battle mania. His greatest reason
for opposing Dianna was his
resentment that she had organized
the Dianna Counter on her own and
descended to Earth, ignoring those
like himself who had spent
2,500 years repeating drills.
Conversely, this also proved that
he held strong loyalty toward
Dianna.

go to the front lines. This
behavior stemmed from his intense
pride in being a man of the
warrior class. Usually he was
calm and held broad-minded views,
but once battle began, he revealed
his arrogant and belligerent true
nature. As a result, he became so
excited that he lost sight of his
surroundings, exposing his battle
mania by attacking friend and foe
alike without distinction. The
greatest reason he opposed Dianna
was his resentment that she had
ignored him and his people, who
had repeated exercises for
2500 years, and had
independently organized the Dianna
Counter to descend to Earth.
Conversely, this also served as
proof of his strong loyalty to
Dianna. Against Loran's Turn A
Gundam, which he recognized as his
sworn enemy, he fought to a draw
even in the final battle, with
both machines destroyed. Mere
moments after escaping, he then
faced Loran in personal combat
with swords, but during that
struggle he was swallowed by the
cocoon of the Moonlight Butterfly
and returned to the Earth along
with the two Turn-type machines.

184.DSCR:
Suesson Sterro was the captain
leading the Mahiroo squad of the
Ghingnham fleet. He was rough in
temperament, vulgar in character,
and casually imposed unreasonable
demands on his subordinates.
Midgard's assessment of him as 'a
water blister leaning on the
prestige of a distinguished
family' was apt, as he was a man
full of flaws. His fighting style
also lacked flexibility, as he
could only perform formulaic
movements due to having conducted
nothing but drills within the
fleet.

185.DSCR:
Merrybell Gadget was a girl said
to be Ghingnham's puppet. She
came from the lowest class of the
Moon and had been picked up by
Ghingnham in the past. Her
appearance - a bizarre outfit that
also served as a spacesuit, large
earmuffs, eye makeup, and bells on
her head - along with her agility,
such as performing handstands even
on Earth with its six times the
Moon's gravity, evoked the image
of a clown. She preferred to be
near capable and amusing
individuals such as Ghingnham and
Guin, and she would throw out
words and actions that incited war
toward them. Despite what her
demeanor suggested, she possessed
exceptional mobile suit piloting
skill and maneuvered the Bandit as
if it were an extension of her own
limbs. Her coordination with
unmanned mobile suits seemed to
rely on a special ability she
possessed, but the details
remained unknown.

the Moonrace. As the
administrative official in charge

 He had set the maintenance of
tranquility and peace in lunar

Earthlings would awaken the
instinct for conflict in the

reason, he opposed the Earth

various acts of sabotage, such as
delaying supplies and plotting the
assassination of Dianna.

187.DSCR:
Keith Laijie is a Moonrace youth

years ago along with Loran and
Fran as an advance surveyor for
the return to Earth.
 He was working as an apprentice
at the Donkey bakery in Nox.
However, when the Dianna Counter
descended, he took over the shop
along with the master's daughter
Berlune after the master was
injured.
 He sold the flat he had used

bread factory, and actively hired

positive attitude of doing his
best at what he could do greatly
contributed to bridging Earth and
the Moon at the civilian level.
 Whether as a result of his
efforts or not, his bread-making
skill was excellent, and its taste
was highly praised by both
Earthlings and Moonrace alike.

189.DSCR:
Garrod Ran is a boy of 15 who
survives in the devastated world
by his own strength without
relying on others.
 He is a war orphan, but has a
bright and forward-looking
personality that shows no sense of
tragedy. Perhaps because his
father was a military scientist,
he is skilled in handling
machinery in general. Behind that
may have been a desire to become
an engineer like his father.
Before boarding the Freeden, he
used his natural resourcefulness
and cunning to hunt Mobile Suits
and sell them to junk dealers,
living toughly. Perhaps learned
from such a life, he once opened
the locks of the Freeden and the
Bradman residence using only
wire.
 His Mobile Suit piloting skill
was genius-level, and he quickly
mastered the Gundam X and the
Gundam Double X on his first
flights. Even in his first battle
in space, he grasped the knack in
an extremely short time.
Lancelow, who witnessed his high
adaptability, could not hide his
astonishment.
 During a certain job, he met the
Newtype girl Tiffa and fell in
love at first sight. From then
on, he continued to show
single-minded devotion, plunging
into fire, water, sea, or space
without regard for danger if it
was for her sake.
 Though self-proclaimed, the
epithet 'Pilot of the Flaming
Mobile Suit' accurately describes
him, for better or worse.

190.DSCR:
Tiffa Adill is a naturally
awakened Newtype girl of 15,
born after the 7th Space War, who
was whispered to be impossible.
She exhibits powers that could be
called psychic abilities, such as
future sight, danger detection,
and heightened perception (the
Newtypes of 'Gundam X' differ in
meaning from the Newtypes of
previous Gundam series).
 Many organizations targeted her
as research material for these
abilities, and she was rescued by
Jamil and the others from
confinement in a Newtype research
facility. After boarding the
Freeden, she became the group's
guide and ultimately reached the
D.O.M.E. on the Moon.
 Although her Newtype abilities
were sought after by those around
her, she herself feared them. She
also detested people fighting over
this power, and so lived with her
heart half-closed. However, she
gradually opened up to Garrod, who
treated her as an ordinary girl,
and eventually came to express her
feelings outwardly.
 In the midst of battle, she
wished to be of help to Garrod and
other precious people, and the
power heightened by that feeling
became a factor in opening the
D.O.M.E. on the Moon.

191.DSCR:
Jamil Neate is the captain of the
Freeden, a ship dedicated to the
search and protection of
Newtypes. He is 30 years old.
 In addition to not showing his
emotions, the sunglasses he always
wears give him an even more
taciturn impression. However, the
crew of the Freeden place immense
trust in their captain, revealing
his human charm.
 During the 7th Space War, he
belonged to the Earth Federation
Forces and was a Newtype who
served as the pilot of the Gundam
X. But in the final phase of the
war, he pulled the trigger that
became the catalyst for the
greatest tragedy in human history,
the 'Colony Drop'. That guilt
became a trauma, and he lost all
of his Newtype abilities.
 He suffered from a fear of
cockpits that developed from his
trauma, but he overcame it through

Thereafter, he piloted the Gundam
X Divider and played an active
role.

195.DSCR:
Witz Sou is a mobile suit pilot
hired by the Freeden. He is 17
years old.
 He has a manly personality in
every sense, and he is the type
who acts before he speaks. His
language is also quite rough.
 He was originally a freelance
mobile suit pilot, and the Gundam
Air Master was a keepsake from a
Vulture who had taken care of him
in the past. Initially, he gave
the impression of a money-grubber
who fought only for pay, but that
was all to make life easier for
his family back home.
 His father had been killed by a
mobile suit pilot in the past, and
while he agonized over not being
able to reveal his job to his
mother, who hated that profession,
he possessed the kindness to keep
fighting for his family.
 He eventually signed an exclusive
contract with the Freeden, with
which he had various connections.
Witz rationalized it by saying
that the Freeden was suitable as a
hiding place for the gold he
earned, but it is thought that one
of the reasons was that he wanted
to be near Toniya, for whom he had
secretly developed feelings.

However, when the Freeden, which

into crisis, he rushed to its aid,

eventually signed an exclusive

collect membership fees from the
crew. However, under Sara's

no money could be collected from
children (under 15), so Garrod

use it. He is flirtatious and
frivolous, skilled with both his
hands and his tongue, and his
hobby is seducing women. He has
lovers in various places, and he
is diligent enough to find time to
visit them under the pretext of
aftercare. However, the woman he
truly loved has already passed
away, and his beloved Gundam
Leopard is her memento. His
current true love is Sara. He
seems to harbor surprisingly
sincere feelings for her and
constantly makes advances on her.
