grudge. Later, she met Toniya,
who was out in town during
half-deck rest, and as their
friendship as women deepened, a
change was born in her heart.
Afterwards, her life was saved by
the Freeden, and she subsequently
came to cooperate with Garrod as
well. In the epilogue, though the
circumstances are unknown, she
appeared in Witz's hometown
together with Roybea, and together
with Toniya, the two of them toyed
with the menfolk.

198.DSCR:
Kid Salsamill is the chief
mechanic of the Freeden. As the
youngest crew member at 12 years
old, he serves as chief, which
shows that his mechanical skill
and knowledge rival those of an
adult. Besides maintaining mobile
suits, he is quite versatile,
creating simulators for Bit
attacks and adjusting the
combination mechanism of the
G-Falcon. Jamil never interferes
with his work, indicating that he
places great trust in him. He
constantly hoards useful parts and
ideas, and it was his handiwork
that powered up the various Gundam
units, including the Gundam X, the
Airmaster, and the Leopard.
198.DSC2:
Kid is the chief mechanic of the
Freeden. As can be seen from the
fact that he serves as chief at
the young age of 12, the
youngest of the crew, his
mechanical skills and knowledge
rival those of adults. He is
quite versatile, handling mobile
suit maintenance of course, but
also creating simulators for bit
attacks and adjusting the
combining mechanisms of the G
Falcon. Jamil never interferes
with his work, which suggests he
places great trust in Kid. He is
constantly stockpiling useful
parts and ideas, and it was his
handiwork that powered up the
various Gundams, including the
Gundam X, the Airmaster, and the
Leopard. After the Freeden
fulfilled its role, he began
running a junk shop called
'Freeden III' together with
Shingo, Pala, and his subordinate
mechanics.

199.DSCR:
Tex Farzenberg is the exclusive
physician of the Freeden. 36
years old. His ability as a
doctor is extremely high, and he
handles all kinds of work, from
internal medicine to surgery, as
well as psychological care. As
the oldest crew member, he
possesses deep experience and the
composure of an adult. Jamil
trusts him deeply and often
consulted with him. He is a
voracious reader and once recited
the contents of 'Lorelei' by the
German poet Heine. His hobby is
billiards, and his skill in that
area is considerable, as he won
decisively in a match against
Roybea with the usage fee for the
relaxation room at stake. Later,
when most of the crew went out for
supplies, he tried to take the
opportunity to do secret training,
but was flustered when Sara and
Toniya witnessed the scene,
revealing an unexpectedly
childlike side.
199.DSC2:
Tex is the Freeden's dedicated
physician. He is 36 years old.
His ability as a doctor is
extremely high, and he handles all
kinds of work, from internal
medicine to surgery, and even
mental care. As the oldest of the
crew, he possesses deep experience
and the composure of an adult.
Jamil also trusts him deeply, and
he often served as a sounding
board for Jamil's concerns. He is
quite a bibliophile, and once
recited the contents of 'Lorelei'
by the German poet Heine. His
hobby is billiards, and his skill
at this is also considerable; in
a match with Roybea wagering the
usage fee for the relaxation room,
he won a splendid victory. Later,
when most of the crew went out for
supplies, he tried to conduct
secret training, thinking it was a
good opportunity, and was seen by
Sara and Toniya, panicking -
showing an unexpectedly childlike
side. After the Freeden was
disbanded, he served at a field
hospital. He offered a cup to two
enemy soldiers arguing with each
other and said, 'Most problems can
be solved in your heart while
drinking one cup of coffee. The
rest is just a matter of whether
you can put it into action,'
showing his adult composure to the
very end.

200.DSCR:
Pala Sys is a pilot of the
G-Falcon, belonging to the
resistance organization Satelicon
against the Space Revolutionary
Army. 15 years old. She lost
both parents, who were space
refugees, soon after her birth.
Having grown up in an environment
surrounded by men, her language is
rough, and she often blurts out
things like 'That's lame.' Her
personality is also as masculine
as possible, but when Satelicon
was destroyed, tears of sorrow,
and after achieving the
destruction of the colonial laser
that was her true goal, tears of
joy streamed down her cheeks. At
that moment, her face was that of
a girl her age. She hit it off
with Garrod when she saved him
from a pinch in space, and they
came to fight together.
Afterwards, when she joined the
Freeden, she got along well with
Kid, who was a kindred spirit.
200.DSC2:
Pala is a G Falcon pilot
belonging to Saterikon, a
resistance organization against
the Space Revolutionary Army. She
is 15 years old. Her parents,
who were space refugees, died soon
after she was born. Having grown
up in an environment surrounded
only by men, she blurts out rough
words like 'that's lame' and her
speech is crude. Her personality
is also extremely boyish, but when
Saterikon was annihilated, tears
of sadness, and after achieving
the destruction of the Colony
Laser, her true aspiration, tears
of joy flowed down her cheeks.
Her face at that time was that of
a girl her age. She hit it off
with Garrod when she helped him
out of a pinch in space, and they
came to fight together.
Afterwards, when she became a
member of the Freeden, she got
along with Kid, who was a kindred
spirit. After the war ended, she
seems to have found a new place
for herself at the junk shop
'Freeden III' that she started
with Kid, Shingo, and the others.

201.DSCR:
Shagia Frost is the elder of the
notorious Frost brothers, free
mobile suit pilots. He is 19
years old. His appearance as a
free mobile suit pilot is a
cover; his true identity is an
agent of the New Federation's
intelligence agency. He possesses
the telepathic ability 'Twins'
Synchronity,' which allows him to
communicate with his fraternal
twin brother Olba without words.
This enables them to avoid danger
for each other and to conduct
operations even from distant
locations. However, despite such
abilities, they were not
recognized under the supremacy of
Newtypes and were branded with the
'Category F' label. As a result,
he came to hate Newtypes and
everything in the world that
acknowledged their existence. His
personality is cruel and ruthless,
and he stops at nothing to achieve
his goals. He killed his targets
of revenge and those who had
outlived their usefulness one
after another, sometimes with his
beloved Gundam Virsago and
sometimes by directly pointing a
gun at them. He was always calm
and composed, able to accurately
assess the surrounding situation
and the tide of battle. He often
admonished Olba, whose blood would
rush to his head and lose sight of
the situation.
201.DSC2:
An infamous freelance mobile suit
pilot. The elder of the Frost
brothers. 19 years old. His
career as a freelance mobile suit
pilot was a cover; in truth, he
was an agent of the New Federation
military intelligence agency. He
possessed the telepathic ability
'Twins Synchronity,' which allowed
him to communicate with his
fraternal twin brother Olba
without speaking a word. This
allowed them to avoid danger for
each other and to carry out
operations even from distant
locations. However, despite
possessing such abilities, he was
not recognized under Newtype
supremacism and was branded with
the mark of 'Category F.' As a
result, he came to hate Newtypes
and all of the world that
acknowledged their existence. His
personality was cruel and vicious,
and he stopped at nothing to
achieve his goals. He killed his
targets of revenge and those whose
use had expired one after another,
sometimes with his beloved Gundam
Virsago and sometimes by pointing
a gun directly at them. He was
also always calm and collected,
able to accurately assess his
surroundings and the tide of
battle. He frequently chided
Olba, who would lose his head and
lose sight of the situation, but
during the final battle with
Garrod, he forcibly fired a
satellite launcher that was
insufficiently charged, despite
Olba's attempts to stop him.
After the war ended, he was seen
in a corner of a certain town,
pushing Olba's wheelchair while
watching Garrod and Tiffa set out
on their journey.

202.DSCR:
Olba Frost is the younger of the
notorious Frost brothers, free
mobile suit pilots. He is 19
years old. His appearance as a
free mobile suit pilot is a
cover; his true identity is an
agent of the New Federation's
intelligence agency. He possesses
the telepathic ability 'Twins'
Synchronity,' which allows him to
communicate with his fraternal
twin brother Shagia without
words. This enables them to avoid
danger for each other and to
conduct operations even from
distant locations. However,
despite such abilities, they were
not recognized under the supremacy
of Newtypes and were branded with
the 'Category F' label. As a
result, he came to hate Newtypes
and everything in the world that
acknowledged their existence. His
personality is cold and heartless,
and he stops at nothing to achieve
his goals. But that was only his
outward face; hidden within his
refined features was a passion
beyond imagination. He was often
restrained by Shagia when his
blood rushed to his head and he
lost sight of the situation.
202.DSC2:
An infamous freelance mobile suit
pilot. The younger of the Frost
brothers. 19 years old. His
career as a freelance mobile suit
pilot was a cover; in truth, he
was an agent of the New Federation
military intelligence agency. He
possessed the telepathic ability
'Twins Synchronity,' which allowed
him to communicate with his
fraternal twin brother Shagia
without speaking a word. This
allowed them to avoid danger for
each other and to carry out
operations even from distant
locations. However, despite
possessing such abilities, he was
not recognized under Newtype
supremacism and was branded with
the mark of 'Category F.' As a
result, he came to hate Newtypes
and all of the world that
acknowledged their existence. His
personality was cold and
heartless, and he stopped at
nothing to achieve his goals. But
that was only his outward face;
within him lay a fierce passion
unimaginable from his refined
features. He was often admonished
by Shagia when he lost his head
and lost sight of the situation.
However, during the final battle
with Garrod, a rare scene was seen
where he stopped Shagia, who tried
to forcibly fire an insufficiently
charged satellite launcher. After
the war ended, in a corner of a
certain town, there was his figure
pushing Shagia's wheelchair while
watching Garrod and Tiffa set out
on their journey.

203.DSCR:
Lancerow Dawell is the captain of
the Space Revolutionary Army's
training battalion, with the rank
of colonel. He is 34 years
old. During the 7th Space War,
he was a Newtype who fought evenly
with Jamil, but after the war
ended, he lost that ability. Even
15 years later, he remains with
the Revolutionary Army and is
highly favored by President
Seidel. However, he is aware that
this is because, as a former
Newtype, he holds value to the
populace as a symbol of the future
and to the military as a means to
boost morale. Even without his
Newtype powers, his mobile suit
piloting skills are top-notch.
When he clashed with Garrod, who
went to space for Tiffa, he
overwhelmed him with ease, as if
twisting a baby's arm.
Eventually, he learned that Jamil
was fighting to protect Newtypes,
came to understand his actions,
and lent aid to Jamil and his
group when they were struggling
against the Frost brothers.
203.DSC2:
The captain of the Space
Revolutionary Army's training
battalion. His rank was colonel.
34 years old. He was a Newtype
who fought on equal terms with
Jamil during the 7th Space War,
but after the war ended, he lost
that ability. Even 15 years
later, he still belonged to the
Revolutionary Army and was highly
favored by Supreme Leader Seidel.
However, he was aware that this
was because his former status as a
Newtype made him useful to the
public as a symbol of the future
and to the military as a means of
boosting morale. Even without his
Newtype powers, his mobile suit
piloting skills were top-class.
When he engaged Garrod, who had
gone into space for Tiffa's sake,
he won a complete victory with
ease. Eventually, he learned that
Jamil was fighting to protect
Newtypes, came to understand his
actions, and aided Jamil and his
group when they were struggling
against the Frost brothers. After
the war ended, as one of the
leaders of the Space Revolutionary
Army, he shook hands in friendship
with Jamil, who had become a
member of the peace council.

204.DSCR:
Katock Alzamille is a soldier
belonging to the New Federation.
His abilities as a soldier are
high enough to serve as captain of
a special unit, but he is also a
man who causes trouble in various
places, such as disobeying orders
and firing at superiors. He
infiltrated the Freeden disguised
as a fisherman, intending to
capture it, but failed and was
instead taken prisoner. Later,
amid the chaos of battle, he
seized the bridge and achieved his
objective, but meeting Tiffa
brought a change to his heart.
When Garrod sought to rescue
Tiffa, who had been captured by
the New Federation, he cooperated
without regard for his own
interests. Though he claimed to
dislike it, he often spoke of his
dead wife whenever something
happened, revealing the depth of
his feelings for the family he had
lost in the war.
204.DSC2:
A military officer belonging to
the New Federation. His abilities
as a soldier were high enough to
serve as the captain of a special
forces unit, but he was also a man
who caused trouble in various
places through insubordination and
firing on his superiors. He
infiltrated the Freeden disguised
as a fisherman, plotting to
capture it, but failed and was
captured himself instead. Later,
taking advantage of the confusion
of battle, he seized the bridge
and accomplished his goal, but
meeting Tiffa brought about a
change in his heart. He
cooperated with Garrod, who sought
to rescue Tiffa from the New
Federation's capture, without
regard for his own interests, but
in the end, he died shielding
Garrod and Tiffa from gunfire.
Although he claimed to be bad with
such things, he spoke of his
deceased wife at every turn,
revealing the depth of his
feelings for the family he had
lost in the war.

205.DSCR:
Seidel Rasso is the president of
the Space Revolutionary Army. He
advocated the ideology of Newtype
supremacy, holding that 'humanity
is truly established as Newtypes
only through space transforming
them,' and sought to lead humanity
living in space. However, these
claims were nothing more than a
pretext to maintain his own power,
and he did not truly need
Newtypes. For that reason, he
stubbornly refused to acknowledge
Tiffa, a naturally occurring
Newtype born and raised on Earth.
While he was in the midst of a
decisive battle on the Moon to
destroy the New Federation and
obtain the power of Newtypes, he
was led to D.O.M.E. and came
into contact with its true
essence.
205.DSC2:
The supreme leader of the Space
Revolutionary Army. He advocated
the Newtype ideology that
'humanity is first established as
a Newtype when space transforms
them,' and sought to lead humanity
living in space. However, these
claims were merely slogans to
maintain his own power, and he had
no real need for true Newtypes.
For that reason, he not only
refused to acknowledge Tiffa, a
naturally occurring Newtype born
and raised on Earth, but even
sought to eliminate her. While in
the midst of the decisive battle
on the Moon to destroy the New
Federation and obtain the power of
Newtypes, he was led to
D.O.M.E. and came into contact
with its true nature. However, he
could not accept the fact revealed
there that 'Newtypes do not
exist.' Clinging to his Newtype
ideology and attempting to
continue the fight, he was shot by
the Frost brothers and vanished
into space along with his
ambitions.

206.DSCR:
The supreme commander of the New
Federation Forces. He feared that
with the rise of Newtypes, all
people including himself would be
branded as old humanity. He was
flattered by the Frost Brothers as
'one destined to become the new
leader of the world,' and
eventually, guided by them, he
would engage in a decisive battle
with the revolutionary army on the
Moon.
206.DSC2:
The supreme commander of the New
Federation Forces. He feared that
with the rise of Newtypes, all
people including himself would be
branded as Oldtypes. He was
lifted up by the Frost Brothers as
'one who would become the new
leader of the world,' and
eventually, guided by them, he
fought a decisive battle against
the Revolutionary Army on the
Moon. Later, through contact with
D.O.M.E., he touched upon the
true nature of Newtypes, but even
so, he did not stop the war. When
escaping from D.O.M.E., his
insistence on Newtypes to the very
end incurred the wrath of the
Frost Brothers, and he was blown
away along with his ship.

207.DSCR:
A fifteen-year-old boy serving as
the leader of the self-defense
corps in the regional city of Fort
Severn. He was an artificial
Newtype so excellent that Mayor
Nomoa called him 'my greatest
masterpiece.' He himself
possessed absolute confidence in
his own power, and had the ability
to match it. He repelled the
Gundam X with his beloved Vertigo,
but the existence of Tiffa, a
natural Newtype who should not
have existed, and his defeat at
the hands of the revived Garrod
caused him to lose his sense of
purpose. Finally, when he tried
to take his own life, Garrod saved
him, and that event opened his
heart. Afterwards, his power was
exploited by Nomoa, who was
actually Dorat, and he destroyed
the city with the Patulia. After
Dorat was defeated by Garrod and
the others, he resolved to devote
himself to rebuilding the city as
atonement. Later, as a unit
commander leading a force of the
anti-New Federation organization,
he saved the crew of the Freeden
from a crisis. Furthermore, when
they needed a means to reach
space, he even provided a space
battleship.
207.DSC2:
A boy who served as the leader of
the self-defense corps of the
local city Fort Severn. 15
years old. He was an artificial
Newtype so excellent that Mayor
Nomoa called him 'my greatest
masterpiece.' He himself had
absolute confidence in his own
power, and possessed corresponding
ability. He used his beloved
Vertigo to drive off the Gundam X,
but the existence of Tiffa, a
natural Newtype who should not
exist, and his defeat by a revived
Garrod caused him to lose his
sense of purpose. Finally, when
he was about to take his own life,
Garrod saved him, and that became
the catalyst for him to open his
heart. Afterwards, his power was
exploited by Nomoa, in truth
Dorat, and he destroyed the city
with Patulia. After Dorat was
defeated by Garrod and the others,
he resolved to devote himself to
the city's reconstruction as
atonement. Later, as a unit
commander leading one force of the
anti-New Federation organization,
he saved the crew of the Freeden
from crisis. Furthermore, when
they needed a means to go into
space, he even arranged a space
battleship for them. For a while
after the war ended, he apparently
traveled with Garrod and Tiffa.
But his tact in departing alone,
saying, 'I cannot keep getting in
the way of you two forever,' was
worthy of the name of a Newtype.

208.DSCR:
A former Federation forces
educational officer and instructor
in charge of the Flash System.
She was Jamil's superior during
his military days, but to him she
was a woman of greater
significance than that. In the
final stages of the great war, her
hatred of battle and her wish for
peace grew too strong, causing her
to suffer a mental breakdown. The
Federation Forces, noticing her
Newtype abilities and her hatred
of fighting, used her as the core
of the L System, which could
disable the electronic equipment
of weapons. However, the L
Operation that was supposed to
employ it was ultimately
cancelled. The L System later lay
at the bottom of the sea, but it
was discovered and recovered
during the salvage of the G Bits
that had sunk alongside it. The
Lucile within was not completely
unconscious; she appeared before
Jamil using Tiffa's body and saved
the Freeden from an attack by the
Sea Barchew. She also lent her
power to Jamil, who had lost his
Newtype abilities, and assisted in
controlling the G Bits. After the
battle ended, she was reunited
with Jamil.
208.DSC2:
An educational officer of the Old
Federation Forces, in charge of
instructing the Flash System. She
was Jamil's superior during his
military days, but to him, she was
a woman who meant more than that.
At the end of the great war, her
hatred of battle and her wish for
peace became too strong, causing
her to suffer a mental breakdown.
The Federation Forces, noticing
her Newtype abilities and her
hatred of war, used her as the
core of the L System, which halted
the electronic equipment of
weapons. However, the L Operation
that was to use it was ultimately
canceled. Afterwards, the L
System lay at the bottom of the
sea, but it was discovered and
recovered during the salvage of
the G Bits that had sunk at the
same time. Lucille within was not
completely unconscious; borrowing
Tiffa's body, she appeared before
Jamil and saved the Freeden from
an attack by the Seaburch. She
also lent her power to Jamil, who
had lost his Newtype abilities,
assisting in the control of the G
Bits. After the battle was over,
when she was reunited with Jamil,
at her own request, she sank deep
into the sea along with the L
System.

209.DSCR:
The intelligence chief of the
Government Rebuilding Committee.
He was the man who had the Gundam
Double X developed on Zonder Epta
Island. He focused on Newtypes,
plotting to gain their power and
take control of the committee. He
believed he was manipulating the
Frost Brothers to suit his own
purposes, but in reality he was
merely being used by them.
209.DSC2:
The intelligence coordinator of
the Government Reconstruction
Committee. The man who had the
Gundam Double X developed on
Zonder Epta Island. He focused on
Newtypes, plotting to obtain their
power and take control of the
committee. He believed he was
manipulating the Frost Brothers to
suit his own convenience, but in
reality, he was merely being used
by them in turn. In the end,
during the escape from Zonder
Epta, he was shot dead by Shagia.

210.DSCR:
A military officer belonging to
the New Federation Forces, with
the rank of lieutenant. He was
originally a skilled pilot, but
during combat with Garrod he
awakened the Newtype abilities he
had latent potential for, and used
Bit mobile suit tactics to drive
Garrod and the others into a
corner.
210.DSC2:
A soldier belonging to the New
Federation Forces, with the rank
of lieutenant. Originally a
skilled pilot, he blossomed his
latent Newtype abilities during
combat with Garrod, using Bit
Mobile Suit tactics to corner
Garrod and the others. However,
when he temporarily withdrew due
to damage, he was struck down by a
bullet from Shagia, who hated
Newtypes.

211.DSCR:
Shinn Asuka is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva. He
is 16 years old.
 Born and raised in Orb, he lived
peacefully with his family,
unaware of war. However, during
the Earth Alliance's invasion of
Orb in the previous war, he lost
both his parents and his younger
sister before his very eyes.
Shortly thereafter, at Todaka's
suggestion, he relocated to PLANT,
and, believing that 'power is
necessary to protect what is
precious,' he joined ZAFT. He
graduated from the academy with
excellent records and rose to wear
the red uniform, the mark of an
elite pilot. Given this
background, while his nature is
cheerful, he has a very sensitive
side, and his aggression often
comes to the surface.
 His hidden potential was
recognized by Durandal, and he was
chosen as the pilot of the Impulse
Gundam, the latest mobile suit.
When the three Second Stage
Gundams were stolen, he sortied to
take them back. Initially, due to
a lack of combat experience, he
achieved little, but eventually,
his rejection of the repeated
battles and deaths caused him to
awaken SEED. From then on, he
fought with unparalleled vigor and
grew into a top ace. While he
respected Athrun, he often vented
his anger at Athrun's indecisive
attitude.
 His chance encounter with Stella,
and their reunion amid battle, led
him to see the shadow of his
younger sister in her. When
Stella was taken prisoner, he
risked his own life to let her
escape, but even so, she could not
be saved from her cruel fate.
211.DSC2:
Shinn Asuka is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva. He
is 16 years old. Born and
raised in Orb, he lived peacefully
with his family, knowing nothing
of war. However, during the Earth
Alliance invasion of Orb in the
previous war, he lost both his
parents and his sister before his
very eyes. Shortly thereafter, at
Todaka's urging, he emigrated to
PLANT, and believing that 'power
is necessary to protect what is
precious,' he joined ZAFT. He
graduated from the academy with
excellent results and earned the
right to wear the red uniform, the
mark of an elite pilot. Given
this background, while he is
cheerful at heart, he has a very
sensitive side that can manifest
as strong aggression.
 Duraldul, perhaps seeing promise
in his hidden potential, chose him
as the pilot of the Impulse
Gundam, the latest model. When
the three second-stage Gundams
were stolen, he sortied to take
them back. Initially, due to a
lack of combat experience, he
achieved little, but his repeated
exposure to battle and death
eventually caused him to awaken
SEED. From then on, he fought
with remarkable skill and grew
into a top ace. While he
respected Athrun, he often vented
his anger at Athrun's indecisive
attitude.
 His chance encounter with Stella,
and their reunion in battle, led
him to see in her the image of his
late sister. When Stella was
taken prisoner, he risked his own
safety to help her escape, but she
could not escape her cruel fate.
When he met Stella again after she
lost her memories due to
re-adjustment, he tried to
persuade her and restore her
heart, but his wish went
unfulfilled, and she died.
Consumed by anger and hatred, he
shot down Kira, who had delivered
the killing blow to Stella, and
also shot down Athrun, who had
defected from Durandal. This
became the catalyst for him being
given the Destiny Gundam and
appointed as a member of the
special forces FAITH, steadily
turning him into Durandal's
vanguard.
 During the final battle, he
listened to Athrun's persuasion
but stubbornly continued to
fight. In his frenzy, he nearly
attacked even Lunamaria, with whom
he had shared a connection, but at
the last moment he was shot down
by Athrun and reunited with Stella
in a vision. He awoke on
Lunamaria's lap, shedding tears as
the war came to its end.
 In the epilogue added in 'Final
Plus,' he visits the memorial in
Orb and meets Kira for the second
time. They shake hands, vowing to
continue fighting together to
maintain peace.

212.DSCR:
Ray Za Barrel is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva.
 He is always calm, possesses
excellent situational judgment,
and his mobile suit piloting
skills surpass those of his peers
Shinn and Lunamaria. In space, he
fought evenly with Neo, and his
abilities were recognized by those
around him to the extent that
Arthur wondered, 'Why was the
Impulse given to Shinn and not
Ray?'
 He adores Durandal, and in his
presence, his personality changes
into that of an innocent boy. At
times, however, his absolute trust
appeared fanatical.
 He viewed the Archangel, which
did not obey Durandal, as an
enemy, and his conflict with
Athrun, who could not sever his
past ties with them, deepened.
212.DSC2:
Ray Za Barrel is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva.
Always calm and possessing
excellent situational awareness,
his mobile suit piloting skills
surpass those of his peers Shinn
and Lunamaria. In space, he
fought on equal footing with Neo,
and his abilities were so highly
regarded by those around him that
Arthur wondered why Shinn, not
Ray, had been chosen to pilot the
Impulse. He adores Durandal like
a father, and his trust in him is
so deep that his personality
transforms into that of an
innocent boy in Durandal's
presence. For this reason, he
views the Archangel, which defies
Durandal, as an enemy, and his
conflict with Athrun, who cannot
sever his past ties with them,
deepens. When Athrun attempted to
desert ZAFT, Ray pulled the
trigger without hesitation,
intending to kill both him and
Meyrin, who had aided his escape.
When that failed, he immediately
boarded the Legend Gundam and gave
chase. He also guided the
hesitant Shinn, manipulating him
into shooting down Athrun. In
truth, like Rau Le Creuset, who
died in the previous war, Ray is a
clone of Al Da Flaga. He shares
the same short telomeres, meaning
he was not destined to live long.
During the final battle, he was
defeated by Kira and his mobile
suit was wrecked. He barely
managed to reach Durandal inside
Messiah, but for the sake of the
'future' Kira spoke of, he fired a
bullet at the Durandal he loved
and revered. In his final
moments, held by Talia, he wept,
finally finding a motherly
presence, and was consumed by the
explosion.

213.DSCR:
Lunamaria Hawke is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva.
She is 17 years old.
 Along with Shinn and Ray, she
achieved excellent results at the
academy and became a member of the
elite known as the red uniforms.
She primarily fought in a GOUF
Ignited painted in her personal
color, red.
 Together with her younger sister
Meyrin, she took an interest in
Athrun, the hero of the previous
war, and made various advances
toward him. However, she was
greatly shocked by a certain
action taken by Athrun and
Meyrin.
213.DSC2:
Lunamaria Hawke is a mobile suit
pilot serving aboard the Minerva
in the ZAFT forces. She is 17
years old. Along with Shinn and
Ray, she achieved excellent
results at the academy and became
one of the elite, known as the Red
Coats. She primarily fought in a
GOUF Ignited painted in her
personal color, red. Along with
her younger sister Meyrin, she was
interested in Athrun, a hero of
the previous war, and made various
advances toward him. But when she
heard that Athrun had deserted the
military due to distrust of
Durandal, and that Meyrin had gone
with him, she was shocked, only to
then learn that the two had been
shot down. From then on, her bond
with Shinn, who supported her as
they healed each other's wounds,
quickly deepened and eventually
blossomed into love. During the
final battle, she tried to stop
Shinn, who seemed possessed in his
determination to keep fighting,
but was instead attacked by him.
Even so, she showed her devotion
by tending to Shinn after his
defeat by Athrun. In a post-war
scene in 'Final Plus,' she visits
the Orb memorial with Shinn.
There, she watches Shinn shed
tears as he reconciles with Kira
and Athrun, and together they step
forward into a new future.

214.DSCR:
Talia Gladys is the captain of
ZAFT's new warship, the Minerva.
She is 29 years old.
 As befitting one of ZAFT's rare
female captains, she excels in
situational judgment and in
managing people, and she kept the
young crew, including Shinn and
the others, well organized.
 In the past, she and Durandal had
been lovers, but because she could
not bear his child due to
incompatibility, she was forced to
end their relationship. Even so,
it seems that lingering feelings
remain on both sides.
 From the time of the LOGOS
subjugation onward, she grew
increasingly distrustful of the
unreasonable orders and
inexplicable behavior handed down
by Durandal.
214.DSC2:
Talia Gladys is the captain of
the newly built ZAFT warship
Minerva. She is 29 years old.
Living up to her rare status as a
female captain in ZAFT, she
possesses excellent situational
judgment and the ability to
command her crew's loyalty,
skillfully leading the young crew
including Shinn. She was once in
a romantic relationship with
Durandal, but because she could
not bear his child due to
compatibility issues, she
reluctantly ended their
relationship. However, it seems
they still harbor unresolved
feelings for each other. From the
time of the LOGOS subjugation
onward, she grew increasingly
distrustful of the unreasonable
orders and inexplicable actions
coming from Durandal. During the
final battle, when the Minerva
became unable to fight, she
entrusted the crew to Arthur and
evacuated the ship, heading to
Durandal's location to stop him.
When he fell after a final
exchange with Kira and the others,
she watched over his final moments
and vanished with him in the
explosion of Messiah.

215.DSCR:
Arthur Trine is the deputy
captain of ZAFT's new warship, the
Minerva. He is 26 years old.
 Despite holding the important
post of deputy captain, he is
timid and restless. He tends to
get carried away, and so was
frequently reprimanded by Talia.
 He treated the veteran crew
members such as Shinn and Ray with
familiarity, but he often cast a
cold eye on Athrun, who joined
midway.
215.DSC2:
Arthur Trine is the deputy
captain of the newly built ZAFT
warship Minerva. He is 26 years
old. Despite holding the
important post of deputy captain,
he is timid and restless. He
tends to get carried away and was
often scolded by Talia. He
treated long-serving crew members
like Shinn and Ray with
familiarity, but often cast a cold
eye on Athrun, who joined later.
During the final battle at
Messiah, when the Minerva was
rendered combat-ineffective, Talia
entrusted him with full command of
the Minerva crew as she headed to
Durandal. Gone was the unreliable
Arthur of before, as he saluted
Talia as she departed.

216.DSCR:
Meyrin Hawke is a crew member of
the ZAFT new battleship Minerva,
in charge of communications
control and search operations.
She is 16 years old.
 Along with her older sister
Lunamaria, she takes an interest
in Athrun, a hero of the previous
war. She is also skilled at
operating information terminals,
and has used that skill to
research information on Athrun.
 As she watches Athrun become
isolated within the ship, she
gradually comes to feel complex
emotions that go beyond mere
admiration. Eventually, she takes
a bold action that shocks those
around her.
216.DSC2:
Meyrin was a crew member of the
ZAFT new warship Minerva, in
charge of communications control
and search operations. She was
16 years old.
 Along with her older sister
Lunamaria, she took an interest in
Athrun, a hero of the previous
war. She was also skilled at
operating information terminals,
and had used that skill to
investigate Athrun's background.
 As she watched Athrun become
increasingly isolated within the
ship, she came to feel complex
emotions that went beyond mere
admiration. When Athrun deserted
the military, she assisted him,
and carried by the momentum, she
chose to accompany him. Although
she was shot down by Shinn
immediately after their escape,
she survived, and from then on
followed Athrun and came to belong
to the Orb military. Eventually
she boarded the Eternal, and
supported Lacus with her skilled
communications control.
 In the epilogue added in 'Final
Plus,' she appeared before the Orb
memorial site alongside Athrun,
and walked off side by side with
him.

217.DSCR:
Yolant Kent is a mechanic on the
Minerva. He is 17 years old.
 He is a classmate and friend of
Ray and Meyrin from the academy.
Unlike his partner Vino, he has a
serious personality and is a big
fan of Lacus.
217.DSC2:
Yolant was a mechanic on the
Minerva. He was 17 years old.
 He was a classmate and friend of
Ray and Meyrin from the academy.
 Unlike his partner Vino, he had a
serious personality. As a big
Lacus fan, he was jealous of
Athrun, who was publicly her
fiance. At one point he made
remarks, half joking and half
serious, about pulling the plug on
the Saber.

218.DSCR:
Vino Duple is a mechanic on the
Minerva. He is 16 years old.
 He is a classmate and friend of
Shin and Lunamaria from the
academy. Unlike his partner
Yolant, he has a light and
cheerful personality. He is
especially close to Shin.
218.DSC2:
Vino was a mechanic on the
Minerva. He was 16 years old.
 He was a classmate and friend of
Shinn and Lunamaria from the
academy.
 Unlike his partner Yolant, he had
a light and cheerful personality.
He had been especially close to
Shinn, so when Meyrin fled with
Athrun and Shinn pursued and shot
them down, Vino harbored
complicated feelings toward him.

219.DSCR:
Alex Dino is the false name
Athrun used when he defected to
Orb after the end of the previous
war. His disguise consists of no
more than wearing sunglasses when
going out, so it is not hard to
imagine that anyone who knows him
would see through it at a glance.
219.DSC2:
Alex Dino was the alias Athrun
used when he defected to Orb after
the end of the previous war.
 When going out, he wore no
disguise beyond sunglasses, so it
is not hard to imagine that anyone
who knew him would see through it
at a glance. In fact, Durandal
saw through it immediately.

220.DSCR:
Athrun Zala is one of the figures
who brought the previous war to an
end, and is a hero whose name is
known to everyone in PLANT. He is
18 years old.
 After the war, he defected to Orb
and served as the bodyguard of his
lover Cagalli. However, faced
with the war that began anew, he
was forced to taste the
helplessness of being unable to do
anything. In that state, Durandal
invited him, and after bidding
farewell to Cagalli, he rejoined
ZAFT as a member of the special
forces FAITH.
 Riding the Savior Gundam
entrusted to him upon rejoining,
he fought as a member of the
Minerva's crew, but eventually
came into conflict with Kira and
the others over differences in
opinion.
 At first he sympathized with
Durandal's ideals, but after the
suspicion surrounding Lacus's
assassination, the use of the fake
Meer, and the order to attack the
Archangel, which should have
shared the same purpose, he
gradually grew more distrustful.
220.DSC2:
Athrun was one of the key figures
who brought the previous war to an
end, and a hero whose name was
known by everyone in PLANT. He
was 18 years old.
 After the war, he defected to Orb
and served as the bodyguard of his
lover Cagalli. But before the war
that began anew, he was forced to
taste the powerlessness of being
unable to do anything. In that
state, Durandal invited him, and
after bidding Cagalli farewell, he
rejoined ZAFT. He became a member
of the special forces unit FAITH.
 He piloted the Saber Gundam
entrusted to him upon rejoining
and fought as a crew member of the
Minerva, but eventually came into
conflict with Kira and the others
due to differences in opinion.
 Initially he sympathized with
Durandal's ideals, but as he
received suspicions of Lacus's
assassination, the use of the fake
Meer, and orders to attack the
Archangel whose aims should have
been the same, he gradually grew
more distrustful.
 However, his indecisive attitude
caused Durandal to see him as a
threat. When he was about to be
disposed of, he narrowly escaped
with advice from Meer and aid from
Meyrin, and attempted to desert
the military again. But he was
pursued by Shinn and Ray, and was
shot down along with Meyrin, who
was with him.

221.DSCR:
Athrun Zala, who escaped from
ZAFT, resolved to fight alongside
Kira and the others once more.
Facing Durandal's 'Destiny Plan,'
he has officially become a member
of the Orb military.
 The hesitation he once felt, torn
between what he believed in and
what he wanted to believe in, is
now gone. Furthermore, by
obtaining the Justice Gundam,
which carries on the lineage of
his former beloved mobile suit, he
is now able to fully display his
true combat capabilities.
221.DSC2:
Athrun Zala, who escaped from
ZAFT and decided to fight
alongside Kira and the others once
more. To stand against Durandal's
'Destiny Plan', he formally became
a member of the Orb military. The
hesitation he once felt when
caught between what he believed in
and what he wanted to believe in
is already gone. Moreover, by
obtaining the Infinite Justice
Gundam, which carries on the
lineage of his beloved former
mobile suit, he was able to fully
display his true combat ability.
During the final battle, he
attempted to persuade Shinn, who
was following Durandal, to stop
fighting, but failed. When the
deranged Shinn showed signs of
attacking Lunamaria, who had
intervened to stop him, Athrun
activated SEED and shot him down.
In 'Final Plus', he further
pursued Kira to Messiah, where
Durandal awaited, and witnessed
the end of the battle. After the
war, standing beside Athrun at the
Orb memorial monument was not
Cagalli but Meyrin. Athrun has a
reputation for getting into
trouble involving women, so it is
unclear whether she has truly been
decided as his partner...

222.DSCR:
A crew member of the Archangel
and the pilot of the Freedom
Gundam. He is 18 years old. In
addition to genetic adjustment, he
is the product of various
experiments, a being that could be
called a 'Super Coordinator.'
 In the previous war, as a third
power, he fought against both the
Earth Alliance and PLANT, leading
the war to its conclusion.
Afterward, he went into exile in
Orb with Murrue, who had fought
alongside him, and his lover
Lacus, living a life far removed
from battle. However, witnessing
the fall of Junius Seven and the
battle against the assassination
squad sent after Lacus made him
strongly feel the need to stop the
expanding flames of war. At last,
he initiated military action
together with his former
comrades.
 His combat ability is so high
that no one else can match him.
Yet, because of his overly gentle
personality, which abhors conflict
and killing, he strives to fight
without killing opponents,
destroying only weapons and
cameras even in battle. This
eventually becomes his undoing,
and he is once defeated by Shinn's
desperate attack. But later, he
is revived by obtaining new wings,
the Strike Freedom Gundam.
222.DSC2:
A crew member of the Archangel
and pilot of the Freedom Gundam.
Eighteen years old. An existence
that could be called a 'Super
Coordinator', born through genetic
adjustment and a variety of
repeated experiments. During the
previous war, he fought as a third
force against both the Earth
Alliance and PLANT, leading the
war to its conclusion.
Afterwards, he defected to Orb
along with Murrue, with whom he
had fought, and his lover Lacus.
He lived in seclusion in a world
far from battle. However, upon
witnessing the Junius Seven drop
incident, and triggered by a
battle against an assassination
squad sent after Lacus, he began
to strongly feel the need to halt
the spreading flames of war. And
at last, he commenced military
action together with his former
comrades. His combat ability is
so high that no one can match
him. Yet because of his overly
gentle personality, which abhors
conflict and killing, he strives
to fight in a way that destroys
only weapons and cameras, avoiding
killing his opponents. This
eventually became his undoing, and
he was once defeated by Shinn's
desperate attack. But later, he
achieved a revival by obtaining
new wings, the Strike Freedom
Gundam. After Durandal revealed
the existence of the 'Destiny
Plan', he formally joined the Orb
military following Cagalli's
return to the position of
representative chief. In the
final battle, he settled his score
with Ray, who carried on the
lingering ties of Rau Le Creuset,
then infiltrated Messiah to
confront Durandal, showing his
resolve to keep fighting in a
troubled world.

223.DSCR:
The representative of the Orb
Union chief state. She is 18
years old.
 She carries on the will of the
former representative Uzumi,
striving to lead her homeland and
the world to peace. However, due
to her youth and inexperience, as
well as the covert machinations of
the Seiran father and son, she
cannot unite the nation, and she
keenly feels her own
powerlessness.
 When Athrun, with whom she had
been in love since the previous
war, left Orb, he gave her a
ring. However, afterward, for the
reason of 'unifying the nation,'
she reluctantly decided to marry
Yuna, and she cut off her
feelings. But during the wedding
ceremony, she was taken away by
her twin brother Kira's Freedom
Gundam, and the marriage was
ruined.
223.DSC2:
The representative of the Orb
Union of Chief States. Eighteen
years old. She carries on the
will of the former representative
Uzumi, striving to lead her
homeland and the world to peace.
However, due to her youth,
inexperience, and the
behind-the-scenes machinations of
the Seiran father and son, the
nation failed to unite, and she
keenly felt her own
powerlessness. When Athrun, with
whom she had been in a romantic
relationship since the previous
war, left Orb, he gave her a
ring. But afterwards, for the
reason of 'uniting the nation',
she reluctantly decided to marry
Yuna, cutting off her feelings.
However, during the wedding
ceremony, she was carried off by
the Freedom Gundam of her twin
brother Kira, and the marriage
fell apart. Afterward, the Seiran
family, who had seized real power,
began to move the military by
allying with the Earth Alliance,
and she tried to stop them but
failed. Yet witnessing the
desperate resolve of the Orb
military men renewed her
determination to protect her
homeland. When a crisis later
befell Orb, she rode the Akatsuki
left by Uzumi, returned to her
country, and saved it from
danger. After regaining her
position as Orb's representative,
she governed the nation well and
stood against Durandal, who
proposed the 'Destiny Plan'.
Perhaps to prove that resolve, she
removed the ring given to her by
Athrun, entrusting his well-being
to Meyrin.

224.DSCR:
The captain of the Archangel.
She is 28 years old. For
convenience, her rank is listed as
Commander (Lieutenant Commander)
from her Earth Alliance days.
 During the previous war, she was
originally a member of the Earth
Alliance, but she defected midway
due to doubts about the military's
actions. As a third power, she
was a driving force in bringing
the previous war to an end.
Though she sometimes makes
cold-hearted decisions, she is
essentially a kind woman who has
watched over her young crew like a
mother.
 After the war, she went to Orb
with Kira, Waltfeld, Lacus, and
others who had fought alongside
her, and she worked in the
shipbuilding section of
Morgenroete Corporation. Just as
she was considering moving to
PLANT, she was attacked by a
special forces unit plotting
Lacus's assassination, but she
barely managed to repel them.
That incident prompted her to
decide to launch the Archangel for
the sake of a world once again
falling into chaos.
 During the battle at Berlin, she
had a tragic reunion with her
lover, who had supposedly died
shielding the Archangel in the
previous war, and she shed tears
of sorrow.
224.DSC2:
The captain of the Archangel.
Twenty-eight years old. For
convenience, her rank was that of
lieutenant commander from her
Earth Alliance days, but after
formally becoming a member of the
Orb military, her rank became that
of colonel. During the previous
war, she originally belonged to
the Earth Alliance military, but
came to question the military's
actions and defected midway. As a
third force, she became the
driving force that led the
previous war to its conclusion.
Though she sometimes makes
cold-blooded decisions, she is by
nature a kind-hearted woman who
has watched over her young crew
like a mother. After the war
ended, she crossed to Orb with
Kira, Waltfeld, Lacus, and others
who had fought alongside her, and
worked in the shipbuilding section
of Morgenroete, Inc. Just as she
was considering moving to PLANT,
she was attacked by a special
forces unit plotting to
assassinate Lacus, but barely
managed to repel them. With that
incident as the catalyst, she
resolved to launch the Archangel
once more for the sake of a world
again descending into chaos.
During the battle in Berlin, she
was reunited with her lover Mu,
who was supposed to have died
shielding the Archangel in the
previous war, but he had lost all
his memories. In her heartache,
she told him to leave the ship,
but Mu, feeling something nagging
at his heart, came back. And as
if drawn to each other, the two
opened their hearts to one
another. During the final battle,
Mu once again became the shield of
the Archangel. But this time he
survived along with his machine,
and moreover had completely
regained his memories. Witnessing
this miracle, she shed tears of
joy.

225.DSCR:
The helmsman of the Archangel.
He is 27 years old. His nominal
rank is Ensign (Lieutenant Junior
Grade) from his Earth Alliance
days.
 After the previous war, he seems
to have lived as a civilian in
Orb. Even so, navigating the
Archangel skillfully on land,
underwater, and in space, as well
as performing evasive maneuvers
during combat, he proved his skill
remained intact. The fact that he
could fight on equal terms or
better against the new warship
Minerva was largely due to his
helmsmanship.
 After Cagalli returned to Orb, he
was formally incorporated into the
Orb military along with the other
members.
225.DSC2:
The helmsman of the Archangel.
Twenty-seven years old. His
nominal rank is that of ensign
from his Earth Alliance days.
After being formally incorporated
into the Orb military, his rank
became that of lieutenant. After
the previous war, he apparently
lived as an ordinary citizen of
Orb. Even so, whether navigating
on land, under water, or in space,
or performing evasive maneuvers
during combat, he skillfully
piloted the Archangel in all times
and places, demonstrating that his
skill remained intact. The fact
that he could fight on equal terms
or better against the new ship
Minerva was largely due to his
helmsmanship. He may have had
feelings for Miriallia, as he
looked quite displeased when
Chandra appeared during their
conversation. But of course, what
happened afterward remains
unknown.

226.DSCR:
A controller aboard the
Archangel, responsible for search,
radar, and fire control. 26
years old. For convenience, his
rank is listed as a sergeant from
his time in the Earth Alliance
Forces. His whereabouts after the
previous war were unknown, and as
can be seen from the lack of any
particular return scene, he has a
faint presence aside from his
name. However, he reliably
performs his duties, and in the
elite, undermanned Archangel,
which suffers from a greater
shortage of personnel than in the
previous war, he is an
indispensable existence. After
Cagalli returned to Orb, he was
formally incorporated into the Orb
military along with the other crew
members.
226.DSC2:
Chandra is the Archangel's
controller, responsible for
search, radar, and fire control.
He is 26 years old. For
convenience, his rank was set as
Sergeant First Class from his days
in the Earth Alliance, but after
formally becoming a member of the
Orb military, he holds the rank of
Second Lieutenant. His
whereabouts after the previous war
were unknown, and as can be seen
from the lack of a return scene,
he casts a weak shadow other than
his name. However, he performs
his duties reliably, and in the
understaffed Archangel, which
struggles with a shortage of
personnel greater than in the
previous war, he is an
indispensable presence. Regarding
Miriallia, upon his return he
showed signs of interest, such as
being the first to confirm her
relationship with Dearka and
interrupting a chat between her
and Neumann. However, what
happened afterward is likewise
unknown.

227.DSCR:
A crew member of the Archangel in
charge of communications control.
18 years old. She was
originally just an ordinary
student, but was swept up into the
military in the previous war.
Having lost her lover Tolle on the
battlefield, she was at one point
consumed by a dark hatred of
Coordinators. Yet as she came to
learn the hidden side of the war,
she grew mentally and fought
through to the end of the
conflict. After the war's
conclusion, she traveled the world
as a battlefield journalist,
camera in hand, photographing and
witnessing wars across the globe.
Combined with her own past
experiences, she grieved for a
world stained by conflict, but
when the Archangel launched once
more, she boarded the ship again
to fight alongside it. After
Cagalli rose as head of state, she
was formally incorporated into the
Orb military.
227.DSC2:
Miriallia is a member of the
Archangel's crew responsible for
communications control. She is
18 years old. Originally
nothing more than an ordinary
student, she was drawn into the
military in the previous war.
Having lost her lover Tolle on the
battlefield, she was for a time
consumed by a dark hatred of
Coordinators. But as she learned
of the war's hidden truths, she
grew emotionally and fought
through to the war's end. After
the war, she worked as a
battlefield journalist,
photographing and witnessing wars
around the world with camera in
hand. Combined with her own past
experiences, she grieved for a
world stained by conflict, but
when the Archangel launched, she
boarded again to fight alongside
them. Regarding Dearka, who had
harbored unrequited feelings for
her, things apparently did not
work out. When she happened to
run into Athrun on a street corner
and chatted with him, she visibly
grimaced at the mention of
Dearka's name, suggesting that
there was some decisive factor in
why the two never became lovers.

228.DSCR:
An idol who was once called the
'Songstress of PLANT.' 18 years
old. Her presence and charisma
were immense, and in the previous
war she pointed the way for Kira,
Athrun, and others, gathering
those who shared her convictions,
becoming a great driving force
that led the conflict to its end.
After the previous war, she
crossed to Orb together with
Waltfeld, Murrue, and her lover
Kira, who had fought alongside
her. There she lived quietly with
Reverend Malchio, Kira's adoptive
mother Caridad, and a group of
orphans, but learned that her
brief peace had been shattered by
the appearance of those who sought
to assassinate her. With the
emergence of the fake Meer as
well, her suspicions toward
Durandal deepened. Resolving to
return to the public stage, Lacus
boarded the Archangel together
with Kira.
228.DSC2:
Lacus was once called the
'Songstress of PLANT' and is an
idol-like figure. She is 18
years old. Her presence and
charisma are immense, and in the
previous war she guided the paths
of Kira and Athrun, gathered those
who shared her ideals, and was a
major driving force in bringing
the conflict to an end. After the
previous war, she went to Orb with
Waltfeld, Murrue, and her lover
Kira, who had fought alongside
her. There she lived quietly with
Reverend Malchio, Kira's adoptive
mother Carida, and orphans, but
her brief peace was shattered by
the appearance of those who sought
to assassinate her. With the
emergence of the impostor Meer,
her suspicions of Durandal
deepened. Resolving to return to
the public stage, she boarded the
Archangel with Kira. Later, going
into space and learning of the
'Destiny Plan,' she declared her
opposition to it. When she
prepared new Gundams for Kira and
Athrun, she personally boarded the
Infinite Justice Gundam (though
she mostly just rode along) and
delivered it to Athrun. She also
worked energetically, gathering
forces from various quarters, and
became the ideological pillar for
those who opposed Durandal. In
the final battle, as in the
previous war, she boarded the
Eternal and stood at the front
lines, fulfilling her role as a
standard-bearer. After the fight
with Durandal, she was seen at
Kira's side in both public and
private matters.

229.DSCR:
Captain of the high-speed
battleship Eternal. 32 years
old. He was originally a member
of ZAFT, a fierce warrior feared
under the epithet 'Desert Tiger.'
However, during the previous war
he defected from the military,
siding with Lacus and helping
bring the conflict to an end.
After the previous war, he fled to
Orb together with Kira, Murrue,
Lacus, and the others who had
fought alongside him, enjoying a
brief peace while savoring his
hobby of coffee. While
considering a move to PLANT, he
was attacked by a special forces
unit aiming to assassinate Lacus,
and repelled them. Taking that as
a turning point, he resolved to
once again face the war as a third
faction. After the Archangel
launched, he supported Murrue in a
vice-captain-like position, and in
times of crisis sortied in a
Murasame painted in his personal
colors, displaying that his skills
had not diminished. When Lacus
later acted to confirm the state
of PLANT, he went up into space
with her as her escort. When the
Eternal resumed operations, he
took his old seat in its captain's
chair as in the previous war.
When forced to fight alone, he
also sortied in the Gaia Gundam,
successor to his former beloved
machine. After Cagalli returned
to Orb, he was formally
incorporated into the Orb
military.
229.DSC2:
Captain of the high-speed battleship Eternal. 32
