incorporated into the Orb military.

230.DSCR:
Waltfeld's adjutant. He belonged
to ZAFT during the previous war,
but defected together with
Waltfeld and joined the Clyne
faction. In place of his
superior, he always works
faithfully behind the scenes. In
the current war as well, he played
a significant role, protecting the
Eternal while Lacus and the others
were away, and discovering notes
on the Destiny Plan inside the
abandoned colony Mendel.
230.DSC2:
Dakosta is Waltfeld's adjutant.
In the previous war he belonged to
ZAFT, but he defected with
Waltfeld and joined the Clyne
faction. In place of his
superior, he always works behind
the scenes, faithfully carrying
out his duties. In the current
war as well, he plays a fairly
important role, such as guarding
the Eternal while Lacus and the
others were away, and discovering
notes about the Destiny Plan
within the abandoned colony
Mendel. On that occasion, he was
followed by a ZAFT reconnaissance
unit and nearly brought about a
critical situation that could have
led to the ship's sinking.

231.DSCR:
Kojirou Murdoch is the mechanic
chief of the Archangel. He is
33 years old. For convenience,
his rank is listed as Sergeant
Major from his time in the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 After the end of the previous
war, he appears to have worked at
Morgenroete, and he
single-handedly handles the
maintenance of both mobile suits
and the Archangel, which is
convincing given his undiminished
skill.
 He is stubborn, foul-mouthed, and
gives a rough impression from his
appearance. However, his sense of
responsibility toward his position
as a mechanic, whose work affects
the lives of pilots, and the
feelings he holds for his comrades
that stem from it, are stronger
than most. When Athrun attempted
to sortie despite his injuries, he
contacted Murrue to have her stop
him.
231.DSC2:
Mudock is the Archangel's chief
mechanic. He is 33 years old.
For convenience, his rank was set
as Sergeant Major from his Earth
Alliance days, but his rank after
formally being incorporated into
the Orb military is unknown.
After the previous war, he
apparently worked at Morgenroete
and handles all maintenance for
both mobile suits and the
Archangel, making his undiminished
skill understandable. He is
stubborn and foul-mouthed, and his
appearance gives a rough
impression. But his sense of
responsibility toward his position
as a mechanic, whose work affects
pilots' lives, and the feelings
for his comrades that stem from
it, are stronger than most. When
Athrun tried to sortie despite his
injury, he contacted Murrue to
have her stop him. Also, right
after Mu (Neo) returned, he was
seen smiling happily.

232.DSCR:
Yuna Roma Seiran is the heir of
the Seiran family, one of Orb's
five major clans, and is Cagalli's
fiance. He is 22 years old.
 In collusion with his father
Unato, he used smooth talk to
carry out a marriage with Cagalli,
aiming to take control of Orb in
name and in fact. During the
wedding ceremony that eventually
came, Cagalli was taken from him
by Kira's Freedom Gundam.
Furthermore, he was interrupted
during the subsequent battle with
the Minerva, and his pride was
thoroughly crushed on every
front.
 After sitting in the Orb
representative's seat due to
Cagalli's absence, he went to the
front lines as the commander
leading the Orb fleet. However,
his command ability is completely
nonexistent, being utterly
childish. Moreover, he was so
obsessed with operation names that
he cooled the mood of those around
him, and even while other crew
members worked through the night,
he slept soundly alone, making his
casual attitude plainly visible.
232.DSC2:
Yuna Roma Seiran was the heir of
the Seiran family, one of the five
great clans of Orb, and the fiance
of Cagalli. He was 22 years
old.
 Collaborating with his father
Unato, he skillfully manipulated
words to carry out his marriage to
Cagalli, aiming to take control of
Orb in name and in fact. During
the wedding ceremony that
eventually took place, Cagalli was
taken from him by Kira's Freedom
Gundam. He was further
interrupted in subsequent battles
against the Minerva, and his pride
was thoroughly crushed each time.
 After Cagalli's absence allowed
him to assume the seat of Orb's
representative, he went to the
front lines as the commander
leading the Orb fleet. However,
his command ability was utterly
nonexistent, being nothing short
of clumsy. He obsessed over
operation names to the point of
boring those around him, and slept
soundly alone while other crew
members worked through the night,
making his frivolous attitude
plainly visible.
 In reality, he had connections
with LOGOS behind the scenes, and
secretly sheltered Djibril when he
was forced to flee. Because he
refused to hand Djibril over even
after being found out, Orb came
under a full-scale attack from
ZAFT. When Cagalli eventually
returned, he forgot that he had
denounced her as a fake and tried
to ingratiate himself with her,
but was promptly arrested for high
treason. He attempted to escape
in the confusion of battle after
being deposed, but was crushed to
death by a GOUF that happened to
fall on him.

233.DSCR:
Unato Ema Seiran is the head of
the Seiran family, one of Orb's
five major clans, and Yuna's
father.
 Despite holding the position of
chancellor supporting the nation,
he plotted to dominate Orb by
having Yuna and Cagalli marry.
233.DSC2:
Unato Emma Seiran was the head of
the Seiran family, one of the five
great clans of Orb, and the father
of Yuna.
 While holding the position of
chancellor supporting the nation,
he plotted to dominate Orb by
having Yuna marry Cagalli.
 Behind the scenes, he was deeply
involved with LOGOS, and because
he sheltered the fleeing Djibril,
Orb came under a full-scale attack
from ZAFT. Eventually, the
shelter where he had taken refuge
came under attack, and he met his
end buried under the rubble.

234.DSCR:
Todaka is the captain of the
aircraft carrier Takemikazuchi
belonging to the Orb Navy. His
rank is Commander (Colonel).
 He had a warm-hearted personality
and good sense, and he enjoyed the
deep trust of his subordinates.
 He constantly harbored resentment
toward unreasonable orders, such
as attacks on the Minerva, which
saved the Earth from Junius
Seven's fall, and on the Archangel
carrying Cagalli, the head of
state. Regarding the reckless
order issued by Yuna, who was
aboard as supreme commander, to
'attack that Cagalli because she
is a fake,' he judged that since
Orb had already allied with the
Earth Alliance, it was unavoidable
in order to protect Orb. Placing
his hopes on the Freedom Gundam
serving as escort, he issued the
attack order with great
reluctance.
234.DSC2:
Todaka was the captain of the
aircraft carrier Takemikazuchi
belonging to the Orb Navy. His
rank was Captain (Colonel).
 He had a warm-hearted personality
and sound judgment, and enjoyed
the deep trust of his
subordinates.
 He constantly harbored resentment
toward unreasonable orders, such
as attacks on the Minerva, which
had saved Earth from the fall of
Junius Seven, and on the
Archangel, which carried Cagalli,
the head of state. When Yuna, who
had boarded the ship as supreme
commander, issued the reckless
order to 'attack that Cagalli as
she is a fake,' he judged that,
having formed an alliance with the
Earth Alliance, it was unavoidable
in order to protect Orb. Placing
his hopes on the Freedom Gundam to
serve as escort, he gave the order
to attack with great reluctance.
 In the battle off the coast of
Crete, seeing that the outcome was
decided, he barked at his
subordinates and ordered them to
go to the Archangel. Then, aboard
the sinking ship, he was cut in
two along with the bridge by
Shinn's Sword Impulse. His
conduct, remaining faithful to his
duty as an Orb soldier to the very
end, truly embodied the ideals
that Orb upheld. Incidentally, it
was Todaka who had arranged for
Shinn's family to relocate to
PLANT after he lost them, but the
two who faced each other in battle
had no way of knowing of each
other's existence.

235.DSCR:
Ledonir Kisaka is a soldier
belonging to the Orb Army. His
rank is Commander (Colonel).
 He is a direct subordinate of
Uzumi, the former head of state of
Orb, and in the previous war he
also served as Cagalli's guard.
After Uzumi's death, he continued
to watch over her as her
guardian.
 After the alliance between the
Earth Alliance and Orb, he
infiltrated the Earth Alliance
Forces to investigate their
movements.
235.DSC2:
Rednil Kisaka was a soldier
belonging to the Orb Army. His
rank was Captain (Colonel).
 He was a direct subordinate of
Uzumi, the former head of state of
Orb, and had served as Cagalli's
guard during the previous war.
After Uzumi's death, he continued
to watch over Cagalli as her
guardian.
 After the alliance between the
Earth Alliance and Orb, he
infiltrated the Earth Alliance
forces to probe their movements.
Along the way, when he learned of
Athrun and Meyrin's escape, he
rescued them after they had been
shot down and guided them to the
Archangel.
 When Cagalli insisted on
sortieing upon learning of Orb's
crisis, he entrusted her with the
Akatsuki that Uzumi had left
behind. He himself also sortied
in a Murasame.

236.DSCR:
Durandal is the Chairman of the
PLANT Supreme Council. He is 32
years old.
 Unlike his predecessor, Chairman
Patrick Zala, he is a moderate who
seeks a path of coexistence and
peace with the Naturals. During
the Junius Seven fall incident and
the subsequent battles with the
Earth Alliance, he consistently
made calm and precise judgments,
demonstrating excellent
leadership.
 He is also a leading authority on
genetic research, and it is
thought that he came to know Rau
and Ray through that connection.
He also seemed to have anticipated
from the start that Shinn would
manifest the SEED factor.
 He promoted Meer as Lacus in an
attempt to raise the morale of all
of PLANT. However, his secret
plot to assassinate the real Lacus
was exposed, which earned him the
opposition of Kira and the
others.
236.DSC2:
Gilbert Durandal was the Chairman
of the PLANT Supreme Council. He
was 32 years old.
 Unlike the previous chairman,
Patrick Zara, he was a moderate
who sought a path of coexistence
and peace with the Naturals.
During the Junius Seven fall
incident and the subsequent
battles with the Earth Alliance
forces, he consistently made calm
and precise decisions,
demonstrating excellent
leadership.
 He was also an authority on
genetic research, and it is
believed that he came to know
Kruze and Ray through that
connection. There were also signs
that he had anticipated from the
beginning that Shinn would
manifest SEED.
 He propped up Meer as Lacus,
attempting to boost the fighting
spirit of all of PLANT. However,
his secret plot to assassinate the
real Lacus was exposed, drawing
the opposition of Kira and the
others.
 His ultimate goal was to
construct a managed society that
controlled humanity at the genetic
level, which he called the
'Destiny Plan.' After destroying
LOGOS, he declared the
introduction and implementation of
the plan to the world, but was
stopped by Kira and the others,
who rejected a world where
evolution had ceased.
 In the end, he was shot by Ray,
whom he had trusted like his own
son. And so, his life came to a
close in the lap of Talia, who had
once been his lover and had
continued to hold feelings for him
even after their separation.

237.DSCR:
Yzak is the captain of the ZAFT
Joule Team. He is 19 years
old.
 During the previous war, he
cooperated with the Archangel and
the Eternal at the very end, and
together they contributed to
bringing the war to a close.
 After the war ended, with
Durandal's assistance, he returned
to ZAFT, and thanks to his talent,
he rose at a young age to the
position of team captain. His
ability to command his unit using
his abundant combat experience,
and his skill in battle, are
first-rate. He was active across
a wide range of operations in
space, including helping the
Minerva prevent the fall of Junius
Seven, defending PLANT from the
Earth Alliance's unilateral
attacks, and the operation to
destroy the beam deflection
station when PLANT became a target
of Requiem (though this ended in
failure).
 When he reunited with Athrun, he
strongly urged him to rejoin the
military, showing that he had
grown beyond the petty rivalry he
once clung to.
237.DSC2:
Yzak Joule is captain of the ZAFT
Joule Team. Age 19.
 In the previous war, at the very
end, he cooperated with the
Archangel and the Eternal, and
together they helped bring about
the war's conclusion.
 After the war ended, with
Durandal's assistance, he returned
to ZAFT, and thanks to his
talents, he rose at a young age to
the position of team captain. His
ability to command his unit
through abundant combat
experience, and his skill in
battle, are first-rate. He was
active on a wide scale in space:
helping to stop the fall of Junius
Seven in cooperation with the
Minerva, defending PLANT from the
Earth Alliance's one-sided
attacks, and attempting to destroy
the beam deflection station when
PLANT became a target of Requiem
(though that attempt ended in
failure).
 When he met Athrun again, he
strongly urged him to re-enlist,
showing that he had outgrown the
petty rivalries he once clung to
and had matured.
 During the final battle between
Orb and PLANT, he once again found
himself torn between a friend who
had become an enemy and his own
position. However, he opposed
Durandal, who used weapons of mass
destruction like Requiem and Neo
Genesis, and once again cooperated
with Kira and the others.
 After successfully destroying the
beam deflection station for the
second time, he took up defense of
the Eternal. His justification
for doing so was,
characteristically for Yzak, a
forceful one.

238.DSCR:
Dearka belongs to ZAFT and serves
as the adjutant and
second-in-command of the Joule
Team, led by his best friend
Yzak. He is 19 years old.
 He was also a member of ZAFT
during the previous war, but after
being taken prisoner, he came
aboard the Archangel and fought
alongside them. After
contributing to ending the war as
part of a third faction, he
returned to PLANT.
 Whether it is because he was
questioned about that incident is
uncertain, but he wears the
standard soldier's uniform instead
of the red uniform that marks an
elite. However, his skill as a
pilot is in no way diminished, and
it can be said that he has grown
into a more reliable man, both in
ability and in mental fortitude.
238.DSC2:
A member of ZAFT, serving as
adjutant under his best friend
Yzak in the Joule Team. Age
19.
 He belonged to ZAFT in the
previous war as well, but after
being taken prisoner, he boarded
the Archangel and fought alongside
it. After contributing as a third
faction to ending the war, he
returned to PLANT.
 It is not certain whether it was
because of that incident, but he
now wears the uniform of a regular
soldier rather than the red coat
of an elite. However, his skill
as a pilot is in no way
diminished, and it can be said he
has grown into a more reliable
man, mentally as well.
 It was thought he might develop a
good relationship with Miriallia,
for whom he had developed
feelings, but she herself
confirmed with her own mouth that
she had 'dumped him.'

239.DSCR:
Heine is a member of the ZAFT
special forces unit FAITH. Under
Durandal's orders, he was
transferred to the Minerva. He is
21 years old.
 With a bright and friendly
personality, he had the
adaptability and sociability to
immediately blend in with the
Minerva's crew despite joining
partway through. He particularly
looked after Athrun, admonishing
him when he saw him troubled over
battle, and acting to close the
distance between him and Shinn and
the others, who had their own
walls.
 His mobile suit piloting skill is
also high, and his machine was
always painted in his personal
color, orange. He distinguished
himself in the PLANT defense
battle in a ZAKU Phantom, and in
the Battle of the Dardanelles in a
GOUF Ignited that had been
deployed ahead of time.
 Incidentally, in German, 'Westen'
means 'west' and 'fluss' means
'river'. This naming was done as
a tribute to Heine's voice actor,
the artist Takanori Nishikawa, who
also performed the theme song.
239.DSC2:
A member of ZAFT's special forces
unit FAITH. Transferred to the
Minerva by Durandal's order. Age
21.
 Bright and easygoing, he
possessed the adaptability and
sociability to blend into the
Minerva's crew immediately despite
joining mid-mission. He was
especially attentive to Athrun,
admonishing him when he saw him
troubled over battle, and working
to close the distance between
Athrun and the guarded Shinn and
the others.
 His mobile suit piloting skill
was also high, and his machine was
always painted in his personal
color orange. At the PLANT
defense battle he fought in a ZAKU
Phantom, and at the Dardanelles
Strait he was active in an
early-deployed GOUF Ignited.
However, when the Freedom Gundam
intruded to stop the battle and
deprived him of his combat
capability, he was attacked from
behind by the Gaia Gundam and cut
in two along with his machine,
dying.
 Incidentally, in German, 'Westen'
means 'west' and 'flus' means
'river'. This is a name chosen
out of respect for Heine's voice
actor, who also performed the
theme song: the artist Nishikawa
Takanori.

240.DSCR:
Meer is a girl discovered by
Durandal, who thought that someone
was needed to captivate the masses
as a stand-in for Lacus after she
disappeared from the public eye.
She is 17 years old.
 Being herself a great fan of
Lacus, her figure appealing for
peace moved the hearts of many,
and her singing voice attracted
countless people. Thanks to
plastic surgery, her appearance
and voice were exactly the same as
the real thing. However, the tone
of her songs and her mannerisms
were quite different, which made
Yolant and others somewhat
suspicious. Even so, in the end,
she seemed to have gained
popularity approaching that of the
real Lacus.
 Whether she was faithfully
maintaining the fiction that she
was engaged to Athrun, or acting
out of genuine affection, she
approached him excessively and
left him bewildered.
240.DSC2:
A girl sought out by Durandal,
who thought that after Lacus
vanished from public view, someone
was needed to draw the people's
hearts as her substitute. Age
17.
 Being herself a great fan of
Lacus, her appearance appealing
for peace moved many hearts, and
her singing voice attracted many
people. Having undergone plastic
surgery, her appearance and voice
were exactly the same as the
genuine article's. However,
because her song arrangements and
mannerisms were quite different,
Yolant and others regarded her
with some suspicion. Even so, in
the end she seems to have gained
popularity approaching the real
thing.
 Whether out of a faithful attempt
to uphold the fiction that she was
engaged to Athrun, or out of
genuine affection, she made
excessive advances toward him,
much to his bewilderment. When
she learned that danger was
approaching Athrun, she secretly
informed him and saved him from
the crisis. At that time, when he
extended his hand to flee
together, she struck it away,
declaring, 'Even as a fake, I want
to be Lacus.'
 Later, her unstable mental state
- fearing she was no longer needed
- was exploited by an attendant
under Durandal's command, who
manipulated her into having the
real Lacus killed. However,
Lacus's words made her realize her
error, and she shielded Lacus with
her body from assassins' bullets,
breathing her last in Lacus's
arms.

241.DSCR:
Djibril is a member of the
military-industrial complex LOGOS
and the new leader of Blue Cosmos,
which seeks to eradicate
Coordinators. He is 31 years
old.
 He is a man of excessive
aristocratic tastes and biased
elitist ideology. Though he
normally maintains a calm and
polite demeanor, when matters do
not proceed as he hopes he quickly
loses his temper and lashes out at
objects, revealing a base
character. Upon learning that the
Junius Seven drop incident was the
work of some Coordinators, he
unilaterally declared war on PLANT
on those grounds, plunging the
world into chaos once again.
241.DSC2:
A member of the
military-industrial complex LOGOS
and the new leader of Blue Cosmos,
which seeks the extermination of
Coordinators. Age 31.
 A man of excessive aristocratic
tastes and twisted elitist
ideology. Ordinarily he maintains
a calm and courteous demeanor, but
when matters do not go as planned
he quickly loses his temper and
lashes out at things around him -
a base character.
 When he learned that the Junius
Seven drop was the work of certain
Coordinators, he used it as
justification to unilaterally
declare war against PLANT,
plunging the world into chaos once
more.
 However, both he and LOGOS itself
were exposed by Durandal's
machinations, and he became the
sole target of the people's
hostility. Thereafter he suffered
defeats one after another across
the world, fleeing while using
everyone else - LOGOS members,
Earth Alliance officers, all - as
stepping stones. Even at Daedalus
Base on the Moon, his last
stronghold, he was defeated, and
though recovery was impossible he
still attempted escape. But he
was shot through along with the
bridge of the Girty Lue he had
boarded, and with his death the
flight came to an end.

242.DSCR:
Neo Roanoke is the captain of the
Earth Alliance's 81st
Independent Mobile Group, Phantom
Pain. His rank is colonel.
 He is a man of many mysteries,
always hiding his face behind a
mask and possessing an unknown
history. Though he has an
easygoing personality, his command
and combat abilities are high, and
his approachable nature and
attentiveness earn him deep trust
from his subordinates.
 Beyond his un-soldierly
character, his high spatial
awareness that allows him to
freely manipulate gunbarrels, and
the ability to sense the presence
of Ray that occurs between them,
he possesses many traits that
evoke a certain person who died in
the previous war.
242.DSC2:
Neo Roanoke was the captain of
the Earth Alliance's 81st
Independent Mobile Group, the
Phantom Pain. His rank was
colonel. He was a man of many
mysteries, always hiding his face
behind a mask and having an
unknown history. Despite his
carefree personality, his command
and combat abilities were high,
and his approachable and
considerate nature earned him the
deep trust of his subordinates.
Beyond his unmilitary-like
personality, he possessed many
traits that called to mind Mwu La
Flaga, who had died in the
previous war, such as his high
spatial awareness that allowed him
to freely manipulate GUNBARRELs,
and an ability to sense the
presence of another person that
manifested between him and Ray.
He engaged Kira in battle over
Berlin and was shot down, and when
he was thrown from the cockpit,
his unveiled face was exactly that
of Mwu. Examination revealed his
biological data to be identical,
confirming him to be Mwu La Flaga
himself. Afterward, he was held
as a prisoner aboard the
Archangel, but was released by the
hand of Murrue, his former lover.
However, from the faint remnants
of his past memories and fragments
of his feelings for Murrue, he
decided to return to the ship and
fight alongside them. Later, when
he was formally incorporated into
the Orb military, he became the
pilot of the Akatsuki in place of
Cagalli, who had to remain on
Earth, and achieved great results
in battle. His rank remained that
of a colonel, and even considering
that he was a man who had been
with the enemy until shortly
before, was an acquaintance, and
was skilled, the generous
treatment he received was truly
exceptional.

243.DSCR:
This is the true form of Mu La
Flaga, revealed when Neo Roanoke
regained his lost memories. He is
30 years old.
 It is believed that the
recreation of the same
circumstances as when he lost his
memories triggered an effect
similar to shock therapy. Apart
from the scar on his face, he is
exactly as he was before - truly a
complete revival.
243.DSC2:
This is the true form of Mu La Flaga, revealed
when Neo Roanoke regained his lost memories. He is
30 years old.
 It is believed that the recreation of the same
circumstances as when he lost his memories
triggered an effect similar to shock therapy.
Apart from the scar on his face, he is exactly as
he was before - truly a complete revival.

244.DSCR:
Sting Oakley is an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
He stole the Chaos Gundam from
ZAFT and became its pilot.
 For Extendeds like him, a verbal
safety device called a 'Block
Word' is prepared to suppress
their rampages. Upon hearing that
word, they immediately fall into
confusion and lose themselves.
However, Sting's 'Block Word' has
not been revealed.
 Compared to Auel and Stella, he
is the most mentally stable, and
he is earnest about his missions
and obediently follows orders,
making him the leader among the
three.
 In the battle over Berlin's city
streets, he engaged the spirited
Orb Murasame forces and was shot
down without being able to
retreat. He was believed dead,
but later made a return in an
unexpected form.
244.DSC2:
Sting Oakley was an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
He stole the Chaos Gundam from
ZAFT and became its pilot. For
these Extendeds, a verbal safety
device called a 'Block Word' was
prepared to suppress their
rampages. Upon hearing that word,
they would immediately fall into a
state of confusion and lose
themselves. However, Sting's
'Block Word' was never revealed.
Compared to Auel and Stella, he
was the most mentally stable, and
he was earnest in his duties and
obediently followed orders, making
him the leader among the three.
In a battle over the streets of
Berlin, he engaged the spirited
Orb Murasame units and was shot
down without being able to
retreat. He was thought to have
died there, but later returned to
the front lines as the pilot of
the Destroy Gundam. However, he
had been transformed into a
biological CPU with further
enhancements and adjustments, and
his personality had become
pathologically bloodthirsty. In
the end, he was struck down by
Shinn, who was burning with rage
at his brutal fighting.

245.DSCR:
Auel Neider is an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
He stole the Abyss Gundam from
ZAFT and became its pilot.
 Just as his appearance still
retains boyishness, he is
capricious and free-spirited like
a youth. He casually talked back
to his superior Neo, ignored
withdrawal orders to achieve
results, and displayed numerous
problems in his words and
actions.
 For Extendeds like him, a verbal
safety device called a 'Block
Word' is prepared to suppress
their rampages. Upon hearing that
word, they immediately fall into
confusion and lose themselves. In
Auel's case, the word is 'Mom',
and he once fell into a confused
state due to uttering that word
himself.
245.DSC2:
Auel Neider was an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
He stole the Abyss Gundam from
ZAFT and became its pilot. True
to his youthful appearance, he was
capricious and free-spirited like
a boy. He would casually hurl
abuse at his superior, Neo, ignore
withdrawal orders to achieve
results, and showed numerous
problems in his words and
actions. For these Extendeds, a
verbal safety device called a
'Block Word' was prepared to
suppress their rampages. Upon
hearing that word, they would fall
into a state of confusion and lose
themselves. In Auel's case, the
word was 'Mother', and he once
fell into a state of confusion due
to his own utterance of that
word. He engaged Shinn's Blast
Impulse, which had manifested
SEED, and in a brief opening
created by using the explosion of
the Silhouette as a distraction,
his cockpit was pierced by a beam
javelin, and he vanished into the
sea.

246.DSCR:
Stella Loussier was an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance's
special forces unit, Phantom
Pain. She stole the Gaia Gundam
from ZAFT and became its pilot.
 For Extends such as herself, a
word-based safety device called a
'block word' was prepared to
suppress their rampages. Upon
hearing that word, she would
suddenly become confused and fall
into a state of losing herself.
In Stella's case, the word 'death'
served this function, and she
frequently fell into confusion
upon hearing it.
 Compared to Sting and Auel, she
was the most mentally unstable.
In normal times she was timid and
docile in personality, but in
combat she revealed a savage
destructive impulse. Whether she
obeyed Neo's orders obediently in
any state because of such
adjustments, or because of
personal feelings, remained
unclear.
 Reacting to Auel's words 'Mom's
going to die,' she sortied alone
as if to deny them. Though she
was counterattacked and taken
prisoner by the Minerva, she
escaped danger through the hands
of Shinn, who was a known
acquaintance. Stella was returned
on the condition that she would
not be drawn into battle
henceforth, but peaceful times did
not visit her.
246.DSC2:
Stella Loussier was an Extended
belonging to the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
She stole the Gaia Gundam from
ZAFT and became its pilot. For
these Extendeds, a verbal safety
device called a 'Block Word' was
prepared to suppress their
rampages. Upon hearing that word,
they would immediately fall into a
state of confusion and lose
themselves. In Stella's case, the
word was 'Death', and she would
frequently hear it and fall into a
state of confusion. Compared to
Sting and Auel, she was the most
mentally unstable. In normal
times she was timid and quiet, but
in combat she revealed a ferocious
destructive impulse. Whether her
obedient following of Neo's orders
in any state was due to such
adjustments or personal feelings
remains unknown. She reacted to
Auel's words 'Mother is going to
die' and, as if to deny them,
sortied alone. She was defeated
and taken prisoner by the Minerva,
but escaped danger through the
hand of Shinn, who was an
acquaintance. Stella was returned
on the condition that she not be
involved in battle from then on,
but peaceful times did not come to
her. Eventually, she was adjusted
once more and, having lost her
memories, was made the pilot of
the Destroy Gundam. With
overwhelming destructive power,
she burned the city of Berlin, its
inhabitants, and the garrison
forces to ashes. She briefly
regained her composure through
Shinn's persuasion, but upon
seeing the Freedom Gundam in her
sight, she fell into a frenzy. As
she was about to fire her beam as
if to wipe everything out, she was
stopped by Kira and consumed by
the explosion of her cockpit. In
her final moment, she regained her
memories and smiled, and fell into
an eternal sleep while watched
over by Shinn.

247.DSCR:
Ian Lee was a soldier belonging
to the Earth Alliance's special
forces unit, Phantom Pain. His
rank was Major.
 He served as captain of the newly
built ship Girty Lue, the unit's
mother ship, and was a capable
commander who could make calm and
accurate judgments. However,
after his superior Neo moved his
area of operations to the ground,
he was no longer seen.
247.DSC2:
Ian Lee was a soldier belonging
to the Earth Alliance special
forces unit Phantom Pain. His
rank was lieutenant colonel. He
served as captain of the Girty
Lue, the new vessel that served as
the unit's mother ship, and was a
capable commander who could make
cool and accurate judgments.
However, after his superior Neo's
area of activity moved to the
ground, he was no longer seen. He
appeared again briefly when
Djibril escaped from the Daedalus
base on the Moon, but was blown
away along with the bridge by Ray,
and was never to be seen again.

248.DSCR:
Mayu was Shinn's younger sister.
 During the previous war, she
lived in Orb with her family, but
they were exposed to the flames of
war when the Earth Alliance
invaded. While evacuating, she
was caught in stray fire and lost
her life along with her parents.
 At that time, because Shinn had
gone to retrieve the mobile phone
Mayu had dropped down a slope, in
the end only Shinn and Mayu's
phone remained in this world.
248.DSC2:
Mayu was Shinn's younger sister.
 During the previous war, she lived in Orb with
her family, but they were exposed to the flames of
war when the Earth Alliance invaded. While
evacuating, she was caught in stray fire and lost
her life along with her parents.
 At that time, because Shinn had gone to retrieve
the mobile phone Mayu had dropped down a slope, in
the end only Shinn and Mayu's phone remained in
this world.

249.DSCR:
Sato was a deserter formerly of
the ZAFT military, and the
leader-like figure commanding a
terrorist unit.
 Their unit was a gathering of
those who had lost loved ones in
the war. For that reason, they
harbored fierce anger not only
toward Naturals, but also toward
Coordinators who enjoyed a false
peace. Believing that Patrick
Zara's hardline strategy was the
righteous path for revenge and
reform, they plotted to drop
Junius Seven onto Earth.
 A veteran soldier, his skill was
genuine: while piloting the older
Jin High Maneuver Type 2, he
consistently overwhelmed the
spec-superior GuAIZ R, and fought
on at least equal footing with the
new Zaku.
249.DSC2:
Sato is a former ZAFT soldier who
deserted and now leads a terrorist
unit. Their group is made up of
those who lost loved ones in the
war. As such, they harbor intense
rage not only toward Naturals, but
also toward Coordinators who enjoy
a false peace. Believing that
Patrick Zala's hardline approach
was the correct path for vengeance
and reform, he plotted to drop
Junius Seven onto Earth.
 As a veteran, his skills were
formidable; despite piloting the
outdated ZIN High Maneuver Type
2, he consistently overwhelmed
the superior-spec Gates R and
fought on par with or better than
the new ZAKU. However, before the
might of veterans who had fought
through the previous war, such as
Yzak, his comrades were gradually
whittled down.
 In the end, he tried to take
Athrun with him, but was blocked
by Shinn and slammed into the
surface of Junius Seven, where he
exploded and died.

250.DSCR:
Baba was the leader of a Murasame
squadron belonging to the Orb
military. His rank was First
Lieutenant (Captain).
 In the battle off the coast of
Crete Island, he received an order
to cease fighting from Cagalli,
but he continued to fight to
protect his homeland.
250.DSC2:
Baba is the captain of a Murasame
unit belonging to the Orb forces.
His rank is First Lieutenant
(Captain). In the battle off the
coast of Crete, he received a
ceasefire order from Cagalli, but
continued to fight to protect his
homeland. He then launched a
suicide attack on the bow of the
Minerva and exploded along with
his machine.

251.DSCR:
President of the Atlantic
Federation, one of the powerful
nations belonging to the Earth
Alliance. On the surface he is
the supreme leader of the Earth
Alliance, but in truth he is a
puppet of LOGOS, and was forced by
its leader, Djibril, to decide on
the opening of hostilities with
PLANT.
251.DSC2:
Joseph Copeland is the president
of the Atlantic Federation, one of
the powerful nations belonging to
the Earth Alliance. On the
surface he is the supreme leader
of the Earth Alliance, but in
reality he is a puppet of LOGOS,
and was forced by its leader,
Djibril, to decide on opening
hostilities with PLANT. When
Requiem was fired at the Earth
Alliance base Alzachel on
Durandal's orders, he happened to
be present and was obliterated
along with the base.

252.DSCR:
A boy living in Urugusku who is
quite ordinary except for being
good at games. Seventeen years
old. His parents were killed by
Exodusists, so he despises the
Exodus, and, carrying that
emotional wound, he became a
shut-in. While spending his days
absorbed in the online game
'Overman Battle,' he eventually
achieved 200 consecutive wins
and obtained the champion title of
'King.' One day, in a prison
where he was held on false
charges, he met Gain and hitched
onto his escape. On the way, he
named the Overman he acquired
'King Gainer,' and showed off his
game champion skills against the
approaching Siberia Railway
guard. Then, almost without
meaning to, he took part in the
Exodus. Because of his past
experiences, he was initially
quite introverted. But while
various feelings - admiration for
and rebellion against Gain, his
feelings for Sara, and his own
sense of responsibility and
potential - swirled within him, he
kept fighting, and became a great
power in continuing the Exodus
under Yapan's ceiling. At the
same time, he grew as a person.
252.DSC2:
Gainer Sanga is an ordinary
seventeen-year-old boy living in
Ugrusk, notable only for his skill
at games. His parents were killed
by Exodusists, leaving him with a
deep-seated hatred of the Exodus
and a psychological scar that
drove him into seclusion.
Immersing himself in the online
game 'Overman Battle', he
eventually achieved 200
consecutive victories and earned
the champion title of 'King'.
 One day, in a prison where he was
held on false charges, he met Gain
and hitched onto the prison
break. Along the way, he obtained
an Overman, which he named 'King
Gainer', and showed off his game
champion skills against the
pursuing Siberian Railway guards.
Thus, he ended up participating in
the Exodus almost by default.
 Due to his past experiences, he
was initially quite introverted.
But through fighting amidst a
swirl of emotions - admiration for
and rebellion against Gain,
feelings for Sara, his own
responsibilities and potential -
he continued to battle, and the
ceiling of Yapan became a great
source of strength for continuing
the Exodus. At the same time, he
grew as a person.
 In a battle against Cynthia, his
game rival and a subordinate of
Kids Munt, he lost without being
able to fight seriously and was
gravely wounded. However, Cynthia
was also shocked by the real
combat where blood was actually
spilled, and that opening led to
her being captured by the
Overdevil.
 To save Cynthia, he undertook
special training to face both his
game rival and a real enemy
simultaneously. After a
hard-fought struggle, he achieved
victory and succeeded in
surpassing his former self.
Bearing the new title of 'King',
he headed to Cynthia, and although
he was absorbed by the Overdevil
along the way, he succeeded in
freeing her with the support of
Sara and Gain.

253.DSCR:
An Exodus contractor who designs
the Exodus of Urugusku.
Twenty-eight years old. A master
sniper whose shots from his
beloved sniper rifle 'Angerma
Tsaiza' never miss. He is known
by the alias 'Black Southern
Cross' for firing six cross-shaped
bullet marks into his targets, and
has a proud principle of not
shooting enemies who flee with
their backs turned. Because he
hits on women whenever he gets the
chance and says things that seem
half joking and half serious, he
is often thought of as a frivolous
man, but in fact he has a
principled and loyal character
that hates dishonesty. Moreover,
he is quick-witted, skilled in
hand-to-hand combat, and shows
excellent talent in handling
silhouette machines and Overmen.
In any case, he is a reliable man
no matter what you ask of him, and
those who know his true nature
place immense trust in him.
Though he does not show it, he
bears many painful pasts,
including tragedies experienced in
his birthplace and the death of
his lover. The name Gain also
seems to be an alias.
253.DSC2:
Gain Bijou is an Exodus
contractor who designs the Ugrusk
Exodus. He is 28 years old. He
is a master sniper whose shots
from his beloved sniper rifle
'Angerma Zaisa' always hit their
mark. He is known by the epithet
'Black Southern Cross' for carving
six cross-shaped bullet scars into
his targets, and holds the
chivalrous principle of never
shooting an opponent who turns his
back and flees.
 He often tries to charm women and
says things that may be lies or
sincere, so he is often seen as a
frivolous man, but in truth he is
a principled and loyal person who
detests crookedness. Furthermore,
he is quick-witted, skilled in
hand-to-hand combat, and
demonstrates excellent talent in
handling silhouette machines and
Overmen. He is a reliable man no
matter what he does, and those who
know his true nature place immense
trust in him.
 His current name is a pseudonym;
his real name is 'Charle Felibe'.
He was born into the ducal house
of Domepolis Ubbus, which was
ruined after a failed Exodus.
During that failed Exodus, he
experienced painful events,
including the death of his lover
Gaera and witnessing the slaughter
among the people of Ubbus.
However, by successfully (or in
the story, almost successfully)
pulling off the Ugrusk Exodus, it
seems that his past was at least
partially redeemed.

254.DSCR:
A classmate on whom Gainer
secretly harbors feelings.
Seventeen years old. A cheerful
and bright girl with the courage
to fight in a silhouette machine
as a member of the Gauli Squad,
and the strength to frequently
scold Gainer and Bello and to
contend with Adette as a fellow
woman. Her strong sense of
independence seems to stem largely
from the fact that she is an
orphan, and perhaps for that
reason she seemed to regard Gainer
as a particularly pathetic man.
Even so, as she acted together
with him in the Exodus and their
opportunities to interact
increased, she eventually revised
that view.
254.DSC2:
Sara Kodama is a classmate of
Gainer's whom he secretly harbors
feelings for. She is 17 years
old. As a member of the Gauli
Squad, she fights in a Silhouette
Machine with courage, and
possesses the strength to
frequently scold Gainer and Bello,
even holding her own against
Adette as a woman. She is a
cheerful and bright girl. Her
strong sense of independence seems
largely due to the fact that she
is actually an orphan, and perhaps
for that reason, she regarded
Gainer as a particularly pathetic
man. Even so, as they shared
actions during the Exodus and
their opportunities to interact
increased, she gradually revised
her opinion of him. When Gainer
confessed his feelings for Sara to
counter the Over Skill of Planeta,
it resounded throughout the
ceiling of Yapan. Sara ran off
blushing deeply, and nearly
everyone who saw or heard it
learned of their relationship.
Eventually, when Gainer suffered
an Over Freeze, she pressed her
lips to his to save him, but she
herself ended up in the same state
as a result. Then, she became a
servant of Cynthia and Gainer,
riding Jinba to steal the lives of
those on the ceiling of Yapan.
However, while being hindered by
Martina and Adette, she was
restored by the Over Heat of King
Gainer. In the end, also under
the watch of the people, she and
Gainer exchanged their feelings
for each other.

255.DSCR:
Gainer's classmate. Twenty years
old. While riding in a silhouette
machine as a member of the Gauli
Squad, he also serves as the
helmsman of the Bachacron that
tows Yapan's ceiling. Because he
repeated a grade, he is older than
Gainer and Sara, but despite that
he is a cheerful show-off who
lacks composure, and could easily
pass for their age. That
personality works in his favor,
making him a good partner with the
introverted Gainer, and they have
built a friendship that could be
called close friends. He has
feelings for Sara and always tries
to show off, but things never seem
to go well.
255.DSC2:
Bello Corish is a classmate of
Gainer's. He is 20 years old.
While serving as a member of the
Gauli Squad and boarding a
Silhouette Machine, he is also in
charge of steering the Bach Cron
that tows the ceiling of Yapan.
Because he repeated a grade, he is
older than Gainer and Sara, but
despite that, he is a bit of a
joker and restless, so he could
pass for the same age. However,
this personality works in his
favor, making him a good partner
for the introverted Gainer, and
they have built a friendship that
could be called close. He has
feelings for Sara and always
strives to show off his good
side. But the Exodus continued
without things going well for him,
and in the end, Sara ended up on
good terms with Gainer. After the
battle with the Overdevil, he gave
a somewhat desperate round of
applause to the two who had
exchanged their feelings.

256.DSCR:
Gauli Hughes is the captain of
the self-defense group 'Gauli
Squad' in Domepolis Urgusk, aged
28. He masters a suspicious art
called 'Yapan Ninpo,' and his
combat abilities are extremely
high, ranging from martial arts
(ninjutsu) to piloting Silhouette
Machines. Normally, he has a warm
and personable temperament, but
his true nature is that of an
Exodus supremacist. He does not
choose means or ends for the sake
of carrying out the Exodus, and at
times resorts to ruthless
measures. However, Gauli himself
feels conflict about his own
position.
256.DSC2:
Gauli Hughes is the captain of
the self-defense group 'Gauli
Squad' of Urgusk. He is 28
years old. He masters a
suspicious technique called 'Yapan
Ninpo,' and his combat abilities,
from physical arts (ninjutsu) to
piloting Silhouette Machines, are
extremely high. Normally, he has
a warm and gentle personality, but
his true nature is that of an
Exodus supremacist. For the sake
of carrying out the Exodus, he
does not choose his means or ends,
and at times he resorts to
merciless methods. In fact, it
was Gauli who killed Gainer's
parents, but he continued to
regret that act, harboring a
sentimentality that could not
fully commit to ruthlessness.
Because of this, he feels conflict
over his position. He was once
taken in by Desnetta due to this
weakness being exploited, but was
rescued by Gainer, who was
inwardly conflicted upon learning
the truth. In the final battle
against the Overdevil, he was Over
Freezed and lost his
sentimentality and conflict,
becoming an ice demon who sought
only to use his combat abilities
for destruction and slaughter.
However, receiving the desperate
kiss of Adette, who was in love
with Gauli, he thawed the darkness
in his heart.

257.DSCR:
Adette Kistler is a member of the
Siberian Railway Guard, aged
25. She has a caring,
big-sisterly personality, and was
respected by Kejinan and Enge as
'big sis' and by Jaboli as 'older
sister.' She frequently clashed
with the people of Yapan's
ceiling, such as fighting Gainer
to stop the Exodus, infiltrating
alone to seize Princess Ana, and
engaging in hand-to-hand combat
with Gain.
257.DSC2:
Adette Kistler is a member of the
Siberia Railway Guard. She is
25 years old. She has a caring,
big-sisterly nature and is
respected by Enge and Kejinan as
'Big Sis' and by Jaboli as
'Lady.' She frequently clashed
with the people of the ceiling of
Yapan, such as fighting Gainer to
prevent the Exodus, or
infiltrating alone to seize
Princess Ana and engaging Gain in
hand-to-hand combat. After
failing to attack Yassaba and
breaking off, she was left behind
on the ceiling of Yapan and lost
her destination. Later, while
participating in events like the
sports day, she ended up joining
the Exodus by circumstance.

258.DSCR:
Adette, who quit the Siberian
Railway and became a teacher at
the school Gainer attends. Due to
the circumstances that led her
there, she had no place to live
and forced her way into Gainer's
room as a live-in guest.
Initially, she caused problems
such as helping herself to the
students' lunches, but with her
innate adaptability, she quickly
settled into Yapan's ceiling.
Gainer, who lived with her,
described her as 'a clumsy, rough,
selfish, and truly hopeless
person.' When the people of
Domepolis Gangaran established a
self-defense group, her combat
abilities caught their eye and she
was chosen as captain, forming
'Adette Squad.' She stole a Dobek
from the Siberian Railway as a
substitute for her severance pay
and deployed it to the squad, and
though her methods remained as
ever, she displayed a captaincy
worthy of her drive and
leadership. She is only
interested in strong men, and gave
Gainer individual training to
toughen him up. During her
Siberian Railway days, her
interest was in Yassaba, but now
it seems to be in Gauli.
258.DSC2:
Having quit the Siberia Railway,
Adette became a teacher at the
school Gainer attends. Having
arrived at this state by
circumstance, she had no place to
live and forced her way into
Gainer's room as a freeloader.
Initially, she caused problems
like helping herself to the
students' school lunches, but with
her innate adaptability, she
quickly settled into life on the
ceiling of Yapan. 'A clumsy,
rough, selfish, truly hopeless
person' is how Gainer, who shared
bed and board with her, put it.
When the people of the dome polis
Gangaran established a
self-defense group, they were
impressed by her combat abilities
and selected her as captain,
forming the 'Adette Squad.' She
stole a Dobeck from the Siberia
Railway as her severance pay and
equipped her squad with it, and
though her methods were the same
as ever, she displayed a captaincy
befitting her drive and
leadership. She is only
interested in strong men and
provided individual training to
toughen up Gainer. During her
Siberia Railway days, her interest
was in Yassaba, but now it seems
to be in Gauli. When Gauli was
manipulated by the Over Freeze,
she kissed him without regard for
the danger and succeeded in
restoring his sense of self.

259.DSCR:
Ana Medal is the daughter of the
Medail duke family of Domepolis
Urgusk, aged 8. She was taken as
a nominal hostage for carrying out
the Exodus by Gain and Gainer, who
accompanied him. With her
abundant curiosity, she joins the
Exodus while enjoying herself.
She has an innocent personality
befitting her age, but at times
displays mature thinking and
speech. When taken hostage by
Asuham, she sternly condemned his
actions with a composed attitude.
259.DSC2:
Ana Medaiyu is the daughter of
the Medaiyu ducal family of
Domepolis Urgusk. She is eight
years old. She was taken as a
nominal hostage for carrying out
the Exodus by Gain and the Gainer
that accompanied him. Thanks to
her vigorous curiosity, she
accompanies the Exodus while
enjoying herself.
 While she has a guileless
personality befitting her age, she
sometimes shows adult-like
thinking and speech. When taken
hostage by Asuham, she criticized
his actions with a resolute
attitude.
 After defeating the Overdevil,
she performed the monkey dance
familiar from the opening.

260.DSCR:
Links is Ana's pet, consisting of
three creatures: Link, Linna, and
Lins. They look similar, but each
has distinct features such as the
color of their back or tail and
their gaze. However, only a few
people, including Ana, can tell

271.DSCR:
Yassaba Jin was the captain of
the Siberian Railway Guard. He
was 32 years old.
 He devoted himself wholeheartedly
to stopping the Exodus and rooting
out Exodus sympathizers, and he
would stop at nothing to
accomplish those goals. Yet his
character was more that of a
warrior than a soldier; he showed
a willingness to admit defeat with
grace, and occasionally revealed a
gentleness toward those without
power.
 He persistently attacked the
'Yapan Ceiling,' but each time he
was thwarted by King Gainer,
suffering defeat after defeat.
Though he was once taken prisoner,
he escaped by seizing an
opportunity, and during his flight
he encountered the fortune-telling
girl Eifa. He rescued the girl,
who had been mistreated by her
boss, but in the ensuing battle he
was defeated once again.
 With his options exhausted,
Yassaba carried out the Exodus
together with Eifa. But during
their escape they encountered a
Golem, and he was struck by
gunfire, after which his fate
became unknown.

272.DSCR:
Kejinan Dadd was a member of the
Siberian Railway Guard. He was
31 years old.
 He had a simple, easy-to-read
personality: he fawned over the
strong and was overbearing toward
the weak.
 When his captain Yassaba lost his
Overman, he tried to have him
killed and take over as captain
himself, and when he found himself
in a position superior to Adette,
he took advantage of it to press a
marriage proposal. Regardless of
who he was dealing with, his
actions remained consistent. In a
sense, one could say he was a man
of unwavering character to the
core.
272.DSC2:

settle for remaining a
'self-styled' Vice President.

273.DSCR:
Enge Gam was a member of the
Siberian Railway Guard. He was
30 years old.
 With his stern face and eyepatch,
he gave the impression of a tough,
rugged man, but inwardly he had a
somewhat pessimistic disposition.
 He subscribed to the idea of
being number two rather than
number one, and always yielded the
initiative to Kejinan, with whom
he always acted in concert.
However, this was largely a means
of avoiding responsibility when
trouble arose. And beneath it
all, he harbored a dark cunning,
ready to discard Kejinan at any
moment if the need arose.

274.DSCR:
Jaboli Mariera was a member of
the Siberian Railway Guard. He
was 23 years old.
 He was born and raised in the
countryside and carried a deep
inferiority complex about it. He
felt a strong admiration for Saint
Reigan of London IMA, which seemed
to embody the city, and especially
for Asuham, whom he adored and
addressed as 'Lady White Lily.'
Asuham called him the 'Man of the
Wild Rose,' but in truth it seemed
he was regarded as little more
than a convenient pawn.
 He handled Silhouette Machines
and Overmen competently, but since
he had never shot anyone, he was
poor at using firearms, revealing
a side of him unaccustomed to
violence.

275.DSCR:
Kashmar Bare was the operations
director of the Siberian Railway.
He was 39 years old.
 He hated nothing more than having
the railway timetable disrupted,
and his ruthlessness in
maintaining the schedule at any
cost earned him the nickname 'the
Ice Operations Director.'
 He was dispatched as captain of
the Railway Guard to fill the gap
left by the vanished Yassaba, and
above all to stop the Exodus of
the 'Yapan Ceiling,' the very
source of the timetable
disruptions.
 He spoke in a feminine manner,
wore purple lipstick and a mohawk,
and favored psycho Overmen that
sowed unease or read minds. Both
in appearance and in substance, he
was a thoroughly unmanly figure.
 Aside from timetable disruptions,
what he hated most was healthy
relationships between men and
women, and that had once proven to
be his undoing.

Southern Cross baptism struck his
back.

276.DSCR:
Asuham Boone is the captain of
the special forces unit 'Saint
Reigan' of the London IMA police
organization that governs
Domepolis. His rank is special
lieutenant, and he is 28 years
old. He is an elite with handsome
looks and high practical ability,
expected to have a bright future.
His refined demeanor strongly
attracted Jaboli. However, he
actually has a sociable but easily
excitable personality, and to
achieve his goals he will calmly
resort to treachery and taking
hostages. He is not merely a
handsome face but, in a sense, a
man full of human warmth. He
ostensibly uses the prevention of
the Exodus as his reason, but more
than that, he devotes himself to
capturing Gainer, repeatedly
launching attacks on the ceiling
of Yapan. The reason was that
Gainer had previously laid hands
on Asuham's sister Karin and then
left her, so Asuham was trying to
bring him back. Later, in order
to corner Gainer, he voluntarily
removed himself from the elite
course and transferred to the
Siberian Railway Guard.

279.DSCR:

he schemes to collect the parts of

sometimes shows oddly childish
behavior. It is hard to imagine

armed Asuham in a counterattack.

281.DSCR:
Cynthia Lane is the prized
protege of Kids Munto, eighteen
years old. She is a girl who
always has confectionery in her
mouth, with a guileless
personality and small stature,
leaving much childishness about
her. However, her mother and
grandmother come from a bloodline
with powerful Oversense, and
having been raised with elite
training as an Overman pilot, she
possesses combat ability beyond
what her appearance would
suggest. She has been acquainted
with Gainer through games for some
time, being both rival and friend,
and holds the title of 'Queen,'
the female counterpart to Gainer's
title of 'King.' There is a
tendency in her to view combat
aboard an Overman as an extension
of gaming.

282.DSCR:

fortune-telling stall in Urgusk.
She meets the fugitive Yassaba and
becomes close to him after
sheltering him. Having been
mistreated by her master, she is
invited by Yassaba to join the
Exodus toward the Indus region,
but she vanishes in a blast of
wind after being shot at by a
Golem attempting to stop them.

283.DSCR:
Roger Smith is the foremost
negotiator in Paradigm City, a
town that has lost its memories,
aged twenty-five. He advances
negotiations with a humorous and
witty tone, delivering results
beyond what his clients expect.
He is fundamentally a feminist and
a gentleman, but he is quick to
lose his temper, and against those
who refuse to listen to his words
and break good faith and rules, he
may resort to force. However, he
makes it a principle never to
carry a gun, no matter how
dangerous the job. He has a past
as a former military police
lieutenant, and is an old
acquaintance of Dastun. He is a
stubborn man who dislikes bending
his own views, but when Dorothy
says she wants to keep a cat, he
ends up granting such earnest
wishes despite his grumbling,
showing a good-natured side. He
holds the memory of piloting Big
O, and with Big O confronts great
evils. This is by no means an act
of playing at being a hero, but
the result of straightforward
anger toward those who break good
faith and human rules. Roger
himself does not know why he holds
the memory to pilot Big O. He
makes his home in a ruined bank on
72nd Street, Out of the Dome.
Because Roger has an extreme
preference for black, everyone
living in his mansion is required
to wear black clothing. Also,
only women may enter his mansion
unconditionally. His hobby is
collecting hourglasses, and he
also makes them himself. He
places great importance on a
refreshing awakening, though his
poor rising from sleep has seen
him roused by Dorothy's extreme
piano playing.

it was his policy never to carry a
gun, even on the most dangerous
jobs. He had a past as a former
military police lieutenant, and he
knew Dastun from those days. He
was a stubborn man who disliked
bending his own views, but he also
had an easygoing side, such as
when Dorothy said she wanted a
cat, and he ended up granting such
earnest wishes despite his
grumbling. He held the memory of
piloting the Big O and faced great
evils alongside it. This was
never a pretense of being a
champion of justice, but the
result of straightforward anger
toward those who broke sincerity
or the rules of humanity. Roger
himself did not know why he held
the memory that allowed him to
pilot the Big O. He made his home
in a decayed bank on 72nd Street
on the Out of Dome. Because Roger
had an extreme preference for
black, everyone living in his
mansion was required to wear black
clothes. Also, only women could
enter his mansion
unconditionally. His hobby was
collecting hourglasses, and he
also made them himself. While he
placed great importance on a
refreshing awakening, he had poor
mornings, and scenes were seen of
him being roused by Dorothy's
extreme piano playing. After the
battle with Big Fau, he negotiated
with Big Venus, which appeared to
reset the world, that is, with
Angel, and succeeded brilliantly
in the negotiation that determined
the world's fate.

284.DSCR:
R. Dorothy Wayneright is an
android created by Timothy
Wayneright in the likeness of his
own daughter. However, she is
quite heavy, weighing 130
kilograms. Lacking the funds to
pay her reward for the affair
concerning Wayneright's
inheritance, she chose to work as
a maid in Roger's mansion. Not
only is she highly complete as an
android, but she displays rich
expressions to Wayneright, showers
affection on cats, and poses
questions about love to Roger,
being made as a being very close
to human. Thus, Roger is
sometimes seen forgetting that she
is an android. The 'R' stands for
the R in 'Robot.' Her unfriendly
and high-handed attitude sometimes
leaves Roger at a loss, but over
time she became his good partner.
The headband portion of her head
is a memory drive, often used as a
light source as well. Playing the
piano is her hobby, but her
initial repertoire consisted only
of violent musical pieces.
However, under the instruction of
the pianist android R. Instole,
the breadth of her playing
gradually expanded.

285.DSCR:
Norman Berg is a butler serving
Roger, aged fifty-four. Long
before Roger came to the ruined
bank, he followed the memory of
Big O's maintenance and awaited
the arrival of his master. He
ably handles not only Big O's
upkeep but also the maintenance of
Roger's beloved car 'Griffon' and
all household affairs of the
mansion, displaying his versatile
abilities daily for Roger's sake.
Given his performance, it is no
exaggeration to say that Roger's
private life is sustained thanks
to him. He possesses an iron
spirit unshaken by anything, and
even when Roger was kidnapped, he
worried but remained calm and
composed without panicking. He
also showed a powerful side,
racing through battle zones on a
large motorcycle with sidecar, and
wielding heavy firearms when
enemies attacked.

286.DSCR:
Duston is the chief of the
Paradigm military police and
commander of the mobile unit, aged
47. He takes pride in his work
with the military police and is a
rugged man who faithfully follows
his duties. He is also a man of
justice who will defy orders from
above and act on his own judgment
to protect citizens, both inside
and outside the dome. Many
subordinates admire him and act
alongside him. With Roger, his
former subordinate, he sometimes
clashes, but at the bottom of
their hearts they trust each other
and have built a good friendship.
During the Megadeus incident, he
grew frustrated with his own
powerlessness and that of the
military police, and began to
doubt the very worth of the
military police's existence.

287.DSCR:
Angel is a woman of unknown
identity, with almost everything
about her, including her
nationality and age, shrouded in
mystery. She calls herself Angel
because of scars on her back that
look as though wings once grew
there. Her motives are unclear,
but she appears before Roger at
every opportunity, seemingly
aiming to obtain memory data. She
possesses a strong personality
that does not flinch before
anyone, and the drive to go even
to the dangerous bottom of the sea
if it means getting the memory.
She is registered with Paradigm
Corporation, but her actions do
not seem to prioritize the
company's interests.
287.DSC2:
Angel is a mysterious woman whose

But in the final episode, it is
revealed that her true identity is
the memories themselves.

288.DSCR:
Beck is a criminal who commits
misdeeds in Paradigm City, aged
22. He appears with vulgar
laughter and engages in all manner
of crimes, including bank robbery,
kidnapping, and fraud. His speech
and conduct are those of a petty
thug, and Roger calls him 'a
criminal unworthy of the title
professional.' Because he holds
memory data on alternative
interface technology essential for
operating Megadeus, he procures
Megadeus units and uses them in
his crimes. After being sent to
prison by Roger in the Soldano
heiress kidnapping incident, he
calls Roger 'that crow bastard'
and swears revenge. He repeatedly
escapes prison and devises schemes
time and again to send Roger to
his doom.
288.DSC2:

291.DSCR:
A memory digger who investigates
the truth behind memories lost

Press under the name Michael
Seebach, he became obsessed with

corridor. However, when he

Incidentally, Schwarzvalt means
'black forest' in German. Later,
he discovered the Big Duo and
challenged Roger to a duel but was
defeated. At that time, he was
shocked to see the Big Duo act on
its own and vanished from the
public stage. He has a habit of
speaking with meaningful words, as
if reciting poetry. He looks down
on those who do not seek the truth
and merely live in the present.

The head of Paradigm Corporation,

thoroughly looks down on the

292.DSC2:

to the Big O's monitor, attempting

293.DSC2:

In the end, the Big Duo Inferno

The first head of the Paradigm
Group. He has now left the

immense influence remains intact
to this day. He is a person who
may know the truth of the
memories, and when Roger visited
him, he cast words suggesting that
something had occurred between
himself and Roger. In his
unfinished book 'Metropolis', he
recorded events believed to have
taken place 40 years ago.

295.DSCR:
A killer clad in a red raincoat.
He awakened from a container left
underground in a marshalling yard
and, using a handgun, murdered one
after another those who had
recalled memories from over 40
years ago. His motive was an
order he heard from the moment of
awakening. The face beneath the
hood was that of an android
closely resembling Dorothy. The
'R' stands for 'RED', and the 'D'
stands for 'DESTINY'.

296.DSCR:

responsibility for her

As the one who held the Union
members together, she was
considered to have considerable
power within the organization.
However, after failing to punish

lose that power.
296.DSC2:

Big Ear is an information broker

well-versed in all kinds of
information, both within Paradigm
City and beyond. He always sits
in the same seat at the seedy bar
Speakeasy, reading the newspaper

297.DSC2:

information, both within and

speak-easy bar, he always sits in

the skeleton of an android.

298.DSCR:
Touga Tenkuuji is the pilot of
God Gravion and its core unit,
Gran Kaiser. He is 17 years
old. During his early childhood
in an orphanage, his strong G
Factor was recognized, and he was
adopted by Sandman. Since then,
he has undergone combat training
at St. Germain Castle to become
the Gran Kaiser pilot. As a
result, his personality has become
quite detached from the real
world. Normally gentle and
personable, once he enters battle
he coldly destroys enemies like a
combat machine. In that state, he
prioritizes defeating the enemy
above all else and does not balk
at accepting some casualties.
This imbalance sometimes leads him
to hurt others without realizing
it. However, through his
interactions with Eiji, who is his
complete opposite, he comes to
recognize what he lacks and begins
to suffer over it.
298.DSC2:
Pilot of the Gran Kaiser, and

during the Unite into God Gravion,

Gravion. 17 years old. During
his childhood in an orphanage, his
strong G Factor was recognized,

When he revealed Leele's past,

a fragile side, disappearing in a
daze. However, through his
interactions with Eiji, his exact
opposite, he came to recognize
what he lacked and began to
suffer. Finally, he realized that
the warrior's path lies not in
fighting to destroy the enemy, but
in fighting to protect what is
precious. Afterward, his emotions
became richer, and when he learned
that Eina, thought dead, was
alive, he wept tears of joy.

299.DSCR:
Eiji Shigure is the pilot of G
Attacker, which forms the right
leg of God Gravion. He is 17
years old. His surname is read
'Shigure'. He has an intense
sister complex, valuing Ayaka, the
sister who raised him since
childhood, above all else. When
she went missing, he infiltrated
St. Germain Castle alone to
search for her. By chance, he
boarded the G Attacker, and that
became the catalyst for him
becoming a pilot. His personality
is hot-blooded, and he is a
constant troublemaker, with
ignoring orders and going out
without permission being routine.
To Touga, he is truly a bad
influence, filling the naive boy's
head with all sorts of knowledge
and dragging him into reckless
situations. On the other hand,
Eiji has also boarded the Gran
Kaiser out of rivalry with Touga.
However, he frequently clashed
with Touga, angered by his
willingness to accept sacrifices
in battle and his attitude of
disregarding others' feelings.
299.DSC2:
Pilot of the G Attacker, which

Gravion, and of the Geo Mirage,

Sol Gravion. 17 years old. His
surname is read 'Shigure.' Since
childhood, his older sister Ayaka,

Even so, they recognized each

300.DSCR:
Runa Gusuku is the pilot of G
Driller, which forms the left arm
of God Gravion. She is 16 years
old. Her surname is read
'Gusuku'. She is a lively girl
from Okinawa who wears her
emotions on her sleeve, giving her
a very expressive face. She
possesses the bravery to face
harsh battles without fear. Since
meeting Touga at St. Germain
Castle as a child, when her father
brought her there, she has
harbored a budding romantic
feelings for him. As a result,
she is jealous of Eiji, who
appeared later and grew close to
Touga despite being another boy.
This is one reason the two are
constantly fighting, but through
their repeated squabbling, it
seems she has also begun to take
some interest in Eiji. She deeply
respects her late father, and she
joined the Grand Knights to carry
on his will, which he had reported
the discovery of Zeravire at the
cost of his life.
300.DSC2:
Pilot of the G Driller, which

forms the left arm of Sol
Gravion. 16 years old. Her

Gravion. She is 22 years old.
 A professional fighter who

Knights, many of whose members are

 She has a hobby of seducing men,

 She is a close friend of Ayaka,

Gravion. She is 16 years old.

 Although she is timid and lacks

305.DSCR:
The lord of Saint Germain Castle
and one of the world's wealthiest
men. Using his knowledge and
financial resources, he organized
Asgard and protects the peace of
Earth as its supreme commander.
However, his past and true
identity are shrouded in mystery.
 He possesses his own unique
aesthetic, and is a flawless
individual who carries out
anything he does in a stylish
manner. He has many fans even
among the maids working at Saint
Germain Castle.
305.DSC2:
Sandman is the lord of
Saint-Germain Castle and a
world-class tycoon. With his
knowledge and wealth, he organized
Asgard and, as its supreme
commander, protects the peace of
Earth. However, his past and
background remain shrouded in
mystery. He is a man of unique
aesthetics, flawless in everything
he does, always carrying it out in
style. He has many fans even
among the maids working at
Saint-Germain Castle. Yet,
because he carries the shameful
secret of his past alone, he has
shown a human side, quietly
retreating into his own shell at
times.

306.DSCR:
Sandman is a false name; his
real name is 'Zig Ehrlichmeyer'.
A scientist from the planet
Lambias, he developed the Genesis
machine 'Gran Sigma', capable of
destroying or even creating
planets, in order to save his
dying homeworld. However, a
difference of opinion brought him
into conflict with his
brother-in-law Hyugi, and as a
result, Lambias collapsed. He
escaped Lambias in the 'Gran
Sigma' and eventually reached
Earth. Over the long years that
followed, he built the Proto
Grandiva, God Gravion, and other
machines to protect Earth from his
brother-in-law, who would one day
come seeking revenge. By using
the G Factor within his body as a
metabolic function, his hair
turned purple, and he became
immortal and ageless. However,
because he boarded the 'Gran
Sigma' and released his G Factor
in order to fight, he has reverted
to his original blond hair.
306.DSC2:

After the battle with Zeravire

who had saved him both physically
and mentally.

307.DSCR:
The combat commander of Asgard.
He always conceals his face behind
a mask, which cannot be removed
without Sandman's permission. He
possesses an unyielding will,
always maintaining the composure
to correctly assess any
situation. In an emergency, he
issues precise orders to the Gran
Knights and the combat maid unit.
He enjoys Sandman's deep trust and
becomes the highest authority
during Sandman's absence. Because
of this position, he is often left
behind to mind the fort when the
others go on vacations or to hot
springs, a fact that deeply
grieves him. He is also in charge
of training the Gran Knights, and
he is particularly hard on Eiji.
When the Zeravire began their
full-scale invasion, he removed
his mask in order to spur on
Sandman, who was cowering in fear
of Hyugi's shadow, using his own
voice and words.

308.DSCR:

possesses the G Factor, its power
was too weak for her to pilot
Grandiva. To support him, she
chose to conceal her identity and
succeed the mantle of 'Raven',
without even telling the truth to
her close friend Mizuki. In her
role as 'Raven', when conducting
Gran Knight training or
punishment, she was especially
strict with Eiji. Whether this
stemmed from sisterly affection or
was a penalty for his insolent
talk toward Sandman remains a fine
line. When Sandman lost his will
to fight, cowering in fear of
Hyugi's shadow, she removed the
Raven mask and rallied him with
her own words.

317.DSCR:
Faye Xinlu is the captain of the
G Soldier unit belonging to the
Earth Federation government EFA,
with the rank of First
Lieutenant. Written in kanji, her
name is 'Fei Xin Lu.' During
combat in the Gran Trooper, she
issues formation orders to each
unit. Her piloting skill is of
course superb, and she possesses
excellent athletic ability and a
sharp intellect, earning deep
trust from both subordinates and
superiors. She spent her early
childhood in the same orphanage as
Touga, but the fact that Sandman
chose Touga over her became a
complex, and she resolved to
always be superior to Touga. That
feeling became a burden, and at

often scolded her subordinate Alex
for his seemingly frivolous
attitude, but their relationship
was never actually a bad one.

 In the final battle, she was

318.DSCR:
Alex Smith is a member of the G
Soldier unit belonging to the
Earth Federation government EFA,
with the rank of Lieutenant. He
was originally in the air force,
serving as a fighter pilot.
However, he was injured in an
attack by a Zeravire during a
mission, and after recovering he
was transferred into the G Soldier
unit. From then on, he rode in a
Gran Trooper whose main armament
was a gun. He is fundamentally
lighthearted in personality, and
his favorite things are girls,
robots, and Japan. Faye
reprimanded him many times for his
overly enthusiastic remarks and
behavior. However, he also
encouraged Faye when she was
troubled, and even in desperate
situations he endured while
believing in the Gravion's
arrival, showing that he has a
passionate side beneath his joker
exterior.

323.DSCR:
Hugi Zeravire is the elder
brother of Sandman's wife Lufira,
and the leader of the Zeravire.
 Originally an excellent
scientist, he developed the mass
slaughter system 'Genocideron' to
save the inhabitants of his dying
home planet Lambia from
environmental deterioration, by
exterminating the people of planet
Celia and securing a place to
emigrate. However, he clashed
with Sandman, who advocated
environmental restoration through
the Genesis machine 'Gran Sigma',
and in an accident during that
confrontation, he was trapped
within the runaway 'Genocideron'.
 After being absorbed into the
system, his desire for revenge
against Sandman was amplified, and
his mental balance was lost.
Combined with his belief that
Sandman was responsible for the
death of his beloved sister
Lufira, he came to resolve to
attack Earth with the destruction
machines 'Zeravire' that the
system had created.

324.DSCR:

She was wed to Sandman and bore

 She had always been frail, and
could not endure the strain of
childbirth, passing away in
exchange for Leele's birth.
However, she was revived as an
artificial life-form by Hugi, who
could not accept her death.
 She has no soul dwelling within
her, and has become a puppet
obedient to Hugi's commands.
324.DSC2:
Lufira is Hugi's younger sister.
She was united with Sandman, and
bore him a beloved daughter,
Leele. Originally frail of
health, she could not withstand
the burden of childbirth and
passed away in exchange for
Leele's birth. However, she was
revived as an artificial life-form
by Hugi, who could not accept her
death.
 No soul dwelt within her, and she
became a puppet obedient to Hugi's
commands. But when she witnessed
Sandman being wounded in the
battle against Hugi, she worked
the miracle of housing a soul
within her body. In the end, she
was consumed by flames inside the
collapsing Goma, together with her
brother's remains.

325.DSCR:
Lorrot is a ferret who is Leele's
pet and also her best friend.
 She spends all her time with
Leele except when Leele sorties.

326.DSCR:
A boy regarded as the
reincarnation of 'Wing of the Sun'
Apollonius. Estimated age 13.
 Having been orphaned during the
great catastrophe 11 years ago,
he joined forces with Baron and
others in the same situation and
lived tough as a street child.
 In addition to a rare wild
intuition, he has amazing eyesight
of 5.0 or better in both eyes,
and a keen sense of smell that can
distinguish even the scent of
infrared rays, let alone body
odor, making him worthy of being
called a wild child.
 His personality is
straightforward for better or
worse, and he tends to act in ways
that could be seen as selfish.
Though he seems to lack any sense
of solidarity, he harbors a
passionate friendship that fears
no danger for the sake of his
comrades. He boarded Aquarion in
order to rescue Baron, who had
been captured by the Shadow
Angels.
 For a while after entering the
Element School, he frequently
caused trouble due to unfamiliar
group life and standard play.
However, through battle he
acquired cooperation and teamwork,
and along with that, he began to
remember his past life.

years later.

327.DSCR:
A first-class Element attending
the Element School. Age 14.
 She is a princess of the old
Kingdom of Alicia, carrying the
bloodline of Apollonius and
Celian. She has the ability to
emit psychokinesis by gathering ki
in her left arm, allowing her to
lift or bend any object.
 Perhaps because she lost her
parents at a young age, she
harbors an abnormal affection for
her older brother Sirius. As a
result, she is wary of all women
who approach Sirius, and
especially harbors hostility
toward Reika. She inherits the
past life of Celian, and was
convinced that the reincarnation
of her former lover 'Wing of the
Sun' was Sirius. However, when
faced with the fact that the wild
child Apollo, who suddenly
appeared one day, might actually
be the 'Wing of the Sun,' she
stubbornly refused to accept it.
But with the help of her own past
life memories, she gradually came
to acknowledge it.
327.DSC2:

14 years old. She is a princess
of the old Kingdom of Alisia,

Angels' side, she too received an

However, upon hearing Apollo's
words, she decided to live as a
human and refused Sirius's
invitation. When the end of the
world arrived after the final
battle, she made Apollo and
Sirius, who continued to fight,
and Zushi (Toma) aware of the
existence of light born from
darkness through the memories of
Celian. Though she was ultimately
separated from Apollo, with whom
she had connected emotionally in
both her past life and the
present, she was certain that he
would someday return to this
planet.

328.DSCR:
A first-class Element attending
the Element School. Age 16.
 He is the prince of the old
Kingdom of Alicia and Silvia's
older brother. He cherishes a
rose named Alicia, recites poetry
at every opportunity, and pours
his affection on all beautiful
things. He recognizes Reika's
bearing as beautiful and holds
feelings for her. However, since
he thoroughly rejects ugliness and
savagery, which are the opposite,
he constantly clashes with Apollo,
who is a mass of wildness.
Regarding Apollo specifically, his
frustration at being unable to
recall his own past life and
jealousy toward him are also
largely involved.
 He possesses the Element ability
to emit high-speed vibrations from
his right arm, and by transmitting
this to a sword, he can produce
astonishing cutting power. His
hearing also far exceeds that of
ordinary people.
328.DSC2:

opportunity, and pours his

Later, when Zushi invited him to
