to stop him, saw the wing and
instinctively pulled her hand
back. Shocked by that reaction,
Sirius realized there was no
longer a place for him on the
earth and fell to the Heavenly
Wings.

329.DSCR:
A first-class Element attending
the Element School. Age 15.
Her name is read as 'Kou Reika.'
 Her Element abilities are strong
spiritual sensitivity and
psychometry that reads records.
However, because her abilities are
too powerful, she attracts trouble
wherever she goes. She is a
'woman who calls misfortune'
acknowledged by both herself and
others.
 Fearing that she might involve
those who approach her, she tends
to show a demeanor that keeps
others at a distance and a dark,
downcast expression. But in truth
she has a rich sensitivity, and
her specialty is sports in
general, making her active.
 She believed that Glen's serious
injury on her first sortie was due
to the misfortune she spreads, and
feared combining, sinking even
deeper into gloom. However,
through Commander Fudo's training
and surviving battles, she
gradually overcame her negative
emotions.
329.DSC2:
Reika is a first-class Element
attending Element School. She is
15 years old. Her name is read
'Kou-Reika.' Her Element
abilities are strong spiritual
sensitivity and psychometry that
reads records. However, because
these abilities are too powerful,

Fearing that she will involve
those who approach her, she tends
to show an atmosphere that keeps
others at a distance and a dark,
gloomy expression. But in truth,
she has a rich sensibility, and
her skills include sports in
general, making her active. When
Glen was seriously wounded on her
first sortie, she believed it was
due to the misfortune she spreads
and feared combining, sinking even
deeper into gloom. However,
through Commander Fudo's training
and surviving battles, she
gradually overcame her negative
emotions. When Glen was revived
after receiving a transplanted
Shadow Angel wing, she was
bewildered by his emotionless
continued fighting. Unable to
leave him in danger, she went to
his rescue, and that became the
catalyst for Glen to successfully
regain his sense of self. Glen
later lost his life in battle, but
the grown Reika continued fighting
without stopping and succeeded in
cutting off her own misfortune.

330.DSCR:
A first-class Element attending
the Element School. Age 17.
 He has the Element ability to
control fire, and is a hot-blooded
man burning in both body and
spirit. He was once active as a
professional soccer player, but
joined DEAVA after all his
teammates and spectators were
taken by a Mythical Beast during a
match.
 Perhaps considering himself the
mood maker of the Elements, he
always brightens the atmosphere
with his innate cheerfulness.
However, when Apollo went out of
control thinking only of himself,
he showed a sportsmanlike side
that values harmony, shouting at
him to cooperate and face the
enemy.
 He is thought to be a frivolous
man who hits on any woman he sees,
but this behavior comes from his
own bravado to cover up the
heartbreak of his first love,
Esperansa, having married his
older brother Lopes.

331.DSCR:
Jun is a first-class Element
attending the Element School. He
is 14 years old. He is strong
with machines and computers, and
his true value shines in
intellectual work such as
information analysis. His
knowledge of hacking in particular
runs deep, and he can access state
secrets at will. On the other
hand, his lack of physical
strength is conspicuous, and he
always struggles with the training
that Commander Fudo assigns. He
is also an idol otaku, and his
favorite figure 'Manamana-chan' is
displayed on top of the computer
in his room. As an Element, he
possesses the ability of
thoughtography, projecting images
onto film or digital screens.
However, he cannot see the images
directly until they are actually
projected. He has feelings for
Tsugumi, who entered the Element
School at the same time as him,
but Tsugumi's heart seems to be
elsewhere, and their relationship
never seems to progress.

Before the final battle, he

332.DSCR:
Tsugumi is a first-class Element
attending the Element School. She
is 15 years old. She is a
bright and cheerful girl, but she
sometimes makes major blunders.
Though one would not imagine it
from her usual timid demeanor, she
also harbors an earnest,
headstrong passionate side. She
also seems to hold feelings for
her senior Reika that go beyond
mere respect and admiration. Her
hobby and specialty is tinkering
with machinery, and her skill is
such that she once repaired her
beloved car, the Isetta, which she
received from her grandfather.
Her Element ability causes
explosions around her when her
excitement reaches its peak.
Because of this, she was
ostracized by others in her
childhood, and it remains a trauma
to this day.
332.DSC2:

Though her usual timid demeanor

She defeated the enemy splendidly

heading to the final battle, she
piloted Aquarion Angel and, using
her explosion ability, broke
through the gate to Atlandia.

333.DSCR:
Reena is a mysterious girl of
unknown age who serves as an
Element belonging to DEAVA. She
possesses very strong psychic
sensitivity, and has the Element
ability to judge people's hearts
and the surrounding environment
through the shape and color of
their auras. She is also a
prophet who performs various
divinations using the 'Book of
Genesis,' and her abilities are
highly regarded within DEAVA. She
absorbs prana from blood and can
teleport without using the Element
Change System, among other
mysteries, to the point that
rumors of her being a vampire once
circulated. However, with
Apollo's help, her comrades
eventually came to recognize that
her special powers, too, were
simply part of who Reena is.

334.DSCR:
Glen was a first-class Element at
the Element School who posted
results on par with Sirius and
Reika. He was 17 years old. In
addition to his kindhearted
personality, he possessed superior
qualities as an Element. He had
built a firm relationship of trust
with Sirius and the others. In
his first actual combat, he
achieved union with Reika, for
whom he harbored feelings.
However, he was hit during that
battle and suffered severe
injuries.

Glen, revived from a coma after

transplanted into him. The

335.DSC2:

Mars piloted by Shishi, who was

338.DSCR:
Fudo GEN is the commander of the
Aquarion deployment unit of the
special agency 'DEAVA, the Earth
Regeneration Organization.' He
also serves as an instructor at
the Element School. His age is
unknown. He appears and
disappears at will, showing up
anywhere, earning him the nickname
'the Magician of Divine Speed.'
He has mastered a wide and deep
range of skills, from magic tricks
such as producing arrows from
nowhere or suddenly enlarging
sheets of paper, to astonishing
abilities like reading people's
minds, summoning wild hawks with a
single finger, and discerning a
person's personality and
preferences from their footprints
alone. Aside from having been a
member of the Aquarion excavation
survey team, his past history is
entirely unknown. Even how he
became commander is a mystery, yet
his words carry a strange
persuasiveness. He constantly
gives the Elements hints to
overcome difficulties, guiding
them to victory.

339.DSCR:
Jean Jerome Georges is the vice
commander of DEAVA's Aquarion
deployment unit. He is 24 years
old. He has been involved in the
organization's founding since he
was a boy, and several members of
his family hold positions in
DEAVA's upper ranks. He possesses
a genius intellect, holding
doctorates in various fields such
as military and defense science,
and has mastered thirteen
languages. However, his overly
serious personality works against
him, leaving him inflexible and
unable to conduct operations with
adaptability, which is his
drawback. As a result, in the
presence of Commander Fudo, who
leads the Elements with bold
actions and weighty words, he
tends to be overshadowed. In
addition, the unruly behavior of
the overly individualistic
Elements is a constant source of
headaches for him.

too had come under Fudo GEN's
influence, and the sight of him
issuing sortie orders to Aquarion
was the very image of the
commander he had aspired to be.

340.DSCR:
Sophia Blanc is a psychotherapist
responsible for the mental care of
the Elements and candidates at the
Element School. She is 27 years
old. Although she is not an
Element ability user herself, she
possesses abundant knowledge and
experience regarding the worries
and doubts unique to ability
users. Furthermore, as she is a
leading researcher in the study of
combination, she serves as a great
pillar of support for the boys and
girls on the psychological front.

Angel tribe and the front-line

Angels. He had wings on the back
of his head, but aside from that,
his appearance was the closest to
human among the Shadow Angels.
Twelve thousand years ago, he was
betrothed to Apollonius, the
strongest guardian Shadow Angel.
However, when Apollonius betrayed
the Shadow Angels at the end of
the Atlantia War, Zushi faced him
as an enemy. Yet his love had not
faded even now, and he repeatedly
made contact with Apollo, who
seemed to be Apollonius's
reincarnation. Incidentally,
'Shadow Angel' was a derogatory
term used by humans for the Shadow
Angels, who called themselves
'Winged Ones' - the derogatory
term humans used among the Shadow
Angels was 'wingless ones' or
'wingless people'. However, it
could be said that only
Apollonius, who betrayed the
Shadow Angel tribe, was truly a
'Shadow Angel' in their eyes.

Angel' is a derogatory term used

Angel side is 'wingless' or

343.DSCR:
Otoha was the music wing of the
Shadow Angel tribe. At first
glance she appeared as a beautiful
woman, but beneath her robes she
concealed a snake-like lower
half. The parts that looked like
eyebrows were also eyes, and when
her emotions ran high, all four
eyes would open wide. As the
lover of the holy Shadow Angel
Zushi in the present age, she
burned with dark jealousy toward
Apollonius, who still attracted
Zushi's heart. The wings covering
both her arms could be strummed
like a harp or produce fine
vibrations to make music. Though
the tone was beautiful, it held
powerful demonic qualities that
could drive listeners mad or even
manipulate the weather.

344.DSCR:
Yohanes was an aged wise wing who
governed the darkness of the
world. He was an elder of the
Shadow Angel tribe and one of the
development members who had
performed genetic manipulation on
the 'wings' born from sudden
mutation, evolving them into
'Shadow Angels'. Much of his body
had already been lost, and chains
were wound around the remaining
parts as if to bind them. He had
bat-like wings on his back. He
realized that in the near future,
his soul would depart from his
body. Before that happened, he
sought to gather prana at the Tree
of Life and revive Atlantia as it
once was, in order to prevent the
extinction of the Shadow Angel
tribe.

345.DSCR:

wings on his back. The eyes
visible through the cloth covering
his face conveyed no emotion,

Belligerent and self-confident, he
held a strong rivalry with Zushi

attitude toward him, but he

346.DSCR:
Lenshi is the prototype wing of
the Shadow Angels.
 By adding mythic power to figures
created with his own hands, he is
able to forge Cherudim soldiers
and Mythical Beasts. It is this
very skill that earned him the
reputation of having the
fingertips of a god.
 His dome-shaped body and mask,
which appears to have lenses
attached, give the impression of a
scientist indulging in mad
experiments within a laboratory.
Two pairs of wings grow from the
sides of his head.

347.DSCR:
Goushi is the wing of monstrous

 With wings running from the crown

 Among the Shadow Angels, he is
closest to Futaba, the small
wing.

348.DSCR:
Futaba is the last small wing
remaining among the Shadow
Angels.
 She has wings at her ankles, and
parts of her body, such as her
shoulders and arms, have machinery
attached.
 After the Atlandia War twelve
thousand years ago, children
became almost nonexistent among
the Shadow Angels, making her a

Shadow Angels. Perhaps because of
this, she has grown into a very

 Driven by her naturally abundant
curiosity, she constantly

sphinx.
 He also serves as the caretaker

from taking a stern approach,

351.DSCR:

with the Shadow Angels and began

the present day, Apollo carries
his past life, and on rare
occasions his personality
surfaces.

353.DSCR:
A fourteen-year-old boy whose
father was a hero who once saved
the world. He has a
straightforward personality -
simple, pure-hearted, bright, and
positive. Because of this, he has
a tendency to lose sight of his
surroundings when he gets too
absorbed in something. Also,
everything he thinks shows on his
face, which makes him a target for
teasing from the adults around
him. He is also at that age where
being seen through the lens of
being a hero's son is a source of
frustration. He lives alone with
his grandfather in the rural town
of Bellforest, and while
dissatisfied with his boring,
unchanging daily life, he spent
his days aimlessly devoting
himself to his bike and lift
board. However, when he fell in
love at first sight with Eureka,
who suddenly descended from the
sky, he became a member of
Gekkostate at the invitation of
his idol Holland and her. While
being worked hard as an errand
boy, he boarded the Nirvash
alongside Eureka during sorties.
At first he only sat in the
sub-seat, but gradually he began
to show promise as a rider.
Eventually he came to hold an
indispensable presence for
Gekkostate and for Eureka.

Gekkostate was not merely a lift

meeting and parting with people

making up with Eureka, and the

greatly as a person.

354.DSCR:
In the final episode, Renton rose
up to save Eureka. His slightly
longer hair and resolute
expression show considerable
growth. And the Nirvash,

evolved into Spec 3.

search for Renton, who had run
away from home.

359.DSCR:
The leader of the
anti-establishment group
Gekkostate. 29 years old. He

lift boarders. Renton also had a
strong admiration for him, putting
posters in his room and using a

excessively confident and always
leads the members with a strong
attitude. Yet during lifts he
never loses his composure, which
is what makes him who he is. He
once belonged to the Federation of
the Tower State military, but
defected after a certain
incident. He seized the Gekko-Goh
and the Nirvash and organized
Gekkostate. He and Talho are
lovers, but because all his
actions prioritize Eureka above
all, this has become a source of
trouble. With Renton, who in some
ways resembles his former self, it
seems minor clashes are constant.

397.DSCR:

earnest personality and strives
diligently to fulfill the tasks
and roles assigned to her.
However, due to her lack of
self-confidence and timid nature,

approach to things, and inwardly
she harbors doubts about whether a
soldier's life truly suits her.
Although she has no combat
experience, her careful piloting
skill is highly regarded, and she
has been newly assigned to Glory
Star. Her hobby is going around
tasting sweets at various shops.

400.DSCR:
Rand Travis is a man who runs the
wandering repair shop 'Beater

He calls himself 'The Heat,' a

He regards a drink after work as

business. He travels the desolate
land with Mel in search of his

403.DSCR:
Eder Bernal is a major general in
the New Earth Federation Forces.
She is a powerful figure within
the military who was promoted to
major general in recognition of
her achievements in establishing
the UN. She has a gentle and
thoughtful personality, worries
about the future of the
multi-dimensional world, and has
many followers within the
military. She intends to reform
the corrupt upper echelons from
within, and to that end she
directs her personal special
operations unit, Kaimera, to
secretly support various
organizations and individuals.
She carries herself with refined
manners and never loses her
Madonna-like smile, but she will
occasionally resort to physical
force to stop Dr. Z's rampages.
403.DSC2:

the UN. She had a gentle and

multi-dimensional world, and

truth, she was an egotist who
looked down on others and believed
herself the most fit to rule the
world. Her true nature was that
of an artificial human created by
Ji Eidel Bernal, and every action
she took was predetermined by Ji
Eidel.

404.DSCR:
Eder Bernal is a major general in
the New Earth Federation Forces.
She has begun taking action to
bring the entire world under her
control, aiming to become the
'Ruler of the New World'.
404.DSC2:
A brigadier general of the New
Earth Federation Forces. She
began actions to bring the entire
world under her control, aiming to
become the 'ruler of the new
world.' Her true identity is an
artificial human created by Ji
Eder Bernard to satisfy his own
desires. Everything about her,
from her appearance and
personality to her thoughts and
hobbies, was set by Ji Eder. Ji
Eder installed the 'Bind Spell,'
an activation key for absolute
obedience, into Eder, and through
it he controlled her actions while
in the form of Jee. Eder did not
know she was an artificial human
until her final moments, and when
she learned the truth, she
completely lost her reason and
fell into a state of rampage.

405.DSCR:
Dr. Z is the true identity of
Eder Bernal, and the man who
created the android Eder Bernal.
He has succeeded in limited
control of the power of the Origin
Law, and he uses that power to act
on his own desires. His principle
of action is summed up in the
phrase 'As long as it's
interesting!' and he enjoys the
existence of the multi-dimensional
world born from the space-time
vibration bomb more than anyone
else. By applying the power of
the Origin Law, he integrates the
abilities of multiple selves
existing between parallel worlds,
surpassing ordinary humans in
every respect. Furthermore, he is
liberated from concepts such as
ethics and morality, and is driven
by desires that others find
difficult to understand, making
his intentions and actions hard to
predict.
405.DSC2:
The true form of Doctor Jee, and
the man who created the artificial
human Eder Bernard. The name Ji
Eder Bernard is also a convenient
alias; his real name exists
separately. He has succeeded in
the limited control of the power
of origin (Origin Law), and uses
that power to act as his desires
dictate. His principle of action
is the single phrase, 'If it's
interesting, it's good!' and he
enjoys the existence of the
multi-dimensional world born from
the temporal oscillation warheads
more than anyone else. Through
the application of the power of
origin, he integrates the
abilities of multiple selves
existing between parallel worlds,
surpassing ordinary humans in
every respect. He is also freed
from concepts such as ethics and
morality, and is driven by desires
that others find difficult to
understand, making his intentions
and actions hard to read. The
process by which he unraveled the
power of origin remains shrouded
in mystery.

energy, and he is very fond of

Federation Forces and establish

world. During infiltration

man to put opponents off guard.
However, his true personality is
hysterical and self-centered, and
he goes beyond having a phobia to
actually hate the existence of
women. The sole exception to his
misogyny is Eder, and he openly
declares that he would give even
his life for her sake.

under Edel's direct command, with
the rank of lieutenant. He shows
his true worth in rear-area
missions such as maintaining
public order and information
warfare. Because he is calm and
composed and never loses his cool
demeanor no matter the situation,
he sometimes gives others a cold
impression. He and Raven are
close friends.
408.DSC2:

emotions, and for that reason he

409.DSCR:

wears a bewitching smile, but she
has a fierce and radical

409.DSC2:

officer of the New Earth
Federation Army. As captain of

directly under Edel, she also
served as the liaison between
Kaiymera and Asakim, accompanying
him in his activities. Having
been present at the detonation of
the time-space oscillation bomb,

resulting displacement and was
condemned to a harsh life across
the multi-dimensional worlds. For
this reason, she hated chaos and
took part in Edel's plan to govern
Earth, while also serving Ji-Edel
as a free existence who could
rescue her from her trauma.
However, she could not keep up
with his extreme personality and
gradually found herself drawn to
Asakim.

410.DSCR:
A young man in black robes,

mobile weapon Shurouga, appearing

410.DSC2:

the past and being forbidden even
to die, wanders through various
times and spaces together with
Shurouga. To escape this fate, he
wishes to obtain the power of the
Taiji, and he himself participates
in the battles among the owners of
the Spheres, which are fragments
of the Taiji's will.

relating to space and UFOs. Its director is
Dr. Genzo Umon, an authority on space science.
 When the Vegan invasion of Earth began, it
became the base for Grendizer and the Spazer,
and stood against the great evil from space.

1.DSCR:
An underground nation ruled by the Reptilian
Humanoids, reptiles that evolved into a humanoid
race. Led by Emperor Gore, who worships the
great demon god Yura, they launched an invasion
to seize the surface world.
 The Reptilian Humanoids once ruled the surface,
but they could not withstand the Getter Rays
that suddenly rained down from space, and were
driven into the magma layers deep underground.
For that reason they were obsessed with
destroying Getter Robo, which draws its power
from Getter Rays.
 In their final operation they sent out the
Invincible Battleship Dai, mightiest of all the
Mechasaurus. But Musashi Tomoe rammed it in a
Command Machine loaded with explosives, and Dai
went out of control. Gore was caught in the
destruction and died, and the Dinosaur Empire
was annihilated.

The military of Planet S-1, also called the
Aldebaron Army.
 Following Gattler, who rebelled against the
emperor and seized control of the nation, they
set out to invade Earth as their new homeland.
Their supreme commander is Rosa Aphrodia.
 They possess technology that lets them pass in
and out of subspace at will, and confounded
Earth's forces with operations that struck from
nowhere.
 Their headquarters is the subspace fortress
Algol, where great numbers of S-1 natives sleep
in cryogenic capsules, awaiting the time of
their awakening.

A layer of distortion lying above the world
that formed when parallel worlds overlapped.
Space-time within the layer is unstable and
cannot be crossed, so passage between space and
the surface is impossible.
 Because this layer exists, a greenhouse effect
has driven surface temperatures up, causing
serious damage.
 The term also refers to the merged world
itself, born from the effects of the space-time
oscillation bomb.

4.DSCR:
A people of advanced science and technology who
live in domed cities called Points. They supply
the Civilians with Walker Machines and buy up
the Blue Stone they mine.
 Their ancestors were the humans who fled into
space to escape the great upheaval that struck
Earth. When they returned long afterward, what
they found was the ravaged land of Zora - a
world turned so hostile that a few hours in the
open air meant death for them.
 So they created a new race suited to Zora's
environment, the Civilians, as the heirs who
would carry on their civilization. They also
succeeded in building an economy on trade in
Blue Stone, worthless to the Innocent
themselves, and in instilling order through the
Three Day Law.
 As the Civilians rose, Kashim King feared the
Innocent would lose their dominion over Zora,
and cracked down on the resistance again and
again to hold them in check. But Jiron and his
companions threw off even that oppression, and
at last the rule of the Innocent was
overturned.

passed, what they saw was the ruined land of
Zora. It had become an infinitely dangerous
planet for them, where exposure to the outside
air for even a few hours meant death. So they
created the new humanity, the Civilians, adapted
to Zora's environment, as successors to carry on
their civilization. They also succeeded in
teaching them economics through trade in Blue
Stones, which were worthless to the Innocent,
and order through the Law of Three Days.
Fearing that the rise of these Civilians would
cost the Innocent their dominance over Zora,
Kasim King repeatedly suppressed them through
resistance organizations. But Jiron and the
others, who overcame even that crisis, finally
overturned the Innocent's system of rule. The
Innocent seemed destined for extinction, but
through research they developed technology that
allowed them to live outside the domes as well.
From then on, both peoples came to live together
hand in hand.

5.DSCR:
The supreme head of the Innocent. His full
name is Arthur Rank, a name handed down through
generations of Innocent leaders.
 He was confined at Point Yop by his aide Kashim
King. Rescued by Jiron and the others, he saw
promise in them and entrusted Zora's future to
them.
 Later, to save Elche after Kashim's mind was
transplanted into her, he had Kashim's
consciousness transferred into himself instead.
It turned his character violent, but he wrung
out the last of his strength and leapt from the
Iron Gear together with a bomb.

6.DSCR:
The most powerful figure among the Innocent.
 He clung to the conviction that Zora should be
ruled by the Innocent themselves and not by the
new race. To that end he imprisoned his lord
Arthur and sought to control the Civilians as he
pleased and rule Zora.
 But he met the resistance of the Civilians led
by Jiron and his companions, and died in the
decisive battle at X Point. With that battle
the Innocent lost their dominion over Zora.

7.DSCR:
A special forces unit of the Earth Federation
Forces, made up of elites born on Earth. Its
current commander is Jamitov Hymem.
 It was established in U.C. 0083 to keep
watch on the Spacenoids, prompted by the colony
drop operation 'Stardust' carried out by
remnants of the Principality of Zeon. In truth,
however, it was formed to oppress the
Spacenoids, and would not stop short of
massacring colony residents with poison gas.
Its soldiers grew drunk on that power, sinking
into an arrogance that had them boasting the
Titans stood 'two grades above ordinary officers
and men'.
7.DSC2:
The Titans are a special forces unit of the
Earth Federation Forces composed of elites from
Earth. The current commander-in-chief is
Jamitov Hyman. They were established in U.C.

Spacenoids, following the Zeon remnant force's
colony drop operation 'Stardust'. In reality,

oppress Spacenoids, and would not hesitate to
commit mass murder of colony residents with
poison gas if necessary. The soldiers belonging
to it were intoxicated by their power, and
became steeped in arrogance, boasting things
like 'The Titans outrank regular soldiers by two
grades'. But after repeated conflicts with the
AEUG and Axis, the organization's upper echelons
were annihilated, and it was effectively
dissolved. The war between the AEUG and the
Titans that took place in U.C. 0087 is
called the 'Gryps Conflict'.

8.DSCR:
A military organization formed to oppose the
tyranny of the Titans, centered on Brigadier
General Blex Forer, who is also a member of the
Earth Federation Assembly. Its formal name is
the 'Anti Earth Union Government'.
 Supplied with mobile suits by its sponsor
Anaheim Electronics, it resists the Titans'
oppression of the Spacenoids. Many who share
its cause have joined besides career soldiers,
but the AEUG is ultimately an organization
within the Earth Federation Forces. For that
reason some hold that the fighting between them
is no more than an internal military
insurrection.
 It keeps a cooperative relationship with
Karaba, the anti-Earth Federation organization
on Earth, and their joint operations dealt heavy
blows to the Titans' ground forces.
8.DSC2:

name is 'Anti Earth Union Government'.

relationship with the Earth-based
anti-Federation organization Karaba, and joint
operations by the two dealt heavy blows to the
Titans' ground forces. After Blex was
assassinated, Quattro Bageena, otherwise known
as Char Aznable, rose as their leader and
exposed the Titans' misdeeds at the Dakar
Federation Congress.

9.DSCR:
A support organization for the AEUG on Earth,
formed by Hayato Kobayashi. Its flagship is the
Garuda-class large transport aircraft
'Audhumla'.
 Moving in step with the AEUG, it fought the
Titans alongside them from North America through
to East Asia.
 Amuro Ray, a hero of the One Year War, later
joined, and the group went on to build up its
strength further, even developing the Dijeh on
its own.

10.DSCR:
A colony cluster in the L2 region on the far
side of the Moon, also known as Munzo. It is
the Side farthest from Earth, the place where
Zeon Zum Deikun, who advocated Contolism, once
lived, and the stronghold of the Principality of
Zeon during the One Year War.
 With its ruling Zabi family wiped out to the
last in the One Year War, the Principality of
Zeon has since been reborn as the Republic of
Zeon. In the Gryps Conflict, however, it has
been forced into cooperating with the Titans.

11.DSCR:
The doctrine that by moving the foundations of
their lives into space, humankind can attain the
'Newtype' - a new innovation of the species
adapted to space.
 Advocated by Zeon Zum Deikun, this thinking
spread widely among the Spacenoids who resented
the Earth Federation government. Zeon then had
Side 3 declare independence as the Republic of
Zeon in order to put Contolism into practice.
 But as it merged with 'Elezm', which held that
humans should live in space and revere Earth as
a holy land, and with 'Sidezm', which held that
colonies should be recognized as nations Side by
Side, it drew still greater resentment from the
Earthnoids living on Earth. The pressure on the
Spacenoids grew harsher as a result, and the two
came to stand on the brink of open conflict.
 Even so, Zeon sought a settlement through
dialogue with the Federation government - only
to die with his work half done. After his death
the Zabi family twisted Contolism into the claim
that 'the Spacenoids are the chosen people',
renamed it 'Zeonism', and used it in the One
Year War that broke out against the Earth
Federation.

12.DSCR:
The politician who advocated Contolism - that
humankind should advance into space - and who
led the Spacenoids. He later had Side 3
declare independence as the Republic of Zeon.
He is also the father of Char Aznable, known as
Quattro Bajeena.
 He foresaw the birth of the 'Newtype', humans
adapted to the space environment, and kept up
patient negotiations with the Earth Federation
to protect Earth's environment and realize that
innovation. But those around him grew impatient
with the high-handed attitude of the Earth
Federation government, and came to believe the
Spacenoids' long-held wish should be made known
to the world by force.
 It was then that Zeon died suddenly, and his
hardline aide Degin Sodo Zabi became his
successor. Degin turned the Republic into the
Principality of Zeon and declared war on the
Earth Federation, placing his kin in the
military's key posts. From this, the prevailing
theory is that Zeon's death was an assassination
by the Zabi family.

13.DSCR:
The armed forces held by the Inglessa and
Borjarno territories. They are called by the
name of the territory they belong to, as in the
'Inglessa Militia'.
 Until direct negotiations with the Moonrace
began, they possessed only weapons that recalled
the age of the Industrial Revolution, such as
biplanes and cannon. But ever since the Turn A
Gundam emerged from the White Doll, they have
unearthed mobile suits one after another from
the Mountain Cycles and strengthened their
armament.

14.DSCR:
Gendarme is a dome city on the Moon that serves
as the capital of the Moonrace's living sphere.
It was built by the Ghingnham family, who
continue to serve as the city's guardians.
 The palace of Queen Dianna Soreil, the 'White
Palace,' and the 'Winter Palace,' a facility for
the cryogenic hibernation of countless citizens,
are also located here.
14.DSC2:

sphere. The Ghingnham family built it and also

castle of Queen Dianna Soreil, and the Winter
Palace, an artificial hibernation facility where
many citizens sleep, are also located here. In
addition, records of the Dark History remain
beneath the Winter Palace, and it was here that
the threat of civilization's collapse by the
M-Fly was made clear.

15.DSCR:
An autonomous city in the northern part of the
North American continent, governed by Mayor
Nomoa Long. It is protected by a civilian
defense force centered on Carris Nautilus, an
artificial Newtype created by Nomoa.
 In truth, Nomoa was Dr. Dorat of the Space
Revolutionary Army in disguise, and Fort Severn
was built as a cover to restore the giant
Newtype-exclusive mobile armor Patulia, in order
to complete 'Operation Lilac,' a plan that had
been foiled by the Federation forces during the
Seventh Space War. Nomoa activated Patulia with
Carris as its pilot, but his ambitions were
destroyed along with him thanks to Freeden's
efforts and Carris's resolve.
 Afterward, the city was rebuilt around Carris
and given a fresh start as a truly autonomous
city.
 Incidentally, a real city of the same name
exists in Canada.

16.DSCR:
A term for human beings born naturally, without
genetic adjustment. The designation came into
use after the emergence of Coordinators, humans
whose genes had been adjusted.
 Many Naturals feel jealousy or hostility toward
Coordinators, who possess superior abilities.
At the same time, no small number of
Coordinators look down on Naturals, flaunting
their gifts. As a result, some Naturals openly
advocate opposition to Coordinators, the
foremost of whom are Blue Cosmos.

17.DSCR:
A general term for human beings whose genes
were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage to
grant them heightened intelligence and a robust
body. Their existence became known to the world
in C.E. 15, when George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, made a worldwide confession
broadcast.
 Coordinators are born with many superior
traits, both physical and mental. However,
whether or not those abilities blossom depends
heavily on the environment in which they are
raised.
 Most Coordinators live on the PLANTs, though
there are exceptional places, such as the
neutral nation of Orb or lunar cities, where
they coexist with Naturals (ordinary humans who
have not undergone genetic adjustment).
 Those born to Natural parents through genetic
adjustment are called 'First-Generation
Coordinators,' while children born between two
Coordinators are called 'Second-Generation
Coordinators.' However, the birth rate has been
declining year by year, and this has become a
major social problem.

18.DSCR:
A political organization known for its
extremism. All of its members are Naturals, and
under the slogan "For a Pure and Blue World," it
seeks the eradication of Coordinators. Even
among Naturals who have not joined Blue Cosmos,
many regard Coordinators with suspicion - a
result of the organization's manipulation of
public opinion.
 However, the political front is only a facade.
Behind the scenes, Blue Cosmos hides its true
nature as a secret society acting as the hands
and feet of LOGOS in pursuit of the total
eradication of Coordinators. This is possible
because its members have infiltrated deep into
the core of the Earth Alliance and the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 After its leader Muruta Azrael died in the
Second Battle of Jachin Due in C.E. 71, the
organization kept a low profile for a time. But
once Lord Djibril took over as its new leader,
it once again began manipulating public opinion
through the Atlantic Federation and the media,
working to drag the Earth Alliance and the
PLANTs back into war.

19.DSCR:
A military-industrial complex said to have
existed since the dawn of recorded history,
wielding powerful influence over politics. It
is made up of merchants of death who have
secretly manipulated wars and postwar
reconstruction alike to reap enormous profits.
 LOGOS is the backer of Blue Cosmos and has
guided public opinion to provoke war between the
Earth Alliance and the Coordinators. Both
Muruta Azrael, Blue Cosmos's former leader, and
Lord Djibril, its current leader, are members of
LOGOS. For LOGOS, the true goal is to keep
profiting by continuing the war; the fact that
Blue Cosmos champions the eradication of
Coordinators owes much to the personal feelings
of these two men.
 Since it possesses no military force of its
own, LOGOS moved the Earth Alliance Forces to
attempt to annihilate the Coordinators during
the previous war. After the war, it organized
Phantom Pain to wield power more directly.

ship.

20.DSCR:
A term referring to the new generation of space
colonies inhabited by Coordinators, their
collective grouping, and the Coordinator nation
itself. The name is an abbreviation for
'Production Location Ally on Nexus Technology,'
and it doubles as a reference to a 'large-scale
production base.'
 As a nation, the PLANTs are administered by the
PLANT Supreme Council. In the past, the Earth
Alliance sought to prevent the PLANTs' autonomy
and independence by imposing heavy taxes and
pressure on them, which became one of the
triggers of the previous war.
 As a residential zone, the PLANTs are
concentrated at L5, one of the Lagrange points
where Earth's and the Moon's gravity balance.

21.DSCR:
The highest authority of the PLANT Supreme
Council, the PLANTs' foremost decision-making
body. Since the signing of the Junius Treaty,
Gilbert Durandal has held the post.
 Patrick Zala once held this post concurrently
with that of Chairman of National Defense, and
it was his hatred and madness that dragged the
war into a quagmire. In reflection of that,
holding both posts simultaneously is forbidden
today.

22.DSCR:
A special unit of ZAFT, its name an
abbreviation for 'Fast Acting Integrated
Tactical Headquarters.'
 Only those whose character and combat record
are recognized as truly exceptional are
admitted, with the approval of both the Chairman
of National Defense and the Chairman of the
PLANT Council. Members are given a silver badge
as proof of their status, and its bearers always
command the respect and envy of those around
them.
 Despite being called a special unit, its
members do not belong to any single unit; they
are permitted to act and give orders based on
their own judgment. Their authority is
considerable, extending even to giving orders to
field commanders.

24.DSCR:
The PLANTs' military organization, its name an
abbreviation for 'Zodiac Alliance of Freedom
Treaty.'
 Its roots lie in a political society formed
chiefly by Siegel Clyne and Patrick Zala, and it
is made up of volunteer soldiers drawn from the
Coordinator populace. All members are trained
to fight on land, at sea, and in the air without
distinction, and the most outstanding soldiers

Coat.'
 ZAFT has no ranks like those of a conventional
military; instead, units are named directly
after their commanders. Supreme command
authority rests with the Chairman of National
Defense of the PLANT Council.

 It was developing the 'Second Stage' mobile
suits, typified by the Impulse, as well as the
new warship Minerva, which would operate them.
 However, on the day of the Minerva's launch
ceremony, it was subjected to a surprise attack
by the Earth Alliance special task force
'Phantom Pain,' and all of the 'Second Stage'
units except the Impulse were seized.

26.DSCR:
The capital of the PLANTs, located in the L5
region.
26.DSC2:
The capital of PLANT, located in the L5
sphere.
 At the end of the war, it was made the target
of the large strategic beam cannon 'Requiem' by
the madness-consumed Djibril. However, thanks
to the efforts of the Joule team, the line of
fire was deflected and it avoided annihilation.
Nevertheless, the surrounding PLANTs suffered
severe damage.

27.DSCR:
An international body established primarily by
nations opposed to the PLANTs and by former
PLANT-affiliated member states.
 After the previous war ended, under the
leadership of the Atlantic Federation - its
strongest military power - the Earth Alliance
used the Earth Alliance Forces to militarily
annex pro-PLANT nations one after another. Only
a handful of nations, such as the Orb Union and
the Kingdom of Scandinavia, remained
unaffiliated and neutral.
 Triggered by 'Break the World,' the incident in
which Coordinators caused Junius Seven to fall
to Earth, the Earth Alliance once again marched
down the road to war with the PLANTs. Behind
the scenes, it appears Blue Cosmos and LOGOS
were involved.

28.DSCR:
The Orb Union. A small nation in the Pacific
Ocean made up of several islands.
 It is a rare place where Naturals and
Coordinators coexist peacefully, and it has
declared a neutral stance, siding with neither
the Earth Alliance nor ZAFT. It is home to the
state-run Morgenroete Inc.
 Orb declared neutrality during the previous war
as well, but its land was scorched by war when
the Earth Alliance invaded. Though its
infrastructure has since been rebuilt, the loss
of many talented people as a result of the war
remains a headache for its current chief
representative, Cagalli Yula Athha.
 Despite her title, the young Cagalli finds it
difficult to seize the initiative, and within
the government the ambitions of the Five Great
Clans that guide the nation are in constant
conflict. Chief among them is Unato, head of
the Seiran family and serving as prime minister,
whose lust for power drives him to scheme to
marry his son Yuna to Cagalli in order to seize
control of the nation's government.

 Even so, it is difficult for the young Cagalli

marry Cagalli to control the government as he
pleases. Furthermore, he conspired with LOGOS,
abandoned the ideal of neutrality, and concluded
an alliance with the Earth Alliance.
 But that honeymoon was also brought to an end
by Cagalli, who returned with the Archangel, and
Orb returned once again to its former neutral
state.

29.DSCR:
Uzumi Nara Athha. The chief representative of
Orb two generations before the present, and
adoptive father of the current chief
representative, Cagalli Yula Athha.
 A shrewd and capable politician known as the
'Lion of Orb' for his resolute manner and
uncompromising integrity.
 During the previous war, he tried to maintain
neutrality, submitting to neither the Earth
Alliance nor ZAFT. But the Earth Alliance
launched an invasion to annex Orb and seize its
mass driver.
 Though he resisted to the very end, the tide of
battle turned decisively against him.
Entrusting the future to Cagalli and the
Archangel, he evacuated the citizens and then
destroyed both the mass driver and Morgenroete
Inc. by his own hand, sharing the fate of his
burning nation.

30.DSCR:
A state-run company of the Orb Union with a

suits, including the Strike and the Aegis.

as shown by its development of the 'Murasame,'
the variable-type mass-production mobile suit
that serves as the mainstay of Orb's forces.
 It also has deep ties to the Archangel, which
it once helped develop, and it secretly carries
out the ship's refits and resupply.

31.DSCR:
A term for the fighting during the previous war
that began with the Earth Alliance's invasion of
Orb.
 Seeking to seize the 'Kaguya,' the mass driver
(a large-scale mass-projection device) essential
for contesting ZAFT's control of space, the
Earth Alliance deployed its new 'GAT-X' series
mobile suits. Orb's forces met them with the
secretly developed mass-production mobile suit
'M1 Astray,' but were ultimately forced into
defeat by overwhelming numbers.
 The Archangel, having broken away from the
military, also joined the defense, but was
forced to withdraw from the battle line after
Uzumi entrusted it with the world's future.
 This two-day battle came to an end when Uzumi
vanished into the flames along with a key
facility.

32.DSCR:
A term for the battle fought in the final stage
of the previous war, in the region of Jachin
Due, ZAFT's space fortress. Many officers and
soldiers on both sides, including Mwu La Flaga,
Muruta Azrael, and Patrick Zala, were killed or
went missing.
 In this battle, the 'GENESIS,' ZAFT's ultimate
weapon - an enormous gamma-ray laser cannon -
was fired twice, and the Earth Alliance Forces
lost more than 40 percent of their space fleet
along with the Ptolemaeus base on the Moon.
 The First Battle of Jachin Due, meanwhile,
refers to the fighting that broke out between
the Earth Alliance Forces and ZAFT immediately
after the outbreak of war, when the Alliance
attempted to strike the PLANT homeland. This
battle was the catalyst for converting Jachin
Due, then still only a resource satellite, into
a space fortress.

33.DSCR:
Rau Le Creuset. A capable ZAFT commander. In
truth he was a Natural, but he concealed this
fact when he enlisted with ZAFT.
 He was born as a clone of Al Da Flaga, Mwu's
father, but because his telomeres, which govern
lifespan, were shorter than those of an ordinary
person, he was treated as a defective product.
 Learning this truth, he came to hate the very
world that had produced a being like himself.
He eventually leaked operational details and
handed over military secrets in an attempt to
bring about the mutual destruction of both ZAFT
and the Alliance. As a result, his scheme had
very nearly succeeded by the time of the Second
Battle of Jachin Due. However, he was defeated
in battle against the Freedom, and vanished
cursing the world into the light of the runaway
GENESIS.
 Perhaps because of a special drug he took
regularly to slow his aging, he was occasionally
seen suffering from side effects. It is thought
that he always hid his face behind a mask to
conceal features aged beyond his years, along
with the dark ambition he kept hidden within.
33.DSC2:
Rau Le Creuset. An excellent military officer

Upon learning of this fact, he came to despise

conceal a face that had aged beyond his years,
along with his hidden dark ambitions. He came
to know Ray Za Burrel, who was also a clone of
Al Da Flaga, through his old friend Durandal,
and took it upon himself to act as Ray's
guardian.

34.DSCR:
A wartime treaty concluded between the Earth
Alliance and the PLANTs on March 10, C.E.
72, the year after the previous war ended. It
takes its name from the fact that it was signed
at Junius Seven, where the scars of the previous
war still ran deep.
 Its main purpose was to limit armaments,
establishing an upper limit on the number of
mobile suits each side could hold and banning
the use of Neutron Jammer Cancellers.
 It also included provisions for restoring
national borders, and nations such as the Orb
Union, which had been annexed by the Earth
Alliance during the war, regained their
independence.
34.DSC2:
A wartime treaty concluded between the Earth

this name. Its main purpose was the limitation
of armaments, establishing caps on the number of
mobile suits possessed and prohibiting the use
of Neutron Jammer Cancellers. It also included
the restoration of border lines, and nations
that had been annexed by the Earth Alliance
during the war, such as the Orb Union of
Chiefdoms, recovered their independence.
However, since each faction was secretly
developing weapons that violated the treaty, it
could be said that, at least in military terms,
it had become a dead letter.

35.DSCR:
Enhanced humans developed by the Earth Alliance
under Blue Cosmos's direction. They were
deployed on the mission to seize the 'Second
Stage Series' at Armory One.
 They resolved the emotional instability that
plagued the earlier generation of enhanced
humans, the 'Biological CPUs,' successfully
retaining the ability to fight Coordinators on
equal or superior terms while also gaining
enough cooperative capacity to work as a team.
 However, if an Extended hears the Block Word
set as a safety measure, they fall into an
extremely unstable mental state.
 Additionally, maintenance using an adjustment
device called a 'cradle' is essential for them
after combat.
35.DSC2:

Coordinators while also granting them enough
coordination to operate as a team. However, if
they hear a block word set as a safety device,
they fall into an extremely unstable mental
state. Furthermore, after combat, maintenance
using an adjustment machine called the 'Cradle'
is indispensable. The 'Cradle' also possesses a
memory adjustment function, and it was used to
erase the memories of Stella, who had become
MIA, from the other two.

36.DSCR:
A mental restraint imposed on the Extended, the
enhanced humans developed by the Earth
Alliance.
 Though the Extended are more mentally stable
than earlier generations of enhanced humans,
hearing the assigned word instantly throws them
into confusion and robs them of the ability to
act calmly. Although it was set as a kind of
safety mechanism, it carries numerous problems,
including the risk of an Extended going berserk
simply by speaking the word themselves.

 It was discovered by George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, in a meteorite near Europa during a
visit to Jupiter, and it is currently kept in
the PLANT homeland.
 It is said to be evidence of extraterrestrial
life, but no new evidence has been found to
support this theory.

38.DSCR:
Leaving one's current Dome Polis to escape to a
region with a milder climate.
 In the story, humanity is forced to live in
Dome Polis, a collection of city units set up in
harsh environments, ostensibly to protect the
environment. But many of the People (as Dome
Polis citizens are called) sense that this is
merely a pretext used by the Siberian Railway,
which holds a monopoly on the procurement of
supplies, to pursue its own profit. As a
result, People who dream of living somewhere
better and carry out an Exodus are never in
short supply.
 However, Exodus is banned by the Siberian
Railway and is treated as a serious crime that
can be punished by death in the worst cases.
Because of this, there exists a profession known
as Exodus contractors, who smuggle people past
the eyes of the Siberian Railway Security Force
to their destination.

39.DSCR:
The sole transportation network across the land
of Siberia. It is managed and operated by the
Siberian Railway Corporation (commonly known as
the Sibetetsu), headed by President Kids Mondo.
Its headquarters are located in Liman
Megalopolis.
 Because it supplies the resources, food, and
other lifelines that the Dome Polises along its
lines depend on, the Siberian Railway is, in
effect, the ruler of the Dome Polises.
 Under its umbrella is the infamous armed
organization known as the Siberian Railway
Security Force. It also maintains close ties
with the international monitoring body known as
'London IMA.'

 At the start of the story, Gainer achieves

 Wearing an Overcoat increases the power of Over
Skills, or allows the wearer to acquire new Over
Skills.
 Each Overcoat is dedicated equipment for a
specific Overman, but another Overman can also
wear the coat and use the Over Skill hidden
within it.

42.DSCR:
Rock formations that rise up in scab-like
(scub) layers. They were given this name
because their colorful appearance resembles
coral. They are sometimes simply called Scub.
 Because they can occur anywhere, human
settlements drive massive stakes called 'pile
bunkers' deep into the ground to prevent the
formations from rising.
 Buried beneath the Scub Coral are the
archetypes of LFOs and KLFs. Because of this,
many excavators are said to keep digging deep
underground in search of them.
42.DSC2:
Rock that rises in multiple layers like scabs.
Its colorful appearance resembles coral, and so
it received this name. It is also simply called
'Scab.' Because it occurs in all sorts of
places, in human living areas, giant piles
called 'Pile Bunkers' are driven deep into the
earth to prevent uplifting. Beneath the scab,
archetypes of LFOs and KLFs are buried. For
this reason, many excavators continue to dig
deep underground. Eventually, Dr. Bear puts
forth the hypothesis that the Scub Coral is a
sentient being, and this turns out to be true.
And what the Scub Coral sent as a messenger to
humanity was the humanoid Coralian, which was
the hope for humanity and the Scub Coral to
coexist.

43.DSCR:
An abbreviation for 'Transparent Light
Particle.' Trapar refers to mysterious,
invisible particles that erupt from Scub Coral
and drift through the air. Sky Fish, creatures
of unknown origin, gather at points where Trapar
is dense.
 Trapar is used as an energy source in power
plants and has already become indispensable to
people's lives. Lift boards are able to fly by
reflecting these particles.
 But Trapar is not merely convenient; it can
also turn against humanity. In the past, a
phenomenon known as the Summer of Love, in which
Trapar erupted abnormally, drove the world to
the brink of destruction. It was the hero Adroc
Thurston who saved the world from that crisis.

45.DSCR:
A sport in which riders use a lift board fitted
with a wheel to ride the waves of Trapar
drifting through the air. It is not limited to
humans - even LFOs and KLFs can Ref if they use

 Its defining feature is the ability to pull off
three-dimensional tricks unlike anything
possible on a skateboard or surfboard. Many are
captivated by the green trails drawn across the
sky, and Ref is quite a major pastime within the
world of the story. Those who Ref are called
lift boarders.
 Incidentally, a lift board is able to fly
because a reflection film that reflects Trapar
is attached to its underside.

 Ciudad del Cielo, the faith's holy site, was

the sky. But it was utterly destroyed in the
SOF massacre, and today lies in ruins.

50.DSCR:
An abbreviation for 'Universal Network.'
 It is commonly pronounced 'U.N.'
 An information network established by the New
Earth Federation with the aim of centralizing
and sharing information across the many parallel
worlds.
 Anyone with a terminal can browse or post
information. In major metropolitan areas, it is
not unusual for a connection to reach every
household, but the further one gets from urban
centers, the lower the rate of adoption
becomes.
 It serves as both a valuable source of
information for citizens and an entertainment

50.DSC2:
An abbreviation for 'Universal Network.'
 It is commonly pronounced 'U.N.'
 An information network established by the New
Earth Federation with the aim of centralizing and
sharing information across the many parallel
worlds.
 Anyone with a terminal can browse or post
information. In major metropolitan areas, it is
not unusual for a connection to reach every
household, but the further one gets from urban
centers, the lower the rate of adoption becomes.
 It serves as both a valuable source of
information for citizens and an entertainment
medium, making it an extremely important piece of
infrastructure across the many parallel worlds.

51.DSCR:
A tactical research unit belonging to the Earth
Federation Forces' lunar garrison.
 It was formed for the purpose of evaluation
testing and shakedown of new-model units, and
its members possess exceptional piloting
skills.
 Its current mission is testing next-generation
standard-issue production units and their
onboard armaments, as well as researching
applied combat tactics.
